jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**


Technomics is a growing employee\-owned, decision analytics company that provides professional services and management solutions to help our clients make ***better decisions faster***. We enable a wide range of clients across the Federal government, from senior level policy makers to program managers, to ***choose smartly, buy effectively and operate efficiently****.* We deliver practical, credible and defensible results offering actionable insights by applying data\-driven and analytics\-based approaches in combination with multidisciplinary talent, subject matter expertise, and tangible and repeatable assets in the form of databases, models, approaches and techniques.  

  

Analysts have the knowledge, skills, abilities and initiative to deliver timely, practical and innovative solutions to our clients as part of high\-performing project teams typically composed of a mix of junior and mid\-level analysts.


Our employee\-owners pride themselves on their ability to apply deep analytical rigor and innovative thought that assist clients in understanding and solving a myriad of challenging resource planning and management problems.


This position may be located in Arlington, VA (Headquarters), Washington D.C., Pentagon, Springfield, VA., Chantilly, VA., Tysons Corner, VA.  

  

**Position\-Specific Overview**  

Data Analysts will support a U.S. Government client in developing data\-driven solutions using Palantir Foundry and related technologies. The role will support data integration, transformation, analytics, and user\-facing applications that improve access to mission and business information.


The individual will work with technical teams and end users to develop data pipelines, analytical workflows, and applications, translate requirements into practical solutions, and support testing and implementation. Relevant experience includes Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, ETL/ELT, low\-code development, cloud technologies, and UX/UI design. Direct Palantir Foundry experience is preferred but not required.


**Responsibilities and Qualifications**


* Develop, maintain, and improve data pipelines, transformations, analytical workflows, and user\-facing data products in Palantir Foundry and related technologies.
* Work with client stakeholders and technical teams to understand requirements, troubleshoot data issues, and translate business needs into practical analytical solutions.
* Analyze, clean, integrate, and validate data from multiple sources to support reporting, analysis, and operational workflows.
* Develop queries, scripts, dashboards, applications, and other analytical products using tools such as Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, and low\-code applications.
* Support data modeling, database design, testing, documentation, and deployment of new capabilities.
* Apply UX/UI and user\-centered design principles to improve the usability of dashboards, workflows, and analytical applications.
* Use modern software development practices including Git, testing, version control, and collaborative development.


**Minimum Qualifications**


* 2\+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, software development, or a related technical field.
* Experience with Python, SQL, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and working with relational databases and structured data.
* Experience with low\-code application development, cloud technologies, or UX/UI design.
* Ability to work directly with users to understand requirements and develop data\-driven solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable data and analytics platforms.
* Experience with PySpark, Spark, or other large\-scale data processing technologies.
* Experience integrating practical AI capabilities, such as LLMs or machine learning models, into user\-facing applications, workflows, or analytical products.
* Prior experience supporting U.S. Government clients or working in regulated environments.


Salary range: $85,000\- 150,000 USD  

  

The salary range listed is one part of our total compensation package, which may also include bonuses, incentives and benefits. Individual compensation is determined based on qualifications such as relevant years of experience, education, certifications and geographic location.


Technomics is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected status under applicable law, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Data Center Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Critical Project Implementation Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) delivers retrofit and infrastructure projects across Amazon’s operational data centers. Our data analytics function turns complex construction and project\-controls data into the insights CPI and CPT leadership rely on to make timely, high\-stakes decisions. Today that function runs on a single engineer supporting a growing portfolio of dashboards, data\-quality checks, and reporting pipelines — a concentration of knowledge and workload that has outpaced one person.  

  

This role adds a second Business Intelligence Engineer to the team. The engineer will partner with our existing analytics owner to share ownership of CPI’s reporting platform, build resilience into critical pipelines, and extend our capacity to serve CPT programs, MBR inputs, and regional\-management reporting audiences. It is equal parts data engineering and customer partnership: you will build the pipelines and dashboards, and you will sit with the customers who depend on them to make sure the solution actually answers the question behind the request.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Design, develop, and maintain BI solutions that turn complex construction and project\-controls data into actionable insights for senior leadership, CPT program teams, and Regional Managers.  

  

Partner directly with customers to gather requirements, challenge assumptions, and translate business needs into scalable data models, dashboards, and reports. Bring genuine curiosity to every engagement to uncover what customers need, not just what they ask for.  

  

Drive process\-improvement initiatives by identifying gaps in existing workflows and advocating for best data practices, working collaboratively with customers to refine and evolve processes until the solution truly delivers.  

  

Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines within the AWS ecosystem for extraction, transformation, and loading of data across a variety of sources.  

  

Oversee production operations including data\-delivery optimization, infrastructure scalability, code deployments, and release management.  

  

Apply and uphold data\-governance and security standards, ensuring appropriate access controls and secure handling of sensitive operational data.  

  

Work as a peer to CPI’s existing analytics engineer — sharing ownership of critical pipelines and dashboards, reviewing each other’s work, and building redundancy so no reporting capability depends on a single person.  

  

Establish and evangelize best practices for data integration, documentation, and solution design across engineering and business teams.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* 3\+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience in ETL management/data pipeline
* Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience directly related to the design or construction of data centers or critical infrastructure or large\-scale mechanical and electrical plants
* track record of going beyond the ask — identifying process gaps or data opportunities that were not part of the original scope and driving them to resolution.
* Experience building and operating highly available data pipelines using AWS technologies including Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda, DynamoDB, and IAM.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role where requirements were ambiguous or incomplete, with a track record of driving clarity through structured discovery and constructive challenge.
* Experience with large\-scale, complex datasets in a business environment, including data mining and warehouse design.
* Familiarity with data governance, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive operational data.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Corporate Sustainability Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
SBA Communications is a leading independent owner and operator of wireless communications infrastructure, including towers, buildings, rooftops, DAS and small cells. We offer a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment.  

  

We welcome your interest in SBA. Let us know a little about you by checking all that apply:

* You are a self\-starter.
* You are resourceful and thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* You have a strong work ethic.
* You are passionate and driven to achieve results.
* You are a team player who enjoys working in a collaborative environment.
* You continuously challenge yourself to find innovative ways to improve.


You may be a perfect fit. At SBA, we operate with the highest sense of integrity and commitment to quality. We focus on achievement and operate with responsiveness, timeliness and accountability. Our culture of excellence incorporates working collegially, where every team member can contribute meaningfully and make a difference.  

  

If you are ready to make an impact, join our team!

**Your Next Career Opportunity – Corporate Sustainability Strategy Analyst**

The Analyst is responsible for conducting research and analysis on relevant industry trends, emerging regulations, and strategic opportunities to fulfill the company’s sustainability objectives, reporting requirements, and program commitments.


The Analyst will play an important role in advancing the company's sustainability agenda, working closely with the team to develop, implement and enhance sustainability initiatives that align with corporate objectives. This position requires a strategic analyst with knowledge of environmental stewardship, social responsibility, and corporate governance practices. The Analyst will execute project plans and collaborate with various departments and internal stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes and financial returns.

**What You Will Do – Primary Responsibilities**

* Support the execution of the company’s sustainability strategy while ensuring alignment with the overall business goals, mission, vision and values.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of the company’s annual Sustainability Report in alignment with sustainability standards, industry best practices and stakeholder expectations.
* Prepare presentations and management reports.
* Conduct research on relevant industry trends, best practices, standards and emerging regulations to fulfill the company’s sustainability objectives and reporting requirements.
* Facilitate the implementation of the renewable energy strategy to achieve the company's goals and targets.
* Deliver cross\-functional sustainability assignments to support the company’s sustainability strategy.
* Analyze benchmarks and key performance indicators to measure the progress, effectiveness and impact of various initiatives.
* Report on project workstream outcomes while making recommendations for improvements.
* Support analysis for annual shareholder engagement meetings on sustainability with the company’s largest investors.
* Draft responses to credit and sustainability rating agencies and the company’s key customers to optimize ratings and achieve market recognition.
* Collaborate with internal teams, including operations, accounting, and commercial affairs.
* Research relevant legislation, regulations and standards related to sustainability to ensure compliance across all markets of operations.
* Support climate risk and impact assessments, contribute to reporting under voluntary and regulatory frameworks and research strategies for risk mitigation.
* Conduct the collection, analysis and reporting of quantitative and qualitative sustainability data and metrics.
* Follow robust processes for collecting, analyzing, and verifying sustainability\-related data.
* Contribute to emissions accounting for Scopes 1, 2 and 3, in line with GHG Protocol standards and third\-party assurance requirements.
* Prepare periodic reports that track progress toward project workstreams.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, cost savings and improved resource management.
* Review external statements and policies annually.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative work environment. Provide guidance and review the work of junior team members.
* Encourage team member engagement around sustainable practices throughout the company.
* Other projects and duties as assigned.

**What You’ll Need – Qualifications \& Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Sustainability, or a related field.
* Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., MBA, Sustainability, or equivalent) preferred.
* 1 to 3 years of relevant business experience in corporate sustainability or management consulting.
* Ability to conduct research and data collection related to sustainability strategies and programs.
* Foundational business acumen.
* Experience supporting sustainability reporting activities for publicly listed companies.
* Exposure to industry standards (e.g., GRI, SASB, IFRS S1/S2, etc.) and regulatory requirements.
* Foundational analytical skills.
* Basic knowledge of emissions accounting under the GHG Protocol standards.
* Strong communication and business writing skills.
* Ability to perform research and analysis to support team activities.
* Driven, collaborative, accountable, resilient analyst with strong interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in teams.

**Physical Requirements**  

  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Ability to stoop, bend, kneel or crouch.
* Ability to stand, walk and sit.
* Ability to reach with hands and arms
* Visual ability correctable to

jobs.description:
As the digital arm for the world's largest food and beverage company, Nestlé IT \& Digital Americas harnesses the power of data, analytics, and innovative technology to deliver transformative solutions and business resiliency for Nestlé businesses and iconic brands from Purina® to Nescafé®. We’re innovators, strategic collaborators, value multipliers, and digital business leaders committed to delivering results that create meaningful experiences and drive value, enabling Nestlé to win in the marketplace. By joining, you become part of a 150\-year legacy and a global team of 270,000\+. We invest in our people—their growth, development, and sense of belonging. This shared unity and purpose is what motivates individuals to join, stay, and advance their careers within Nestlé.

 *This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.*

 **Position Summary**

  

The Functional Relationship Management (FRM) team serves as the critical link between Nestlé Digital \& IT and the Commercial business, helping shape how technology capabilities are prioritized, funded, and delivered across Nestlé USA. As a Senior Business Analyst, you’ll be a key operational partner to the Commercial FRM function, driving alignment, execution, and business outcomes across a complex portfolio. Working closely with senior leaders, you will help define priorities, manage plans, oversee financial and portfolio performance, while translating complex information into clear, actionable insights that enable disciplined decision\-making and successful execution.

  

* Manage the daily operations of the Commercial FRM function, ensuring priorities, initiatives, milestones, risks, and dependencies are tracked and communicated to provide leadership with clear visibility into progress and performance
* Develop high\-quality, executive\-ready materials that communicate portfolio progress, priorities, and recommendations with clarity and impact
* Own financial tracking for the Commercial portfolio, including budget management, forecasting, variance analysis, and reconciliation of actuals
* Support the Sr. Director of FRM in driving alignment, preparing for key forums, and managing communications across stakeholders
* Ensure leadership interactions are well\-prepared, focused, and result in clear actions
* Facilitate alignment and ensure follow\-through on key actions and commitments across Commercial, Digital \& IT, and other stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to improve how the FRM function operates by refining processes, templates, and tools that enhance efficiency, consistency, and overall impact

 **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7\+ years of experience in business operations, portfolio management, strategy support, and/or a related role within a large, complex organization

 **Other**

* 1 \+ years of experience managing budgets, forecasting, and/or analyzing financial performance is preferred
* Experience with Commercial, Sales, or Marketing functions is preferred
* Experience in Consumer Product Goods (CPG) and/or a similarly complex industry is preferred

  

The approximate pay range for this position is $89,630\.00 to $126,980\.00\. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position. Nestlé offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with Company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at About Us \| Making an Impact \| Nestle Careers (nestlejobs.com).

  

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.  

  

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

  

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.description:
**Senior Information Security Analyst**
=======================================

﻿  

  

**Category**
------------


Information Technology  

  

**Job Location**
----------------


Washington, District of Columbia  

  

**Tracking Code**
-----------------


5468  

  

**Position Type**
-----------------


Full\-Time/Regular  

  

CALIBRE Systems, Inc., an employee\-owned mission focused solutions and digital transformation company, is looking for a highly qualified Senior Information Security Analyst to support a DoD client with enterprise cybersecurity for a large program serving military families. This position will be hybrid with some required meetings in Alexandria, VA.



This candidate will lead and oversee cybersecurity compliance, security architecture, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, RMF/eMASS support, and ATO sustainment for DoD cloud infrastructure and information systems. The senior analyst will provide technical leadership for Zero Trust Architecture implementation, advanced security monitoring, vulnerability remediation, cyber reporting, and coordination with Government cybersecurity stakeholders.


**An active Secret clearance is required.**


**Salary range will be from $105k\-$115k.**

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Lead RMF, ATO, continuous monitoring, and eMASS activities, including development and execution of ATO action plans and sustainment documentation.


* Develop and maintain Zero Trust Architecture across IL2, IL4, and IL5 cloud infrastructure and prepare quarterly Zero Trust compliance briefings.


* Design and implement advanced security architectures for predictive threat detection, incident response, real\-time security insights, and cloud infrastructure resilience.


* Oversee weekly DISA STIG/SRG and ACAS assessments, vulnerability prioritization, remediation planning, and integration of results into eMASS.


* Lead POA\&M governance, evidence collection, mitigation planning, and validation coordination with ISSM, ISSO, SCA Team, CIO/AO, and other Government stakeholders.


* Direct monitoring and analysis of cyber resources, SIEM\-integrated logs, WAF/NGFW activity, anomaly detection, account aging, compliance monitoring, insider threat indicators, and GovCloud logs.


* Provide rapid escalation and advisory support for abnormal findings, vulnerabilities, cyber threats, OPORDs, CTOs, WARNORDs, and secure incident communications.


* Lead vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for new or modified applications, servers, databases, and infrastructure components before deployment.


* Coordinate with the Tier 2 Cybersecurity Service Provider to support incident lifecycle management, response coordination, and reporting timelines.


* Develop, recommend, and implement automated incident response workflows, cybersecurity playbooks, threat simulation labs, and cross\-agency exercise scenarios.


* Oversee recurring audits of cybersecurity SOPs, contingency planning, disaster recovery exercises, and reporting through the IT, Cybersecurity, and Data Operations Dashboard.


* Access SIPRNet and attend classified briefings at the Government facility in Alexandria, Virginia, as required.
  


  

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Advanced knowledge of NIST RMF, eMASS, DISA STIGs/SRGs, ACAS, POA\&Ms, DoD Zero Trust requirements, DoD 8140/DCWF mandates, and cybersecurity reporting requirements.


* Ability to analyze threat, vulnerability, compliance, and security monitoring data and translate findings into actionable remediation plans and executive\-level reporting.


* Coordination with ISSMs, ISSOs, SCA teams, CIO/AO stakeholders, CSSPs, and technical operations teams.


* Ability to develop cybersecurity policies, SOPs, automated workflows, incident response playbooks, or security architecture recommendations.


**Desired Skills and Qualifications:**


* Master’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a related field.


* DoD 8570/8140\-aligned certification such as Security\+ CE, CySA\+, CISSP, CASP\+, or equivalent


* Active Top Secret clearance


* Experience with eMASS or other compliance tracking platforms.


* Proficiency with cloud security controls and cloud\-based compliance requirements.


* Demonstrable knowledge of Zero Trust principles and cybersecurity modernization strategies.
  


  

**Required Experience**
-----------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a related field.


* Active Secret security clearance.


* **7\+ years** of experience in cybersecurity, RMF support, compliance, or information assurance.


* Senior\-level experience (e.g. leading, mentoring, or supervising others) with DoD cybersecurity, information assurance, RMF, ATO, vulnerability management, compliance, or incident response activities.
  


  

**CALIBRE and its subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity Employer and supports transitioning service members, veterans and individuals with disabilities. We offer a competitive salary and full benefits package. To be considered, please apply via our website at** **www.calibresys.com****. Come join our dynamic team. \#CALIBRECareers**

jobs.description:
**Geotechnical Research Technician (On‑Site)**

**Location:** Turner–Fairbank Highway Research Center, 6300 Georgetown Pike, McLean, VA

**Employer:** Advanced Global Resources (AGR), LLC.

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, **On\-Site** (no remote authorized)

**Hours of Operation:** Monday – Friday 8 hours shifts, 7:30 am – 4:00 pm

**Clearance:** Must meet TFHRC facility access requirements

  

Hiring immediate with start date within 2 weeks of passing federal background check

**About the Role**


Join a nationally recognized federal research center supporting geotechnical innovation that directly impacts U.S. transportation infrastructure. As a **Geotechnical Research Technician**, you will work hands‑on in the FHWA Geotechnical Laboratory, supporting research on soils, foundations, erosion, pavements, and geotechnical materials. You’ll assist engineers, set up and run experiments, install instrumentation, collect data, and help maintain a state‑of‑the‑art research facility.


This role is ideal for mechanically inclined, detail‑oriented individuals who enjoys research testing, technically inclines, data organizer experienced with spreadsheets, and contributing to meaningful national research.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Laboratory Testing \& Experiment Support**

* Set up, operate, and break down geotechnical experiments (triaxial, direct shear, resilient modulus, erosion testing, permeability, etc.)
* Prepare, mix, and fabricate soil specimens using sands, clays, gravels, and engineered materials.
* Install sensors, reference assemblies, and data acquisition systems for manual and automated readings.
* Conduct standardized geotechnical tests following ASTM and AASHTO procedures.
* Document procedures with clear notes, photos, and organized data.

**Instrumentation \& Field Support**

* Assist with field testing, instrumentation installation, and data collection at off‑site locations.
* Operate forklifts, cranes, and rigging equipment (training provided).
* Handle Shelby tube and other sensitive samples to minimize disturbance.

**Operations \& Maintenance (Engineering Lab)**

* Maintain laboratory cleanliness, organization, and equipment readiness.
* Support calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of lab equipment.
* Coordinate logistics, materials, and supplies for ongoing research activities.

**Research Support \& Data Management**

* Collect, organize, and analyze test data in approved formats.
* Assist engineers with experimental plans, schematics, and documentation.
* Contribute to high‑quality research outputs, including internal reports and technical notes.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Ability to pass a federal background check (no criminal record, pass drug test, either US citizen or non\-US citizen who has an authorization to work in the US and resided in the US for the last 3 years, valid drivers license.)
* Completion of **at least two years of technical training** in engineering technician skills, electronics, computer science, or related fields (GT‑RT‑1 requirement).
* Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to work with tools and laboratory equipment.
* Demonstrated hands‑on experience in a geotechnical laboratory.
* Knowledge of standard ASTM/AASHTO soil testing methods.
* Ability to lift 50 lbs and be on your feet for up to 8 hours per day.
* Strong communication skills and ability to follow detailed technical instructions.
* Comfortable working with formulas in spreadsheets

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree within the area of civil engineering or geology.
* Experience with large‑scale geotechnical testing (triaxial, direct shear, erosion function apparatus, interface shear).
* Familiarity with instrumentation systems and data acquisition hardware.
* Experience directing general laborers or assisting engineering staff.
* Data analysis skills and ability to prepare clear summaries of test results.
* Forklift or overhead crane experience (training can be provided).

jobs.title: Business Analyst 2
jobs.description:
We are seeking a forward\-thinking SharePoint Online Administrator who is highly skilled in designing, managing, and evolving enterprise SharePoint solutions to support NASA’s Office of Strategic Infrastructure and Center Operations Directorate. This role requires someone who can understand mission needs, translate requirements into effective digital solutions, and guide customers toward smarter, more efficient use of SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365\.

**\*On\-Site \- Must reside within 50 miles of a NASA Center.\***

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Meet regularly with customers, site owners, and mission teams to understand their day‑to‑day challenges and information management needs.
* Help translate business requirements into practical SharePoint solutions such as pages, lists, libraries, and basic workflows or forms.
* Improve site organization and searchability by setting up and maintaining site structures and document libraries. Use consistent metadata and simple taxonomy guidelines so users can easily find the information they need.
* Offer guidance on SharePoint features and recommend ways users can streamline their processes using built‑in capabilities.
* Assist with creating new business solutions using SharePoint Online, Power Automate, Power Apps, and other Microsoft 365 tools, focusing on configuration rather than custom development.
* Create and maintain site templates, list configurations, metadata setups, and basic term store entries to support organized and consistent content management.
* Support teams in making full use of SharePoint as a collaboration and information‑sharing platform.
* Manage site collections, permissions, storage settings, and basic configuration tasks across SharePoint Online.
* Apply security, compliance, and governance settings based on established organizational standards.
* Help oversee content lifecycle tasks such as archiving, maintaining clean version histories, and ensuring metadata is properly used.
* Troubleshoot common SharePoint issues including access problems, performance concerns, and configuration inconsistencies.
* Assist with site migrations, onboarding new SharePoint sites, and supporting cross‑team coordination around platform use.
* Review current SharePoint or Microsoft 365 setups and provide practical recommendations to improve usability, efficiency, and compliance with organizational guidelines.
* Build and maintain simple Power BI dashboards or reports to help teams view data and make informed decisions.
* Share progress on SharePoint improvements with leadership in clear, easy‑to‑understand terms.
* Proactively communicate risks, limitations, and opportunities to customers and stakeholders.

 **Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
* 4\+ years’ experience with SharePoint Online, Power Platform, or M365 tools
* Support day‑to‑day management of SharePoint Online and M365 sites, including site collections, libraries, lists, permissions, and basic site structure.
* Improve data organization and ease of use by helping implement consistent folder structures, metadata, and simple retention practices.
* Working knowledge of SharePoint Online features and integration with Teams, OneDrive, and M365 Groups.
* Assist with monitoring storage usage, applying sharing settings, and following governance guidelines.
* Basic PowerShell experience for routine tasks such as bulk updates, permissions adjustments, and generating reports.
* Familiarity with Entra ID (Azure AD) concepts related to authentication and access control.
* Support the application of security settings, governance policies, retention labels, and proper access management.
* Understand versioning, recycle bin processes, and common recovery steps.
* General awareness of SharePoint performance basics and standard troubleshooting approaches.
* Experience using migration tools or supporting SharePoint data moves between cloud and on‑prem environments.
* Build simple workflows or automations using Power Platform tools like Power Automate
* Comfortable working with Teams, OneDrive, and Power Platform integrations; awareness of modern SharePoint features.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical steps in an easy‑to‑understand way.
* Solid problem‑solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Commitment to maintaining clean, organized sites that support user productivity.
* Customer‑focused mindset with proactive support habits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting larger organizations, including government or federal environments.
* Participation in delivering SharePoint improvements or small solution initiatives.
* Experience collaborating across IT teams, business units, and leadership.
* Ability to create helpful dashboards, scripts, or simple automation tools (Power BI, PowerShell, Graph API, M365 admin tools).

**Additional Requirements**

* Must be located within **50 miles of a NASA Center**

**Clearance Requirement**

* Must be able to obtain and maintain a **Public Trust Clearance**

The process defines a standard methodology to plan, budget, engineer, and install timely, effective, and affordable shipboard improvements while maintaining Configuration Management (CM) and supportability.


The **Data Analyst** will play a vital role in engaging Senior Navy leaders, leveraging their comprehensive understanding of shipboard operations and their ability to provide valuable insights through data analysis. jobs.title: Program Analyst
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


This position is part of the Defense Human Resources Activity. The incumbent serves as a Senior Program Analyst under the general administrative direction of a Branch Chief (military O4/O5 or GS\-13/14\). The primary purpose of this role is to independently evaluate, formulate, and defend strategic operations for Employer Support of the Guard and Reserve (ESGR) volunteer committee programs.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


All U.S. Citizens


  
**Duties**
----------


As a Program Analyst at the GS\-0343\-9/11/12 some of your typical work assignments may include:


* Independently evaluates, formulates, and defends strategic operations for Employer Support of the Guard and Reserve (ESGR) volunteer committee programs, providing regional oversight to 25\-30 states and territories to establish critical program aspects impacting the nationwide framework.
* Serves as a nationwide Subject Matter Expert (SME) for high\-visibility initiatives (e.g., Bosslift, Volunteer of the Year), authoring nationwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and developing customized local volunteer plans to drive the readiness and retention of National Guard and Reserve members.
* Formulates, reallocates, and defends Annual Spend Plans (ASP) before HQ ESGR leadership, executing complex spend analyses, resolving regional funding priorities, and enforcing strict regulatory compliance (including the mandatory 60% outreach budget threshold).
* Performs qualitative and quantitative analyses on committee effectiveness and fiscal execution, developing novel methodologies to resolve poorly defined regional issues by mapping Member Management System (MMS) and EventPLUS metrics against the ESGR Five\-Year Strategic Plan.
* Serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) managing geographically dispersed support contract personnel, operates as a Government Purchase Card (GPC) holder, processes invitational travel, and directs the nationwide ESGR awards cycle.
* If selected at the GS/09 or GS/11 level, the responsibilities will be performed in a developmental capacity.

  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* Must be a U.S. citizen
* Males born after 12\-31\-59 must be registered for Selective Service http://www.sss.gov
* Resume and supporting documents (See How To Apply)
* Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
* May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
* Work Schedule: Fulltime
* Overtime: Occasionally
* Tour of Duty: Flexible
* Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized
* Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA): Exempt
* Financial Disclosure: Not Required
* Telework Eligibility: This position is telework eligible
* If selected at the GS9 level, the incumbent may be noncompetitively promoted to the GS11, and GS12 level, without further competition once time\-in\-grade, training, satisfactory performance, and other requirements of the higher grade levels are met

### **Qualifications**


You may qualify at the GS\-09, if you fulfill the following qualifications:  

  

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS\-7 grade level in the Federal service:


* Assisting in the evaluation of program effectiveness
* Supporting logistics for personnel
* Performing administrative duties related to travel, training, or purchasing

You may qualify at the GS\-11, if you fulfill the following qualifications:  

  

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS\-9 grade level in the Federal service:
* Independently evaluating program operations to recommend improvements
* Managing budgets or spend plans, analyzing data to identify performance gaps, obligating, expending, or controlling funds and items with a monetary value of less than $2 million, and procuring goods/services of a similar value.

You may qualify at the GS\-12, if you fulfill the following qualifications:  

  

One year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS\-11 grade level in the Federal service:
* Evaluating and analyzing program operations to recommend strategic improvements; formulating, executing, or reallocating budgets and spend plans; analyzing metrics from relational databases to identify performance gaps; and providing logistical or administrative oversight (such as serving as a Contract Officer Representative or processing travel/purchasing requests).

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.
### **Education**


Substitution of education may not be used in lieu of specialized experience for this grade level.  



### **Additional information**

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high\-growth Series A start\-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin\-out, and our unique combination of learning\-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion\-dollar industry.



Gravis builds the RACK, our manufacturer\-agnostic hardware and software system that turns excavators and loaders into autonomous machines, alongside Slate, our platform for planning, perception, and machine intelligence.



### **About the role**



You will own end\-to\-end program delivery for one or more key initiatives at Gravis. Technical Program Managers sit at the intersection of strategic, commercial and customer requirements, and engineering execution on squads that draw from our functional teams.



We are looking for candidates with a background in technical program management, product management, or engineering management with solid experience structuring and delivering complex cross\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery.


### **What you will do**


**Program ownership**


* Own end\-to\-end program planning and reporting for major initiatives spanning software releases, hardware integration, and field validation, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks across distributed teams.
* Translate high\-level strategic, commercial and product goals into structured plans, roadmaps, and quarterly commitments in partnership with engineering leads.
* Identify and resolve blockers before they hit the critical path.
* Coordinate software release processes, including integration testing, regression validation, and staged rollouts to field deployments.

**Collaboration \& reporting**


* Act as the operational interface with external partners: OEM integrators, construction contractors, and equipment rental providers, coordinating requirements and delivery schedules.
* Lead cross\-team alignment and program reviews, producing clear documentation (roadmaps, RACI matrices, status dashboards) for engineering, operations, and leadership.
* Gather structured feedback from field deployments and translate it into actionable input for engineering teams.
### **What we're looking for**



We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most but not all of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.


**Core qualifications**


* 5–10 years of experience in technical program management, product management or engineering program management, or a closely related role, with a track record of delivering complex, multi\-team programs from planning through commercial delivery in a fast\-paced, deep\-tech environment.
* Solid technical foundation as evidenced by technical degree(s) in engineering or related fields.
* Hands\-on experience with agile / iterative development methodologies and tools such as Jira or Linear.
* Good working knowledge of software and hardware development practices, system architecture, and CI/CD or testing practices.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, aggressive timelines, and cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, field, and commercial stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel as required by business projects.
* High proficiency in English with the ability to read, write and present technical materials clearly and concisely.

**Nice to have**


* Experience with robotics or hardware product development cycles and embedded systems.
* Exposure to safety\-critical or field\-deployed systems.
* Experience coordinating programs across multiple countries or regulatory environments.
* Prior experience at an early\-stage hardware/software startup.
### **This role is a great fit if…**


* You care about building things that directly impact the real world at scale and work reliably outside the lab, with imperfect data, real constraints, and genuine stakes.
* You want to help build the program management function at Gravis from the ground up, establishing practices that scale as the company grows.
* You thrive when bridging disciplines, moving fluidly between hardware, software, and field operations conversations in the same day.
* You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem\-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism.
This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.



Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Assistant Capital Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. (NYSE: REXR)** is a leading, publicly traded industrial real estate investment and management company operating a $14 Billion industrial real estate portfolio.

**Assistant Capital Project Manager (ACPM)**



We are looking for an experienced Assistant Capital Project Manager (ACPM) who will be an integral member of the construction team with a primary focus on accomplishing capital projects and working in tandem with our Capital Project Managers.



Typical capital projects include roofing/skylights, landscaping, paving, painting, lighting, HVAC, sprinklers, ADA improvements and small tenant improvements (TI's). The value of the individual projects generally ranges from $50,000 up to $1,000,000\. The ACPM will be part of a small team completing the annual budgeted capital work across the Rexford portfolio, throughout Southern California.



In this role you will support Capital Project Managers (CPM) with daily project coordination, documentation, administrative follow\-up, vendor communication, contract processing, and reporting to ensure capital projects move forward on schedule and in compliance with company standards.


**Location:** LI\-Hybrid / Los Angeles, CA, or Ontario, CA or Costa Mesa, CA


**Work Arrangement:** You will follow a hybrid work model, offering a balanced blend of remote and in\-office work.


**About The Role:**


* Coordinate and schedule daily project activities, including bid walks, vendor site visits, tenant coordination, punch walks, project meetings, and other field\-related activities requiring coordination with CPM's, other Rexford internal teams, tenants, and vendors.
* Prepare meeting notes and action item summaries for assigned CPM project meetings and distribute follow\-up notes to attendees in a timely manner.
* Draft and complete formal job cost forms after management approval, process required signatures, and file approved documentation per company processes.
* Complete Work Order and Service Order documentation after CPM scope input is finalized, coordinate routing for signatures, and ensure fully executed documents are stored per company processes.
* Monitor and track change orders daily in coordination with assigned project CPMs, complete change order request documentation, process approvals and signatures, enter approved changes in Yardi, and perform required budget transfers or revisions.
* Maintain clear communication with assigned CPMs and ensure they are included in project\-related communications to support alignment, timely decision\-making, and accurate project records.
* Review, code, and submit invoices for payment processing. Ensure costs are coded correctly and are following corresponding contracts.
* Complete project closeout documentation for assigned jobs, including warranties, permits, as\-builts, closeout photos, final invoices, required releases, and other project records, and file documentation in the appropriate construction accounting or facilities system.
* Review, track, and maintain contractor insurance documentation for each assigned project, coordinate with internal insurance support teams as needed, and confirm required insurance is current before payment processing.
* Provide support to the Property Management teams with onsite improvements projects.


**Experience/Qualifications:**


* Experience within industrial, warehouse buildings, retail, office interior construction.
* 5\-7 years of experience in project / construction management managing capital projects for a landlord.
* Construction accounting experience in Yardi accounting software.
* Broad knowledge of mechanical/electrical/fire life safety engineering and building fabric, infrastructure, and coordination strategy.
* Team player with the ability to excel in a dynamic organization.
* Record of creating new processes and efficiencies.
* Experience with budget development and management, with sound financial acumen.
* Proficient knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).


**ADA Requirements**: The physical demands, work environment factors, and mental functions described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


**Physical Demands**: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to stand; walk; sit for extended periods of time; use hands to feel, handle, or type; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move or carry up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision


**Compensation:** Rexford Industrial's reward plan includes great compensation packages, bonus eligibility, and long\-term stock incentives. The expected hourly rate range for this role is $36\.06 to $45\.67 (annualized equivalent $75,000 to $95,000\), with a 10% discretionary annual bonus target and stock grant eligibility.\* The actual base salary and total compensation offered depend on a variety of factors, which include, without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location where the job will be performed. The final base salary and total compensation will be described in any offer letter.

**What We Offer**


* Comprehensive Benefits Package Including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance.
* Flexible Time Off
* Bonus Eligibility \& Long\-Term Incentives
* 401(k) Employer Match Program
* Professional Development Resources
* Robust Health \& Wellness Program
* Volunteer and Community Engagement Opportunities
* Employee Resource Groups

**OUR EXCITING OPPORTUNITY**




*Community Action Partnership* *of Orange County* has an exciting opportunity for a


***CSFP Program Manager***




The Commodity Supplemental Food Program (CSFP) Manager will lead and manage CSFP staff, including operational and administrative duties, necessary for CSFP compliance and distribution of food to eligible participants; playing a critical part in the work and dedication of *Community Action Partnership of Orange County’s* initiatives. It’s leadership with a cause and the rewards are immeasurable!




**WHAT YOU WILL ACCOMPLISH IN THIS ROLE**


Under the direction of the CSFP Senior Program Manager, the CSFP Manager will plan, direct and coordinate activities for one\-third of CSFP distribution sites while ensuring compliance with CSFP and ensure CAP OC objectives are accomplished within the prescribed time frame. It is desirable that the selected CSFP Manager candidate be bi\-lingual in Spanish or Vietnamese.


This position will work in\-office for the entire work week/remote or a hybrid schedule is not available. This position also requires working rotating Saturdays.




The annual salary for this position is $70,304 to $81,000\.




**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage and coordinate the scheduling and activities for one\-third of the CSFP distribution sites on a daily, weekly and monthly basis; monitor number of food boxes distributed to meet quarterly and yearly distribution goals.
* Manage, assist and support the work performed by Eligibility Technicians including field work, client certification, telephone coverage, filing, data entry and program outreach.
* Research and recommend potential distribution sites to the Senior Manager CSFP.
* Reconcile the number of food boxes distributed daily. Calculate food usage and complete all other computations necessary in preparing the monthly inventory report.
* Complete managerial administrative duties including monitoring budget(s), producing, completing and submitting reports.
* Monitor and evaluate daily activities to ensure program objectives are being met and recommend necessary changes or modifications.
* Work collaboratively with other managers in preparing the monthly calendar and schedule for staff and volunteers.
* Lead the selection, printing and distribution of nutrition education materials.
* Work with a variety of partners and resources, and act as a representative of CAP OC for the community support programs.
* Other duties as assigned.

**MANAGEMENT ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage, motivate and evaluate the performance of direct reporting CSFP Eligibility Technicians by utilizing EPIC values.
* Manage the daily workflow of direct reporting CSFP Eligibility Technicians, scheduling of staff to ensure daily goals and job duties are accomplished, ensure all safety procedures are followed.
* Direct the interview, selection and training process for new members of direct reporting staff.
* Coordinate training programs for new staff and identify training needs for current staff.
* Perform constructive and timely performance evaluations on direct reporting CSFP Eligibility Technicians.
* Ensure direct staff is following all CAP OC policies, procedures and guidelines.
* Perform approval process of timecards, vacation and sick hours within approval process timeline.
* Handle discipline and termination of Eligibility Technicians with support of People and Culture, Senior Manager CSFP and Food Bank Director.
* Other duties as assigned.




**T****HE IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE IN**

* Possessing strong interpersonal and customer service skills with staff, volunteers, and participants.
* Effective leadership skills that will result in meeting all departmental and CAP OC goals, development of an EPIC staff, and meeting CAP OC initiatives.
* Strong time management skills, working effectively within demanding time constraints.
* Communication proficiency with all levels of staff, management, participants and partners. Communication proficiency desired in English/Vietnamese or English/Spanish.
* Problem solving/analysis in order to resolve short\-term problems and possible looming problems.
* Understanding and applying program rules, regulations and procedures, and a familiarity of laws and regulations governing county, state and federal funded programs.




**IDEAL CANDIDATE MUST BE**

* Customer service focus: Establish rapport with staff, service agencies, churches, commercial residences and participants from culturally diverse backgrounds.
* Ethically Focused: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and aligns with the values of the organization.
* Inclusive: Work cooperatively and effectively with others to set goals, resolve problems, and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness.
* Lead: Positively influence others to achieve results that are in the best interest of CAP OC.
* Creative/Innovative: Develop new and unique ways to improve the standing of the department and to create new opportunities.

jobs.title: Enterprise Program Manager (Refuse Manager)
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

  

  

**The City of Santa Ana is looking for individuals who are results\-oriented, possess great attitude, demonstrate creativity and innovation, work efficiently, show a record of success and have a passion for public service. Having highly talented employees provides the best service to our community.**
Directs, coordinates, supervises, and manages the operations of the Enterprise Section, including Refuse Enterprise, Right\-of\-Way, and Energy and Sustainability Programs, within the Municipal Services Division of the Public Works Agency; provides responsible and complex administrative support to higher\-level management.

**DISTINGUISHING FEATURES OF THE CLASS**
This is a single administrative management classification in the Municipal Services Division of the Public Works Agency. The incumbent has managerial oversight responsibility of Enterprise Section programs and activities, including the Refuse Enterprise, Right\-of\-Way, and Energy and Sustainability Programs. The Enterprise Program Manager classification is distinguished from the next higher Deputy Public Works Director / Parks, Fleet, and Facilities Manager classification in that the latter classification has management oversight over all Municipal Services Division functions, provides divisional direction, has higher decision making authority, and handles higher level responsibilities. The Enterprise Program Manager classification is distinguished from the lower level classifications in that the former classification has managerial oversight over all Enterprise Section functions, a broader scope of work, higher decision making authority, and more complex responsibilities.


**Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To**
------------------------------------------------------


* Administers and manages the City’s Refuse Enterprise Program, including program development and implementation, contract and grant management, compliance with state mandates and other regulations, public education, and solid waste code enforcement.
* Develops and oversees solid waste compliance and enforcement programs, and organic waste and recycling programs and activities, including solid waste compliance field inspections and citations, the investigation and remediation of complaints and violations, compliance with Waste Reduction and Recycling Plan requirements, and solid waste outreach and educational programs.
* Develops and manages the City’s waste hauler contract; ensures waste hauler abides by contract provisions; and ensures the resolution of waste hauler questions and concerns from City officials and staff, residents, and commercial businesses.
* Develops and manages right\-of\-way activities, such as bus stop and kiosk maintenance and advertising, and permitting of digital billboards and banners, streetlight banners, and news boxes.
* Oversees the City’s right\-of\-way programs and activities, including the administration of applications and permits; ensures public right\-of\-way items are installed and maintained in compliance with program and regulatory policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Supports the City’s Energy and Sustainability Program goals through various citywide energy efficiency projects and activities; identifies grant funding opportunities.
* Implements, administers, and oversees section short\- and long\-term goals, objectives, policies, procedures, strategies, and priorities; adheres to the City’s Strategic Plan.
* Assists in the development, monitoring, and administration of the section budget; directs the forecasting of funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials, and supplies; determines availability of funding for various projects and services; monitors and approves expenditures; and requests adjustments, as necessary.
* Monitors refuse enterprise related trends and developments; monitors and responds to changes in relevant regulations.
* Prepares, publishes, presents, and maintains a variety of reports and records; conducts and oversees complex section research and studies.
* Conducts and evaluates a variety of organizational studies for effectiveness of service delivery methods and process improvement management; recommends modifications to programs and procedures; and implements program and process improvements.
* Plans, directs, coordinates, and reviews work activities, projects, and programs; monitors work flow; continuously reviews and evaluates work products, methods, and procedures; and works with staff to identify and resolve problems.
* Selects, trains, deploys, supervises, develops, and motivates assigned section staff; establishes performance standards and evaluates employee performance; works with employees to correct deficiencies; and implements disciplinary procedures with the department head.
* Develops, negotiates, and monitors complex requests for proposals and contracts.
* Works and coordinates with other City departments, including the City Attorney’s Office, on section matters, and outside agencies, such as CalRecycle, OC Waste \& Recycling, and the Orange County Transportation Authority, for compliance planning, implementation, and monitoring, as appropriate.
* Represents the City, or delegates such authority, in regard to community, local, and state agencies and professional organizations.
* Manages public information issued and released pertaining to section; oversees responses to general inquiries from citizens and customers; and responds to and resolves the most difficult and sensitive inquiries and complaints.
* Serves and participates on a variety of boards, commissions, and committees to ensure the City’s interests are protected; prepares and presents staff reports and other correspondence; and provides information regarding section matters.
* Conducts internal audits and quality control; coordinates and responds to external audit reviews.
* Ensures division record management is in accordance with legal requirements and City policy.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Quality, GES NA Quality (Design & Construction)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You are a Senior Program Manager within the Design \& Construction (D\&C) Quality Management Team (QMT), part of Global Engineering Services (GES) North America. In this role, you serve as a senior quality program leader, autonomously driving the strategy, development, and execution of quality management programs that span the full D\&C project lifecycle across Amazon's logistics network.  

  

You independently own and deliver complex, cross\-functional quality programs—from Quality Management System (QMS) implementation to continuous improvement initiatives—with limited oversight. You operate as a trusted advisor to D\&C Execution Teams and Regional Leadership, providing strategic guidance on quality frameworks, process optimization, and data\-driven decision\-making. Your work directly influences how Amazon delivers construction projects at scale.  

  

Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. You develop program roadmaps, lead cross\-functional initiatives, make trade\-off decisions, and drive organizational alignment across multiple stakeholder groups. You are expected to influence without authority, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and deliver measurable business outcomes through quality programs.  

  

You bring deep expertise in program management, quality systems, and continuous improvement methodologies. You contribute to team strategy, and represent the QMT in senior leadership forums. You are a systems thinker who connects quality outcomes to business value and champions a culture where quality is everyone's job.  

  

This role requires strong executive communication skills, the ability to present complex decisions and trade\-offs to Directors and VPs, and a track record of building scalable programs in matrixed organizations.  

  

This position requires approximately 60% travel within North America to support field quality programs, stakeholder engagement, and program governance. You must be available to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Quality Assurance \& Compliance  

* Define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and compliance frameworks aligned with Amazon's D\&C standards
* Lead quality program governance including audit strategy, inspection protocols, and corrective action frameworks
* Autonomously own and deliver complex quality programs end\-to\-end with limited oversight, making trade\-off decisions independently
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Process Standards, Program Controls, Lifecycle

  

Business Impact and Value  

* Define success metrics and KPIs; monitor performance and drive corrective actions
* Manage program interdependencies, risks, and resource allocation across concurrent initiatives
* Lead development and alignment of process standards across all Miles within GES
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure process adherence, measure effectiveness, and drive continuous refinement

  

Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration  

* Lead cross\-functional alignment across Preconstruction, Construction, Design, and external partners
* Influence without authority to drive quality adoption and behavioral change across the organization

  

Communication \& Reporting  

* Create executive\-level dashboards, reports, and narratives that connect quality outcomes to business value
* Translate complex quality data into compelling stories that drive organizational action

  

Process Improvement, Best Practices \& People Development  

* Identify and drive systemic improvements that eliminate waste, reduce defects, and accelerate delivery across the D\&C lifecycle
* Develop best practice frameworks, playbooks, and toolkits that enable consistent quality delivery at scale

  

A day in the life  

As a Senior Program Manager on the QMT, you are a strategic program leader who drives quality outcomes at scale. Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. A typical day might include:  

* Leading a cross\-functional governance review on implementation progress across Miles
* Presenting quality program performance and strategic recommendations
* Analyzing program data to identify systemic quality trends and developing improvement proposals
* Facilitating alignment between D\&C Execution Teams and partner organizations on process standards
* Driving improvement cycle from root cause analysis through solution implementation
* Participating in a QMT strategy session to shape the team's long\-term roadmap

  

About the team  

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design \& Construction is a diverse, collaborative team committed to delivering Amazon's logistics infrastructure with the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability. The Quality Management Team provides comprehensive quality assurance and control services to D\&C Execution Teams throughout North America, ensuring consistent project delivery from initial design through warranty walk. We believe quality is everyone's job and operate under four governance tenets: Simplify to Scale, Build Trust Through Transparency, Think Big Start Small, and Quality is Everyone's Job.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling

**Technology – Deep ERP technical knowledge with project management**  

  

**Job Description**  

  

1\. The Cutover Manager is responsible for the successful planning, execution, and monitoring of the transition from legacy systems to new systems (go\-live).
  

2\. This role acts as the central point of command during the critical cutover period, ensuring that business operations experience minimal disruption.
  

3\. The ideal candidate will orchestrate technical, functional, and business teams to execute detailed cutover runbooks, manage risks, and facilitate a smooth handover to production support.  

  

**Your Role**  

  

1\. Strategy \& Planning: Define the overarching cutover strategy, including downtime windows, data migration alignment, and business readiness criteria.  

2\. Runbook Development: Build, maintain, and own the master Cutover Runbook—a minute\-by\-minute project plan detailing every task, dependency, owner, and timeline required for the system transition.  

3\. Mock Cutovers: Plan and direct trial runs (mock cutovers) to rigorously test the runbook, identify technical or logistical bottlenecks, and refine task durations prior to the actual go\-live.  

4\. Contingency Planning: Develop comprehensive fallback, contingency, and rollback plans to mitigate risks during the cutover window.  

5\. Command Center Leadership: Direct the cutover "War Room" during the go\-live event (which may include weekends or after\-hours work), coordinating activities across IT infrastructure, data migration, QA, and business teams.  

6\. Issue Resolution: Act as the primary escalation point for any defects or delays during the cutover, driving rapid troubleshooting and executive decision\-making to keep the project on track.  

7\. Hypercare \& Handover: Oversee the immediate post\-go\-live support period (hypercare) and facilitate the formal handover of the system to the operational IT support and maintenance teams.  

Required  

  

1\. Experience in project management, with a minimum of few years specifically acting as a Cutover Manager or Cutover Lead on large\-scale enterprise system implementations.  

2\. Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), data migration dependencies, testing phases, and IT infrastructure.  

3\. Tools: Advanced proficiency with project management and scheduling tools (e.g., MS Project, Excel, Jira, Smartsheet).  

4\. Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business terms for executive stakeholders.  

5\. Temperament: Proven ability to remain calm, focused, and decisive in high\-pressure, time\-sensitive environments.  

  

**Preferred**  

  

1\. Certifications: Active PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or Agile certifications.  

2\. System Experience: Prior experience managing cutovers for specific tier\-1 enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP).  

3\. Industry Knowledge: Experience working within \[Food and Beverages], understanding its specific regulatory and operational constraints.  

4\. Change Management: Familiarity with organizational change management (OCM) principles to better align user adoption with system readiness.  

  

**About Infosys:**  

  

Infosys is a global leader in next\-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 59 countries to navigate their digital transformation.  

  

With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer clients, in 59 countries, as they navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and AI. We enable them with an AI\-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always\-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. We are deeply committed to being a well\-governed, environmentally sustainable organization where diverse talent thrives in an inclusive workplace.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Quality, GES NA Quality (Design & Construction)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You are a Senior Program Manager within the Design \& Construction (D\&C) Quality Management Team (QMT), part of Global Engineering Services (GES) North America. In this role, you serve as a senior quality program leader, autonomously driving the strategy, development, and execution of quality management programs that span the full D\&C project lifecycle across Amazon's logistics network.  

  

You independently own and deliver complex, cross\-functional quality programs—from Quality Management System (QMS) implementation to continuous improvement initiatives—with limited oversight. You operate as a trusted advisor to D\&C Execution Teams and Regional Leadership, providing strategic guidance on quality frameworks, process optimization, and data\-driven decision\-making. Your work directly influences how Amazon delivers construction projects at scale.  

  

Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. You develop program roadmaps, lead cross\-functional initiatives, make trade\-off decisions, and drive organizational alignment across multiple stakeholder groups. You are expected to influence without authority, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and deliver measurable business outcomes through quality programs.  

  

You bring deep expertise in program management, quality systems, and continuous improvement methodologies. You contribute to team strategy, and represent the QMT in senior leadership forums. You are a systems thinker who connects quality outcomes to business value and champions a culture where quality is everyone's job.  

  

This role requires strong executive communication skills, the ability to present complex decisions and trade\-offs to Directors and VPs, and a track record of building scalable programs in matrixed organizations.  

  

This position requires approximately 60% travel within North America to support field quality programs, stakeholder engagement, and program governance. You must be available to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Quality Assurance \& Compliance  

* Define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and compliance frameworks aligned with Amazon's D\&C standards
* Lead quality program governance including audit strategy, inspection protocols, and corrective action frameworks
* Autonomously own and deliver complex quality programs end\-to\-end with limited oversight, making trade\-off decisions independently
* Lead cross\-functional initiatives spanning Process Standards, Program Controls, Lifecycle

  

Business Impact and Value  

* Define success metrics and KPIs; monitor performance and drive corrective actions
* Manage program interdependencies, risks, and resource allocation across concurrent initiatives
* Lead development and alignment of process standards across all Miles within GES
* Establish governance mechanisms to ensure process adherence, measure effectiveness, and drive continuous refinement

  

Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration  

* Lead cross\-functional alignment across Preconstruction, Construction, Design, and external partners
* Influence without authority to drive quality adoption and behavioral change across the organization

  

Communication \& Reporting  

* Create executive\-level dashboards, reports, and narratives that connect quality outcomes to business value
* Translate complex quality data into compelling stories that drive organizational action

  

Process Improvement, Best Practices \& People Development  

* Identify and drive systemic improvements that eliminate waste, reduce defects, and accelerate delivery across the D\&C lifecycle
* Develop best practice frameworks, playbooks, and toolkits that enable consistent quality delivery at scale

  

A day in the life  

As a Senior Program Manager on the QMT, you are a strategic program leader who drives quality outcomes at scale. Your work is approximately 60% tactical and 40% strategic. A typical day might include:  

* Leading a cross\-functional governance review on implementation progress across Miles
* Presenting quality program performance and strategic recommendations
* Analyzing program data to identify systemic quality trends and developing improvement proposals
* Facilitating alignment between D\&C Execution Teams and partner organizations on process standards
* Driving improvement cycle from root cause analysis through solution implementation
* Participating in a QMT strategy session to shape the team's long\-term roadmap

  

About the team  

Global Engineering Services (GES) North America Design \& Construction is a diverse, collaborative team committed to delivering Amazon's logistics infrastructure with the highest standards of safety, quality, and sustainability. The Quality Management Team provides comprehensive quality assurance and control services to D\&C Execution Teams throughout North America, ensuring consistent project delivery from initial design through warranty walk. ------------------------

* 7\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling

* Comfortable with campaign\-speed execution — whether that background comes from politic
