jobs.title: Research Data Analyst 2
jobs.description:
Job Description

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to manage and analyze large amounts of information, typically technical or scientific in nature, independently with minimal supervision.

Stanford University is one of the world’s most renowned universities. Sitting in the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area among the valley’s most progressive companies.

You will be working with an unparalleled leading-edge community of faculty and staff that are fundamentally changing the world of health care. You will have the opportunity to influence and drive change with your innovative ideas, the ability to make a difference and participate in human advancements. Our culture is fast-paced, energetic, and growing all of the time.

We offer a variety of benefits beyond traditional medical, dental, retirement, and savings options:

Events and program for children, sports camps, tuition options
World-class intellectual stimulation through learning and development classes, workshops, and onsite conferences from leading-edge speakers and faculty
Work/life and family-friendly policies and reimbursement
Participation in Stanford’s social responsibility and sustainable programs for a better world
A vibrant university culture that values the uniqueness of each individual

We are seeking candidates who are progressive thinkers, see challenges as simply problems to solve, and have the spirit and energy to change the world.

About The Department Of Pathology

The Department of Pathology at Stanford School of Medicine, one of its founding departments, stands as a leader among its peers nationwide. Our preeminent faculty spans from emerging leaders to highly accomplished physicians and scientists, including a Nobel laureate and members of the National Academy. Our mission is to improve the diagnosis, treatment, and basic understanding of the human disease. This is done through discovery (research), education, and clinical care. Comprised of extraordinary faculty and staff, our mission is to improve the ability to diagnose, treat and understand the origin and

manifestation of human disease, and to care for those who have or are at risk to develop disease. We accomplish this through our clinical services (in all fields of anatomic and clinical pathology, including molecular and genomic pathology, histocompatibility testing and transfusion medicine) and be research (which includes basic, translational and clinical research into the origins and manifestations of disease, including efforts to improve disease prediction and prevention as part of the goal of achieving precision medicine and health), and also by educating future leaders in pathology and related fields. Everything we do is to achieve the goals of providing the highest quality of clinical services to the patients for whom we passionately care, to advance our ability to understand, diagnose, monitor and ultimately to cure disease or to prevent or delay its occurrence, and to provide outstanding education and career development opportunities to those who share these goals.

For more information about the department visit http://pathology.stanford.edu/

About The Lab

The Research Data Analyst 2 will be working within the Stanford Pathology EMERALD (Enhancing Medical Excellence via Research in Advanced Laboratory Diagnostics) Program. EMERALD is engaged in diagnostics research and novel test development with the goal of rapid deployment in the clinical laboratories.

About The Position

Stanford University is seeking a Research Data Analyst 2 to join our comprehensive cancer genomics program. The RDA2 will be involved in the development and application of bioinformatic tools for the analysis of oncology-related sequencing data including, but not limited to, whole exome, whole genome, and whole transcriptome data from solid tumor and hematopoietic cell malignancies. The RDA2 will also support the implementation of distributed pipeline architectures for medical NGS data analysis. The emphasis is on clinical grade quality, scalability and maintainability in an in-house cluster or cloud environment.

Duties Include

Prioritize and extract data from a variety of sources such as notes, survey results, medical reports, and laboratory data, and maintain its accuracy and completeness.
Determine additional data collection and reporting requirements.
Design and customize reports based upon data in the database. Oversee and monitor regulatory compliance for utilization of the data.
Use system reports and analyses to identify potentially problematic data, make corrections, and eliminate root cause for data problems or justify solutions to be implemented by others.
Create complex charts and databases, perform statistical analyses, and develop graphs and tables for publication and presentation.
Serve as a resource for non-routine inquiries such as requests for statistics or surveys.
Test prototype software and participate in approval and release process for new software.
Provide documentation based on audit and reporting criteria to investigators and research staff.
Analyze sequencing data generated as part of the comprehensive cancer genomics program.
- Other duties may also be assigned

Physical Requirements*:

Sitting in place at computer for long periods of time with extensive keyboarding/dexterity.
Occasionally use a telephone.
Rarely writing by hand.
- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.

Working Conditions

Due to the nature of the work, this position will be hybrid

jobs.title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That’s why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you’ll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

Drive strategic and operational analysis. Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior. Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities. Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions. Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication. Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

Work Authorization

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager IRC302098
jobs.description:
Description

The Technical Release Manager / Technical Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, governance, coordination, and execution of technical programs and production releases for the Omnichannel Engagement Platform (OEP). This role ensures engineering initiatives are thoroughly planned, coordinated, governed, and communicated from initiation through production deployment.

The position serves as the central point of coordination across engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external partners to drive alignment, manage dependencies, facilitate decision-making, and ensure successful execution.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional program and release management skills with strong technical acumen. While not expected to design or develop software, they must possess sufficient technical understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, validate implementation and testing strategies, identify gaps in technical plans, and proactively manage delivery risks before they impact execution.

Requirements

– 8+ years of technical program management, technical project management, or release management supporting enterprise software platforms.

– Experience leading complex software delivery programs with multiple workstreams, dependencies, and cross-functional teams.

– Proven experience managing production releases and coordinating large-scale implementation activities.

– Strong understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC, Azure DevOps (ADO), release governance, and production implementation planning.

– Working knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and modern software engineering practices sufficient to effectively challenge assumptions and validate engineering plans.

– Experience preparing executive-level communications, dashboards, presentations, and delivery status updates for Director- and VP-level leadership.

– Demonstrated success managing risks, issues, dependencies, critical path activities, and executive escalations.

– Experience coordinating engineering leadership, functional tower leads, operations, and external delivery partners.

Job responsibilities

Program & Project Management

– Lead end-to-end planning, coordination, and governance of technical programs and production releases.

– Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, critical path activities, and delivery schedules.

– Coordinate cross-functional workstreams to ensure alignment with committed milestones and release objectives.

– Monitor overall program health and proactively address issues that may impact delivery.

Technical Planning & Release Management

– Partner with engineering leadership, functional tower leads, and external partners to translate technical solutions into executable implementation plans.

– Review implementation plans for completeness, sequencing, validation activities, dependencies, rollback procedures, operational readiness, and production support requirements.

– Consolidate implementation activities into Azure DevOps (ADO) work items, release documentation, implementation plans, release notes, and operational runbooks.

– Challenge technical plans when implementation details, validation activities, or dependencies are incomplete or introduce unnecessary delivery risk.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

– Proactively identify technical, operational, and program risks before they impact delivery.

– Manage cross-team dependencies and critical path activities across multiple concurrent initiatives.

– Drive mitigation planning, issue resolution, and executive escalation as appropriate.

– Provide leadership with clear recommendations, business impacts, and decision points rather than simply reporting status.

Executive Communication & Governance

– Prepare concise executive-level status reports, dashboards, presentations, and release readiness updates.

– Translate complex technical initiatives into clear business outcomes, delivery confidence, milestones, risks, and recommended actions.

– Present program health, implementation readiness, RAID items, delivery forecasts, and strategic recommendations to Directors, VPs, and senior leadership.

Cross-Functional Leadership

– Coordinate activities across engineering leadership, QA, DevOps, Requirements, Operations, and external partners.

– Build trusted relationships that promote accountability, transparency, collaboration, and timely decision-making.

– Influence without direct authority while driving alignment across multiple organizations and workstreams.

Partner & Vendor Management

– Coordinate delivery across multiple external engineering partners.

– Drive accountability for partner commitments, timelines, quality, and delivery execution.

– Facilitate issue resolution, resource coordination, and executive escalations when necessary.

– Foster a collaborative, one-team delivery culture across client and partner organizations.

Continuous Improvement

– Identify opportunities to improve release governance, delivery planning, operational readiness, and execution maturity.

– Drive improvements to release documentation, implementation quality, and engineering delivery processes.

– Promote best practices that improve delivery predictability, operational excellence, and production stability.

GlobalLogic estimates the starting pay range for this role to be performed remotely in Canada is $140,000 CAD to $155,000 CAD and reflects base salary only. This pay range is provided as a good faith estimate and the amount offered may be higher or lower. GlobalLogic takes many factors into consideration in making an offer, including candidate qualifications, work experience, operational needs, travel and onsite requirements, internal peer equity, prevailing wage, responsibilities, and other market and business considerations.

What we offer

Exciting Projects:

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Initiate, plan, monitor the execution and close the projects you have in charge. This includes but is not limited to project schedules and budgets, plans for project quality, resources, communication, and risks, etc.
Work with the project team to understand and track progress and the quality of work being performed.
Responsible for working for the project team to identify and address critical path or roadblock issues and develop mitigation plans accordingly.
Responsible for the communication of project status to all project stakeholders. Communication includes project meeting minutes, performance to the project plan, project risks, kick-off and post-mortem reports, and any status or project detail information needed daily.
Communicate ideas for improving company processes with a positive and constructive attitude, and for developing this attitude in others.
Ensure Agile framework and Project Management processes are being followed by the team and guarantee its overall understanding.
Promote empowerment of teams, ensuring that each team member is fully engaged in the project making a meaningful contribution while encouraging a sustainable pace.
Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame, retribution, or being judged, with an emphasis of healing and problem-solving.
Enhance and evolve the organization's overall Project Management framework and practices.
Partner with Product Owners in refining and grooming the projects and events scope to a level that is acceptable to estimate the level of effort and to deliver.
Support the Product Owner in managing customer expectations for project deliverables, managing stakeholders’ communications, and helping to implement an effective system of project governance.

Qualifications

Fluent English is mandatory.
2+ years working in a Project Management discipline in a Software Development Life Cycle environment.
2+ years experience in Agile framework projects. PMP Certification is a significant plus.
Proficient knowledge of Project Management tools, Jira and BigPicture a plus.
Experience in coaching Product Owners and Development team(s) about Project Management practices.

Additional Notes:
You may be expected to complete a test as part of the interviewing procedure.

Benefits and Perks

Global Collaboration:
Work directly with diverse international teams from Singapore, Israel, the US, and more.
People‑centered Culture:
Where individual effort, shared dedication, and true teamwork come together to craft games of outstanding creativity, aesthetic value, and entertainment quality.
Growth & Learning
: Unlock unlimited growth opportunities through English classes, an online learning platform, specialized technical training led by global experts, and the opportunity to have hands-on experience with game products reaching up to 100 million players worldwide.
Comprehensive Healthcare
: Receive Bao Viet Premium healthcare coverage of up to 1.2 billion VND/person/year for yourself, plus attractive coverage for all your dependents.
Insurance & PIT
(Personal Income Tax):
Receive 100% salary during probation, with full Social, Health, and Unemployment Insurance from day one
. All compulsory insurance is fully covered by the company — you only contribute Personal Income Tax.
Reward & Recognition
: 13-month salary/year; performance-based bonus; discretionary bonus; attractive employee referral bonus program.
Flexible work time
: Work Monday to Friday with two remote days (Tuesday and Wednesday). No attendance tracking — we focus on performance management rather than time management.
Annual & Sick Leave:
Annual leave of 15 days in the 1st year, 17 days in the 2nd year, and 20 days from the 3rd year onwards, plus 5 days of sick leave per year.
Perks & Comforts
: Fresh, delicious, free meals served daily; high-end workstation with laptop and monitors provided; and an equipment allowance of 4,500,000 VND to choose your preferred keyboard, mouse, headset, and more.
Engagement:
Enjoy charity initiatives, team-building, company trips, year-round events, and company-supported clubs like board games, badminton, soccer, and ping pong.

: Financial support for sickness or funeral (up to 2,000,000 VND/person), and for birthdays, marriage, childbirth, or public holidays (up to 500,000 VND/person).

At Browning Day, our portfolio spans a broad range of project types within civic, cultural, healthcare, higher education, faith-based, hospitality, mixed-use, preservation and reuse, sports and wellness, and the workplace. Our success is based on the client's vision coming to life and includes a team of Architects, Interior Designers, Landscape Architects, and support staff who solve complex design problems. We are seeking a Project Manager
who will add their skills and creativity to our diverse projects.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The role will manage project schedules, staffing, fee development, financial performance, contractual compliance, documentation, client interaction, consultant oversight, overall project administration, and lead the production team.
Integral in guiding the internal team and external consultants working toward the common goal.
Mentor team members and assist in staff performance evaluations.
Support focused marketing and business development initiatives.
Provide regular status updates to the Studio Director and Principal-in-Charge.
Conduct programming efforts, including information gathering, site/building analysis, and site/building inventory of existing conditions, identifying opportunities and constraints.
Forecast and adjust staffing needs to meet project scope.
Ensure documentation and timely distribution of all meeting notes to the project teams.
Incorporate and consider sustainable design solutions into all projects.
Coordinate QA/QC and design reviews at each project phase.
Oversee the construction administration phase, responding to RFIs, ASIs, shop drawings, field site reviews, and reports.
Lead project teams in all stages of the project, from planning and concept design to construction documents and site visits.
Partner with Human Resources (HR) on performance management of team members, emerging leaders, recruiting, training, and onboarding new hires.
Incorporates and considers sustainable design solutions into all projects.
Responsibilities vary based on experience, interests, and business needs
Other tasks as assigned

Browning Day provides reasonable accommodation to individuals in accordance with federal, state, and local law.

Passion for the industry and leading teams toward a common goal.
Foster mutual trust and confidence by developing solid relationships (internal and external).
Advanced creative talent in the communication of complex design concepts.
Advanced skill in prioritizing multiple tasks/projects for the teams in a fast-paced environment to meet deadlines and provide high-quality service to clients.
Ability to solve problems, specifically interpreting multiple stakeholders' input.
In-depth understanding of or ability to learn leadership and management fundamentals by partnering with HR to ensure compliance with the company’s best practices and policies.
Advanced ability to notice details, review, write, and edit.
Excellent communicator: verbal, written, training, and public speaking.

Site and building regulations and safety/ADA/FHA/zoning code.
Construction methodology and material application
Zoning, codes, ADA/FHA/accessibility requirements, and applicable codes for site design considerations.

MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint);
Scheduling software (Team Gantt);
Sketchup, Revit, AutoCAD, and 3D rendering software (Lumion);
Online project management software.

10-plus years in a related field of Architecture.
Preferred 10+ years of professional experience in architecture, with 5 years in leading projects.
Bachelor's or master's degree in architecture from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience.
Preferred: Licensed Architect or working toward licensure.
Satisfactory completion of a background screening.

Full-time, exempt position with competitive compensation and paid time off.

Company-paid disability (long- and short-term) and life insurance.

Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.

Chance to be a part of a creative and supportive team.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager - InfoSec based in India.

This is a senior technical program leadership role focused on security, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale engineering environments.

You will coordinate complex programs spanning multiple engineering teams, product groups, legal stakeholders, and enterprise commitments.

A key focus will be driving cloud security initiatives, remediation programs, audit readiness, and secure operational practices.

The role combines strong program management with hands-on technical depth, including architecture reviews, production systems, security tooling, and incident analysis.

You will help establish scalable mechanisms for prioritization, intake, launch readiness, and long-term program execution.

The position requires the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, cloud architecture, security data, and modern software development.

Working remotely from India, you will have significant influence on security programs supporting critical experiences at massive scale.

Accountabilities

Lead and coordinate complex technical programs and multiple workstreams across Product Engineering, Security, Legal, and enterprise-facing initiatives.
Own the program management layer for cloud security efforts, including security control rollouts, remediation service-level agreements, governance, and audit readiness.
Build scalable execution mechanisms, including product-style intake processes, prioritization frameworks, program operating rhythms, and launch readiness reviews.
Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Build, Architecture, and leadership teams to drive successful product launches and smooth deprecation of legacy tooling.
Coordinate security programs spanning multiple engineering teams and maintain clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
Participate confidently in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, build documentation reviews, and post-incident debriefs.
Read and reason about production code in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, and Java to effectively engage with engineering teams.
Evaluate cloud infrastructure at the architecture level, with particular focus on AWS security, reliability, scalability, cost, latency, and failure modes.
Directly analyze metrics, logs, dashboards, SIEM data, and service-level objective burn rates to assess security and operational performance.

Develop durable program frameworks, operating mechanisms, documentation, and processes that improve execution consistency across teams.
Coordinate major security incidents when required and help ensure lessons learned are translated into sustainable program improvements.

Requirements

10+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 5 years supporting security, cloud, data platform, infrastructure, or similarly complex technical organizations at scale.
Prior individual contributor engineering experience in software, security, data, SRE, or a comparable technical discipline.
Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple engineering teams, ideally with regular engagement and reporting at Director level or above.

Strong expertise in at least three of the following areas: cloud security and posture management, Kubernetes runtime security, security data pipelines and SIEM, security automation, and SOAR.
Ability to review and challenge technical architecture and build documents, with a strong understanding of distributed systems, latency, efficiency, cost, reliability, and failure modes.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and security architecture, particularly within AWS or comparable cloud environments.
Familiarity with ML- or LLM-integrated products, including training and evaluation pipelines and the technical judgment required to assess production readiness.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical risks into clear program priorities and execution plans.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence engineers, technical leaders, product stakeholders, and executives.
Proven ability to create sustainable program frameworks, mechanisms, and operating processes rather than simply managing individual projects.
A degree in Computer Science or a comparable technical background is an asset.
Experience with major SIEM and SOAR platforms, cloud-provider security services, or Kubernetes-native security tooling is an advantage.
Experience coordinating Sev 1 or Sev 2 incidents is a plus.
Background in data protection, privacy, or Data Loss Prevention (DLP) programs is desirable.

Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.

As a Lead Technical Program Manager in the Commercial & Investment Bank Technology group, you will drive the successful delivery of complex technology projects and programs that will help reaching business goals across the firm. Leveraging your deep knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential for developing innovative solutions, while simultaneously effectively managing resources, budgets, and high-performing teams. Your strong analytical reasoning and adaptability skills will enable you to navigate through ambiguity and change, ensuring that technology initiatives align with business goals. With advanced communication and stakeholder management abilities, you will foster productive working relationships and influence decision-making to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to the development of operational plans and risk management strategies, ensuring the highest quality and professionalism in service delivery.

Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, incorporating technical requirements, resource allocation, and timelines to ensure on-time delivery of technology solutions
Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate program planning and risk synthesis (e.g., consolidating inputs into integrated plans, RAID, and executive-ready updates), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks, proactively addressing potential roadblocks and implementing contingency plans to maintain project and program momentum
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders, to define program scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall business goals
Utilize advanced analytical reasoning to assess program performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement data-driven optimizations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Champion agile delivery practices and continuous improvement, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the team
Promotes reuse-first, AI-assisted practices for program governance and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization
Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
Ability to review and validate AI-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and influence decision-making across cross-functional teams and clients
Proven track record of effectively managing resources, budgets, and high-performing teams in a fast-paced, agile environment
Demonstrated proficiency in applying analytical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to break down business, technical, or operational objectives into manageable tasks and activities

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Experience generating dashboards, implementing automation, building necessary tools to automate processes
Knowledge of SDLC and the infrastructure behind it

Morgan and Chase brands. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a seasoned professional to serve as a Technical Project Manager
(TPM). This position is based in Houston. The TPM is an exciting role that supports overarching project planning, scheduling, coordination, management, and execution in support of the U.S. Navy’s launch test facilities Research and Development (R&D) program. This R&D program is a top priority for our nation and supports both U.S. Navy Submarine and Surface Ship weapons system capability testing.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead cradle-to-grave engineering project planning, management, and execution in support of U.S. Navy Submarine and Surface Ship weapons systems.
Lead planning and execution of a quick-turn design-build-certify-integrate projects.
Develop and maintain the integrated project plans, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, procurement, design maturity, test readiness, certification, delivery, and integration milestones.
Coordinate project execution across mechanical design, drafting, electrical design, data acquisition, project engineering, systems engineering, test, safety/certification, and customer stakeholders.
Drive early definition and closure of project fundamentals, including team structure, funding path, interface ownership, technical authority path, certification approach, minimum viable test program, and delivery expectations.
Establish and manage the project's critical path, with particular focus on design maturity, long-lead procurements, instrumentation/DAQ approach, fabrication lead times, and integration readiness.
Lead regular project status reviews, risk reviews, action tracking, interface coordination, and decision forums.
Manage technical, schedule, cost, and interface risks associated with changing suit design data, uncertain environments, and late-breaking certification or integration requirements.
Ensure project documentation, design artifacts, certification products, interface agreements, risk posture, and delivery records are maintained at an appropriate level.
Escalate issues early when technical uncertainty, resource gaps, funding delays, or external interface dependencies threaten the project's ability to meet delivery and integration commitments.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Management, Project Management or closely related technical field. Minimum (12) years of experience in U.S. Navy weapon system engineering project management may be substituted in lieu of degree requirements.
Minimum (8) years leading technical projects involving hardware design, build, test, certification, and delivery.
Experience managing rapid-turn or schedule-constrained aerospace, defense, flight hardware, test article, ground support equipment, or vehicle integration projects.
Strong technical literacy across mechanical design, electrical/avionics interfaces, instrumentation, test planning, hardware certification, and integrated system delivery.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through ambiguous early project definition while maintaining execution momentum.
Experience building and maintaining integrated schedules, risk registers, action trackers, staffing plans, and project status products for technical leadership and customer stakeholders.
Ability to manage interface-heavy projects involving multiple organizations, evolving requirements, and external customer dependencies.
Experience coordinating design reviews, test readiness reviews, certification readiness, hardware delivery, and integration planning.
Ability to identify when a project requires systems engineering discipline, project engineering ownership, formal requirements closure, or additional technical authority engagement.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical uncertainty into clear schedule, cost, risk, and decision impacts.
Demonstrated ability to operate with urgency while preserving sound engineering judgment and disciplined configuration control.

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Management, Project Management or closely related technical field.
Minimum (12) years of experience in U.S. Navy weapon system project management to include Vertical Launching Systems (VLS), Trident Missile Systems, and SSGN weapons systems.
Experience supporting flight hardware, flight-like test articles, mass simulators, structural test articles, payload integration, or instrumented hardware.
Experience coordinating data acquisition, telemetry, and instrumentation.
Experience working with various industry engineering organizations and/or federal customers.
Experience managing projects with compressed execution windows, evolving requirements, and coordinated requirements.
Experience leading teams where design, procurement, test, certification, and integration activities must overlap due to schedule constraints.

Security and Clearance:

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S government security clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a U.S government security clearance.

Work Environment:

This position is based in Houston, TX. Significant responsibilities/work is performed at the two primary test sites (China Lake, CA and Crane, IN). Travel expected is approximately 50% of working time and is typically planned in advance.
The role involves both office-based project management and hands-on field activities, requiring the ability to work in varied environments including industrial, laboratory, fabrication, test-site, and outdoor settings. The candidate must be comfortable supporting hardware across the lifecycle, including installation, checkout, troubleshooting, test, sustainment, documentation update, and configuration reconciliation.

Compensation Details:

140,000.00

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off and holidays
Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)
Educational reimbursement
Parental leave
Employee stock purchase plan

Disability and life insurance
Pet insurance

jobs.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Summary Of Role

To further strengthen our Chip-to-Package Interaction (CPI) team, we are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Qualification Project Manager with a strong background in semiconductor technology development, project management, post-fab technologies (bumping, assembly, and package-level testing), BEOL integration fundamentals, and reliability qualification methodologies.

In this role, you will lead CPI qualification programs from concept through qualification and technology release, working closely with global, cross-functional teams including technology development, design, reliability engineering, manufacturing, and external assembly and test partners (OSATs). You will play a key role in enabling next-generation semiconductor packaging solutions and advanced technology platforms.

The position is based at GlobalFoundries' facility in Malta, New York.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end CPI qualification projects supporting Technology Development Programs, including:

Define CPI qualification strategies, scope, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria in alignment with technology development objectives.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, resource forecasts, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful program execution.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams across Technology Development, Design, Reliability Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners.
Support the selection and management of outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) partners to ensure timely delivery of qualification objectives.
Drive test vehicle planning, design definition, and qualification vehicle implementation in support of program requirements.
Define reliability qualification plans, test structures, characterization requirements, and data collection strategies to assess CPI performance and robustness.
Track project progress, qualification metrics, reliability results, budgets, and schedules, ensuring achievement of technical, quality, cost, and timeline objectives.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, technical challenges, and schedule impacts, and drive appropriate escalation and resolution.
Lead technical and program reviews, facilitate cross-functional decision-making, and ensure alignment on qualification strategies and program priorities.
Drive milestone readiness assessments and lead qualification reviews to support technology and product release decisions.
Support customer engagements by communicating qualification strategies, project status, reliability results, and technology readiness.
Prepare and present project updates, technical recommendations, risk assessments, and executive summaries to management, customers, and external stakeholders.
Establish effective communication and collaboration across global teams and partner organizations to ensure successful project execution.

Other Responsibilities

Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a background in technology development, packaging, assembly, reliability engineering, qualification, or related areas.
Proven success leading complex, cross-functional technical projects from concept through qualification and technology release.
Strong knowledge of semiconductor packaging and post-fab technologies, including bumping, assembly, package-level testing, and OSAT operations.
Solid understanding of BEOL process integration, chip-to-package interactions, and semiconductor reliability qualification methodologies.
Experience defining qualification plans, test structures, characterization requirements, and technology readiness assessments.
Demonstrated project management experience, including schedule, budget, resource, and risk management.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively influence and coordinate global teams and external partners.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic technology development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with packaging technologies such as wirebond, flip-chip, wafer-level packaging (WLP), 2.5D/3D integration, TSVs, silicon interposers, or chiplet-based solutions.
Knowledge of industry qualification and reliability standards, including JEDEC and AEC-Q100.
Experience working with customers, OSATs, and external technology partners.
Experience supporting Technology Development and Technology Qualifications.
PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification.
Experience working in a global semiconductor manufacturing environment.

$98,000.00 - $176,000.00

The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location.

The Security Operations Manager II
will oversee delivery of physical security services for QTS data center security operations, including oversight of contract guard operations, alarm investigations and incident reporting, and coordination with regional security disciplinary specialists on projects, expansions, and other security-related efforts. This role is responsible for providing a visual security presence to ensure visitors, clients, and employees have a safe and pleasant experience while providing excellent customer service to all individuals that enter the facility and further employee/management relations, goodwill, and public relations to keep our customers for life.

RESPONSIBILITIES, Other Duties May Be Assigned.

Supervise frontline security staff and daily security operations to provide a safe experience for all who enter the facility.
Manage security operations for a single or multi-building campus, or mega data center.
Participate in project estimating processes as well as contribute to others budgeting processes for physical security system needs in other groups. 
Oversee security projects to ensure they are delivered in accordance with established baseline requirements and deadlines and within budget. 
Maintain close coordination with security vendor management to ensure continuous improvement of security team skills through targeted training, practical exercises, and the documentation and application of lessons learned.
Interface with, and assist in, mobilizing vendors involved in system repairs for current sites.
Manage security for construction projects and new builds.
Develop and Implement security procedures and protocols to ensure the safety of employees, visitors, and assets.
Evaluate and drive continuous improvement of contract guard operations using key performance indicators, collaborative improvement plans, conducting training and leading security briefing for contractor and sub-contractor personnel to ensure great customer service in all Security interactions.
Ensure the Security Department is following all proper protocols, including monitoring the cameras, fire alarms, physical patrolling, recognition of items for proper written documentation of all security-related incidents, dispatching, and completing various logs/files daily.
Verify Data Center security programs are delivered to meet defined corporate security standards.
Assume 24/7/365 availability to respond to and manage appropriately all requests for emergency and non-emergency assistance in a professional manner.
Managing the process of bringing on new contract security staff for sites under construction
Ensure all security systems are fully functional to include Access Control, Visitor Management, Service Now, and CCTV.
Conduct Regular Risk Assessments to identify potential security vulnerabilities and develop strategies to mitigate risks.
Create, assign, and issue facility access badges to authorized personnel.
Investigate accidents, thefts, disturbances, and discrepancies and provide appropriate and timely notifications to required parties.
Knowledge and familiarization with all emergency response plans and evacuation procedures including conducting fire evacuation and Business Continuity drills.
Confirm all security equipment is kept in excellent working condition through regular inspection and by following QTS preventative maintenance programs.
Develop and maintain working relationships with Federal, State, and Local Law Enforcement as well as Fire and EMS services.
Generate reports and prepare presentations on the status of physical security operations and be able to deliver presentations and briefings to customers, stakeholders, and senior leaders.
Provides reports as needed for internal and external audits and investigations.
Serve as a customer advocate by identifying security-related opportunities and crafting innovative solutions that maintain uncompromising security standards.
Perform security officer duties as needed to ensure efficient operations and guest service standards are met.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years working in an operational, physical security. or equivalent environment.
5+ years of experience in security patrolling and reporting.
3+ years of experience in dealing with security vendors, contractors, and customers.
2+ years project management experience.
Bachelor's degree or five or more years working in an operations, physical security or equivalent environment or associate degree or three or more years’ experience working in an operational, physical security, or equivalent environment.
Must be able to travel up to 10% including the ability to travel to other sites to provide training and support as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of Security-related management and leadership experience
3+ years of experience in access control and video surveillance software applications (ex. ProWatch & Genetec)
3+ years of experience working in a facility and observing security gaps in physical barriers, security officer procedure, policies, surveillance equipment, and alarm points.
3+ years of experience driving campaigns to reduce nuisance alarms.
3+ years of experience influencing others in helping to achieve security excellence goals in a corporate environment.
3+ years of experience with excellent verbal and written communications skills in a professional work setting.
3+ years of overseeing security sub-contractors that provide guards, electronic security systems, door construction, door repair, fencing, and access controls.
2+ years of experience overseeing security construction projects.
2+ years of experience teaching others the proper security processes and methods.
Military Background or prior Law Enforcement experience desired.
Active Security Credentials (ASIS - Management Security, etc.).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Proficient with computer skills including Microsoft Office suite.
Proficient in Access Control Systems and related software.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing; for the purpose of public interaction and report writing. Have excellent customer service skills.
Ability to handle typical emergency and crisis situations efficiently and effectively.
Ability to walk, stand, or sit for at least eight hours.
Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching, and lifting. Lifting requirements may range from 10 lbs. – 50 lbs. on a regular basis with heavier weights done in conjunction with other individuals or lifting aids.
May require 24x7x365 on call responsibilities.
This role requires on-site work hours to support a 24X7X365 data center environment and is not eligible for remote and/or hybrid work.

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

This position is Bonus eligible.

jobs.description:
Position

Regional Security Manager, Mexico

Job Description

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.

A Fortune 148 company with 22,00 employees worldwide, Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial, and consumer electronics. Arrow provides specialized services and expertise across the entire product lifecycle. Arrow does this by connecting customers to the right technology at the right place, time, and price. Arrow provides extraordinary value to customers and suppliers - the best technology companies in the world - and connects them through the company's industry-leading services.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Director of Global Physical Security, the Regional Security Manager, Mexico
leads physical security operations, risk mitigation, vendor performance, and investigations across all Arrow locations in Mexico. Based onsite in Zapopan, Jalisco, this role builds strategic programs, manages contract guard forces and security tech, and leverages strong networks with local law enforcement and private security partners to protect employees, facilities, and business operations. Domestic travel and availability for off-hours crisis response are required.

What You’ll Be Doing

Security Operations & Program Management

Provide oversight and management of all contract guard services throughout Mexico.
Provide oversight and management of physical security projects throughout Mexico, including security system installations, upgrades, maintenance, and repairs.
Manage security integrators and vendors to ensure compliance with local laws, company standards, project timelines, and budget requirements.
Utilize intelligence and analytics to enable informed decision-making and enhance Arrow’s overall security environment.
Support the Director of Global Physical Security in investigations, security incidents, executive protection activities, and other security initiatives as required.
Support investigations and ensure proper evidence collection, handling, documentation, and case development when appropriate.
Partner with Human Resources, Legal, and business leaders on threat assessments and case management.
Promote awareness, education, and training programs designed to enhance employee safety and preparedness.

Law Enforcement and Private Sector Engagement

Serve as the primary liaison between Arrow Electronics and law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, private-sector security partners, and relevant industry security networks in Mexico.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with external security organizations and industry associations in Mexico.
Coordinate security-related communications and response activities during critical incidents and emergencies.

What We Are Looking For

Professional Experience

Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in corporate security, physical security, law enforcement, investigations, threat assessment, or a related security discipline, including at least 3 years managing security operations across multiple sites or regions, with demonstrated responsibility for protecting people, facilities, assets, and business operations.
Demonstrated experience managing physical security operations across multiple sites, including guard force oversight, incident response coordination, vendor management, security technology support, and site-level risk mitigation.
Knowledge of evidence handling, investigative processes, and case preparation.
Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Experience and/or formal training in interviewing and interrogation techniques.
Proven ability to build effective relationships with law enforcement agencies and external security partners.

Technical Skills

Experience with access control, CCTV, video management systems, intrusion detection, visitor management, incident reporting tools, and integrated physical security technologies.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Proficiency in English is a must.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, business, risk management, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.

What's In It For You

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans, and a solid benefits package.

30 days of Christmas bonus
40% vacation premium
12 vacation days plus 2 floating days, sick days and holidays
Vision and Dental Assistance
Life Insurance
Healthcare Insurance
10% Food/Pantry Vouchers
Restaurant Vouchers
13% Savings Fund
Growth Opportunities, and more!

jobs.description:
We currently have an opportunity for a Project Manager.
Join our Government and Integrated Facilities Management team and play a key role in leading designated projects from conversion and construction through to handover, finalisation and close out. Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, you'll help deliver high-quality outcomes that support our essential services.

What You'll Do

This role offers a broad scope, with key responsibilities including:

Lead and manage designated projects from initiation through delivery, handover and close out.
Establish and maintain project governance frameworks, project controls, reporting, registers and audit trails.
Drive Zero Harm outcomes by implementing project-specific safety systems and promoting safe, healthy and sustainable work environments.
Manage project performance across scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, document control and contractor performance.
Build strong relationships with clients, subcontractors, contractors, consultants and architects to support successful delivery and repeat business.

What You'll Bring

Tertiary qualifications in building, engineering or project management, or a relevant trades background.
Extensive experience in construction roles covering all aspects of project delivery.
Strong understanding of project governance principles, project management methodologies, project controls and reporting.
Demonstrated experience managing contractor performance, procurement processes, contract compliance and contractual risk.
Advanced stakeholder and client relationship management skills, supported by strong people management capability.

More than anything, you'll bring a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes for our clients.

Why Downer?

At Downer, we plan, create, and sustain essential public services across Australia and New Zealand. From hospitals to data centres and defence partnerships, we manage critical infrastructure that keeps communities thriving.

What It Means to Belong at Downer

We're proud of our high-performance culture and commitment to diversity, offering:

Training and development to support and diversify your career.

With 30% of vacancies filled internally you'll find real opportunities to advance your career.

Perks@Downer: healthcare discounts, great savings on retail purchases, car purchases and much more.

Who We Are

Zinfra is a leading partner in the design, build, operation and maintenance of Australia’s energy and utilities infrastructure. Delivering an annual portfolio of more than $1.2 billion, our work helps keep energy flowing safely and reliably to communities across Australia while supporting the nation's energy transition.

With a workforce of more than 2,800 people, we deliver complex infrastructure, asset management and field services across Australia's east coast. Our people draw on deep industry experience, an unwavering commitment to safety, and practical innovation to deliver the right outcomes for our clients and communities.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Power Services business and lead the delivery of critical electricity infrastructure projects across Victoria. With a strong program of work planned for 2026, including line and feeder upgrades, underground network construction and potential zone substation projects, this role offers the opportunity to shape essential energy infrastructure that supports growing communities and network reliability.

Operating in a fast-paced, safety-critical environment, you'll be trusted to make sound decisions, manage competing priorities and lead project teams through complex delivery challenges. Working closely with clients, contractors and internal stakeholders, you'll be accountable for delivering projects safely, on time and within budget while maintaining strong governance and commercial outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of electricity infrastructure projects, ensuring safe, efficient and commercially successful outcomes.
Drive a strong safety culture through visible leadership, risk management and compliance with Zinfra's health, safety and environmental standards.
Oversee project governance, including planning, change management, stakeholder engagement, reporting and project close-out activities.
Manage project schedules, costs, resources and performance to deliver agreed client and business objectives.
Build strong relationships with clients, delivery partners and internal teams to successfully navigate complex operational and project environments.

About You

You're an experienced project leader who combines technical credibility with practical problem-solving and sound commercial judgement. You thrive in complex operational environments, remain calm under pressure and take ownership of outcomes. You're collaborative, resilient and capable of making decisions that balance safety, customer, commercial and delivery requirements.

To Be Successful, You Will Bring

Demonstrated project management experience delivering engineering, construction or utility infrastructure projects, ideally within the electricity or energy sector.
A Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent technical qualification, supported by a strong understanding of engineering and construction delivery.
Experience applying recognised project management methodologies, with proven capability in risk management, contract administration and project governance.
Strong commercial and stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging with clients, contractors and senior leadership teams.
A commitment to accountability, safety leadership and continuous improvement, with the ability to lead teams through complex project challenges.

Why Work With Us

What we do matters. Delivering safe and reliable energy makes a difference to people's lives across Australia every day. We are proud to keep communities connected while preparing the nation for a renewable future.

This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team delivering critical infrastructure projects that support Australia's energy transition. You'll have the autonomy to lead meaningful work while building your career within a business committed to professional development, succession planning and long-term career growth.

Flexible and hybrid working arrangements where role requirements allow.
Recognition and reward opportunities through our Incentivise program.
Paid parental leave and family-friendly workplace benefits.

We know Zinfra is a great place to belong, but don't just take our word for it. Hear directly from our people about what it's like to build a career, make an impact and be part of the team at Zinfra.

Zinfra does not accept unsolicited resumes, or liability associated with fees or costs, from recruitment agencies, search firms or other third parties. Interested candidates are welcome to submit their application independently.

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To Win, We Focus Relentlessly On:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

The Enterprise Customer Implementation Team at Gorgias works with our highest GMV merchants. Each implementation is truly custom based on the merchant’s business processes, procedures, and workflows. The team is successful when launches occur on time and merchants are promoters of Gorgias at the end of their implementation - excited to continue their customer journey with us.

Specifically, the team is responsible for both Helpdesk and AI Agent adoption and custom implementations. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we’re at the forefront of helping our largest, most complex businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one.

About The Role

As an Enterprise Implementation Manager you work with every merchant in your book of business from pre-sales discovery calls through launch, making sure every item identified in the launch plan is released and the merchant is satisfied. The milestones of a launch include:

understanding early what the merchant needs before they become a customer
migrating the merchant’s data to Gorgias
project managing custom builds and integrations to completion working cross-functionally with the technical solutions team
driving product adoption and AI Agent automation rate to 50%+ within 2 months of launch

What You’ll Do

Drive each of your merchants to a successful launch, supporting them from the sales journey through post-launch
Build an organized work-back schedule and timeline covering all key items needed to bring the merchant live, building trust and gaining buy-in early
Project manage cross-functional partners and workstreams to ensure successful go-live dates, such as custom builds (e.g., custom AI Agent actions, integrations)
Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.
Truly understand each of your merchants and their business needs by doing deep discovery in working sessions, mapping out business processes, and designing creative solutions tailored to their business
Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and driving value-driven adoption to achieve key business results
Document customer interactions and feedback meticulously, leveraging this data to continuously improve the product and overall customer experience
Conduct in-depth AI Agent implementation and optimization sessions, tailoring the configuration to drive automation rate and measurable business outcomes for each enterprise merchant
QA AI Agent responses and iterate on prompts and guidance to tune performance over time
Analyze and interpret each merchant’s e-commerce and support data to shape their automation strategy and continuously optimize AI Agent performance post-launch
Bring an assertive, executive presence to drive timelines - setting clear milestones, holding cross-functional partners and merchant stakeholders accountable, and removing roadblocks to protect go-live dates
Act as the primary liaison between the customer and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout onboarding
Align executive stakeholders and build a mutual success plan to keep enterprise launches on track
Be an expert at Gorgias products and functionality always bringing a consultative approach

Who You Are

Experience: 3+ years with Implementations or similar experience within SaaS, with at least 3 years’ experience working directly with Enterprise clients, understanding enterprise merchants and the level of service needed. Have experience driving discovery in the sales cycle, doing technical implementations, and ensuring successful launches through project plans and organization.
Strategic Project Management: 3+ years of experience crafting and overseeing complex, multi-workstream project timelines tailored to enhance activation among enterprise merchants. You bring an assertive presence to drive timelines - proactively setting milestones, holding both internal and merchant stakeholders accountable, and keeping launches on track - while encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.
Technical Experience: Have hacked solutions yourself or see a path to success with cross-functional engineering support. Comfortable configuring AI Agents and familiar with data migrations, APIs, integrations, and custom builds.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and attention to detail skills.
Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 20 accounts and projects. Adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.
Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on mitigating churn and driving engagement and product adoption.
Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.
AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with enterprise merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

Perks & Benefits

🏖️ 5-week vacation (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

🤕 Paid sick leave

🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

💻 MacBook Air

🏥 Health insurance with Sunlife and RRSP matching with Wealthsimple

💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to $900 CAD to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

📚 Get up to $2600 CAD of learning material per year (includes books, courses, training sessions that are easily identified and linked with your job scope. This also covers individual coaching!)

🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

Job Title: Research and Program Analyst
