jobs.description:
Role: Technical Program Manager

Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid)

Fulltime
Job description:

Role Summary:

We are seeking a Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM)
to lead complex, cross-portfolio technology initiatives within Global Product Technology, with a strong focus on Merch Planning, Forecasting, Sizing, and Allocation systems
.
This role operates at the intersection of business and technology
, owning delivery across multiple interdependent programs. The Staff TPM is responsible for driving end-to-end outcomes, shaping technical and business decisions, and ensuring planning and allocation capabilities deliver measurable business impact
.
This role requires deep understanding of retail planning lifecycles, inventory flow, and allocation strategies
, combined with the ability to orchestrate complex technology delivery at scale
.

Key Responsibilities

1. Portfolio Ownership & Program Leadership

Own end-to-end delivery outcomes across multiple programs
spanning Merch Planning, Sizing, Forecasting, Allocation, and Inventory Optimization
Drive alignment across Flowstate initiatives that support:
Forecast-driven size curves
In-season reforecasting
Allocation and transfer optimization
Ensure execution aligns to GTM gates, buy cycles, and merchandising decision timelines

2. Merch Planning & Allocation Business Acumen (Critical)

Serve as a thought partner to Merch Planning and Allocation leaders
, translating business needs into scalable technology solutions
Deeply understand and incorporate:
Pre-season planning (assortment planning, size curves, buy quantities)
In-season management (reforecasting, transfers, sell-through optimization)
Allocation strategies across DCs and stores
Evaluate tradeoffs between:
Forecast accuracy vs responsiveness
Inventory optimization vs service levels
Automation vs planner control
Ensure technology solutions directly improve:
Forecast accuracy
Inventory productivity
Allocation efficiency
Time-to-decision for planners

3. Technical & Strategic Decision Leadership

Drive cross-system decision-making
(architecture, sequencing, data flows, integration with planning tools like Anaplan, Snowflake, etc.)
Lead decision frameworks (options, tradeoffs, recommendations)
for business and technology leadership
Ensure solutions reflect end-to-end planning workflows
, not isolated system improvements
Act as a technical and business translator
between Planning, Product, and Engineering

4. Release Governance & Delivery Management

Own and evolve release governance and readiness processes
across planning and allocation systems
Ensure releases align to critical business windows (GTM, buys, peak seasons)

Drive proactive coordination of:
Data dependencies (forecast inputs, inventory signals)
Cross-system releases impacting planners
Prevent business disruption through tight release discipline and validation rigor

5. Delivery Excellence & Operating Model Design

Design and scale delivery operating models for planning systems
across multiple teams
Standardize execution practices across:
Backlog readiness tied to business outcomes
Planning feature prioritization
Cross-team coordination
Lead initiatives to improve:
Delivery predictability
Feature adoption by business users
Quality of outputs used by planners

6. Cross-Functional Orchestration & Dependency Management

Act as the single-threaded owner connecting Merch Planning, Allocation, Engineering, Data, and Product teams

Manage dependencies across:
Forecasting engines
Sizing logic
Allocation and transfer systems
Surface and resolve risks tied to data quality, model outputs, and downstream planning impacts

7. Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership

Lead response to production issues impacting planning or allocation outcomes
(forecast errors, allocation mismatches, data delays)
Drive root cause analysis with both technical and business context

Ensure continuous improvements in:
SLA adherence
Data accuracy and reliability
Planning system stability

8. Executive Influence & Stakeholder Leadership

Deliver executive-ready insights linking technology delivery to business outcomes
(inventory, forecast accuracy, allocation effectiveness)
Influence prioritization decisions based on business value, not just delivery feasibility

Partner with senior leaders across:
Merch Planning
Allocation
Product
Engineering

9. Scalable Mechanisms & Organizational Impact

Build scalable mechanisms tailored to planning and allocation domains:
Forecast validation frameworks
Allocation readiness checklists
Dependency maps across data → models → planning tools
Enable teams to operate with clarity, accountability, and business alignment

Coach PMs/TPMs on connecting delivery execution to merchandising outcomes

Required Qualifications

8–12+ years in Technical Program Management or Program Management

Proven experience owning portfolio-level programs across planning, supply chain, or retail technology domains

Strong understanding of:
Merch Planning and Allocation processes
Forecasting and inventory optimization concepts
Cross-functional delivery in data-driven systems
Demonstrated ability to influence both technical and business leadership decisions

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Anaplan, planning systems, or allocation engines

Exposure to AI/ML-based forecasting or optimization models

Experience with data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) and end-to-end data pipelines

Background in retail, apparel, or omnichannel inventory environments

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s of engineering, or related fields.

As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Global Payroll Transformation and M&A Lead

As ABB Robotics prepares for an exciting new chapter as a standalone global leader in automation, we are undertaking a major transformation of our people processes and systems. To support this journey, we are looking for an experienced Transformation Project Manager
to lead payroll and employee lifecycle transformation initiatives across multiple countries.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future payroll landscape of a global organization during a period of significant change and growth. You will work in an international environment, collaborating with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, external partners, and senior stakeholders worldwide.

As Transformation Project Manager, you will lead end-to-end payroll transformation and implementation projects, ensuring successful delivery from discovery and design through deployment and stabilization. You will serve as a key partner to the Global Payroll Transformation Lead and work closely with both local and global stakeholders to establish future-ready payroll and employee lifecycle processes.

The position is a temporary assignment ending October 31, 2027
.

Location:
Flexible within Europe, with a preference for candidates located in Poland, Spain, or the Nordic countries.

Your responsibilities will include:

Leading payroll and employee lifecycle transformation projects across multiple countries.
Driving local country discovery activities to understand current processes and define future-state solutions.
Managing project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
Coordinating with HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation and integration.
Facilitating workshops, gathering business requirements, and supporting solution design.
Overseeing testing activities, payroll validations, and go-live readiness.
Supporting change management, training, and transition into operational support.
Ensuring compliance with local legislation, payroll regulations, and company policies.
Providing regular project updates and recommendations to senior leadership and program stakeholders.

Qualifications For The Role

We are looking for a proactive project leader who thrives in transformation environments and enjoys working across cultures, functions, and geographies.

You are likely to have:

Fluency in English and Swedish.
Experience with Strada, divestments, or carve-out projects is considered an advantage.
Experience supporting organizations operating across Nordic countries.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and change management skills.
Extensive project management experience within payroll, HR transformation, or shared services environments.
Proven experience leading payroll implementation projects in complex, multinational organizations.
Strong experience with Workday, including payroll-related processes and integrations.
Solid understanding of payroll operations, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience working with global and cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
Willingness to travel occasionally for key workshops and project milestones.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

ABB Robotics is a global technology leader enabling customers to become more productive, flexible, and sustainable through automation. As we prepare to become an independent company, you will have the opportunity to contribute to one of the most exciting transformation journeys in our industry while working alongside highly skilled colleagues from across the world.

If you are motivated by driving change, building new ways of working, and delivering business-critical transformation projects, we look forward to hearing from you.

Essential Functions

Ambassador of the SouthState Cultural Cornerstones and Core Values.
Cross Departmental Support by contributing to establishing and maintaining a unified team.
Extensive, in depth understanding of Consumer Bank operations, including bank policies and procedures, government regulations and all service and operational standards and their impact on the financial and risk performance of SouthState Bank.
Ensure policies, procedures, and processes are highly customer centric in thought and delivery. Work to remove obstacles that prevent bankers from creating Meaningful and Lasting Relationships and/or hinder their sales process/opportunities.
Develop and manage a Branch Growth/Innovation Management Program: Oversees and coordinates all aspect of branch opening, closing relocations, LPOs and Operation movements that involve other Line of Businesses by supporting efficient collaboration and alignment with company standards under the OCC Regulations and the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) guidelines, where all tasks are completed efficiently.
Work with the Line of Businesses to Identify emerging trends, technologies, and best practice to enhance branch operations and customer experience, this could include designing, pilot, and implement the process improvement.
Technology Liaison is responsible for managing process improvement with this Line of Business and Technology. When a project or process improvement involves Technology , this role collaborates with the business unit to update related tasks and ensure the appropriate stakeholders are involved.

Merger, Acquisition and Conversion Project Manager and Conversion Support, clear and concise communication with update related as assigned.

Disaster and Recovery Project Manager – manages the annual disaster recovery test for Consumer Bank along with Technology.
Process Improvement Support- serves as coordinator or analyst as needed during any process improvement effort or requirement as needed or required.
Incident Management – ensures that incidents are addressed promptly and efficiently, including communications with other Line of Businesses.
Branch Support and Research Requests - related to the department email coverage/research, which would include, in short, branch cash counters and coin machines, branch equipment, access needs, Technology needs for escalation and others requests as deemed necessary.
Vendor Management – oversees vendor relations, contracts, billing for TCR/TCDs, coin machines, cash counters, IT licensing, ID Guide, and Benchmark.
Invoice Oversight – ensures invoices are entered and paid within established timelines and with accuracy.
Annual Equipment Budget Management – covering TCR/TCD units, coin machines, and cash counters, branch equipment, new purchases, and service agreements. This would include any new administration of mergers/acquisitions.
System Access Owner – oversees access for all Consumer Bank Operations owned applications (iTeller, BPM, Terafina, FIS eFunds, etc.) and ensures that application owners complete access reviews on schedule.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPETENCIES

Demonstrated Leadership Skills
Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills
Ability to make sound informed decisions
Effective time management skills
Ability to build positive relationships and partnerships throughout the bank
A solid understanding of Consumer Bank processes, internal control, and risk controls
Professionalism in dealing with co-workers as well as upper management as required
Lead change management to support the adoption of new technologies and processes.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and reprioritize on short notice
Effective problem-solving skills

Qualifications, Education, And Certification Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred or 15+ years applicable experience
Experience: 15+ years in front line banking experience, bank operations experience, Teller and New Accounts processes, or a combination thereof required. Experience with technology adoption, process improvement, and customer experience initiatives. Management Skills and experience preferred Indirect Leadership skills required, 5+ years Project Management experience preferred.
Certifications/Specific Knowledge: Proficient in Excel, Word, Power Point and Microsoft Outlook as a minimum

Training Requirements/Professional Development

Required annual compliance training; stay familiar with NEO (New Employee Orientation and Annual Banker Foundations for Teller & FSR. To ensure continued success in this role, the Consumer Bank Ops Innovation Program Manager is expected to stay current with emerging technologies, enhancing leadership capabilities, and maintaining up-to-date project management skills. Recommended platforms may include internal training resources, external certifications, and tools such as Workday Learning, as applicable.

Must be able to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents and reports. This position requires a long period of time in front of a computer. This can be done sitting or standing as needed. This position may require bending and reaching.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Telecommuting roles no matter if hybrid or 100% full time telecommuting must have a secure home office environment that is free from background noise and distractions. They must also have a reliable private internet connection that is not supplied by cellular data (hot spot). Cable or fiber connections are preferred. jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is scaling rapidly to meet global cloud and AI capacity demand. The Datacenter Design organization is expanding its technical program management capability to improve the speed, consistency, and predictability of data hall design delivery across Oracle’s global datacenter portfolio.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager – Data Hall Design
to drive complex, cross-functional infrastructure programs that support OCI capacity growth. This role will report to the Director of Technical Program Management for Data Hall Design and will operate as a senior individual contributor responsible for program execution, delivery governance, risk management, dependency tracking, process improvement, and stakeholder alignment.

Data Hall Design includes the physical infrastructure design workstreams required to prepare data halls for scalable OCI deployment, including structured cabling, fiber infrastructure, low-voltage systems, physical networking dependencies, construction handoffs, colocation readiness, and operational handoff milestones.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibilities. Success in this role requires technical depth, strong ownership, structured execution, executive-ready communication, and the ability to drive clarity across ambiguous, high-stakes infrastructure programs.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Governance

Drive planning and execution for complex Data Hall Design programs, including roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
Establish and maintain program mechanisms such as milestone reviews, dependency trackers, risk registers, executive updates, KPI dashboards, and escalation paths.
Translate OCI capacity priorities into clear execution plans that align design, construction, networking, colocation, operations, supply chain, vendor, and automation workstreams.
Prepare clear, concise updates for senior leaders, including delivery status, risks, trade-offs, mitigation plans, and decision recommendations.

Data Hall Design Delivery

Drive cross-functional execution across structured cabling, fiber infrastructure, low-voltage systems, physical networking dependencies, construction handoffs, colocation readiness, and operational handoff milestones.
Partner with design engineering teams to ensure deliverables support scalability, maintainability, performance, cost, deployment speed, and operational readiness.
Identify and resolve blockers that could impact design release dates, construction execution, network readiness, vendor delivery, colocation fit-out, or OCI capacity availability.
Maintain accurate program plans, schedules, dependency maps, decision records, and status reporting across assigned programs.

Process Excellence and Standardization

Drive adoption of standardized design processes, templates, review cadences, handoff checklists, exception tracking, and change-management mechanisms.
Use data, metrics, and operating reviews to improve schedule predictability, blocker resolution, design package readiness, and handoff quality.
Partner with tooling, workflow automation, dashboarding, and reporting teams to improve visibility, accountability, and execution performance.
Capture lessons learned and help improve repeatable program mechanisms across regions and design workstreams.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Engagement

Serve as a key execution partner across Datacenter Design, Physical Networking, Construction, Colocation, Capacity Planning, Supply Chain, Datacenter Operations, Infrastructure Delivery, vendors, and automation teams.
Align stakeholders around goals, owners, timelines, risks, trade-offs, and decision points.
Influence without direct authority to drive accountability, unblock execution, and maintain urgency across multiple organizations.
Communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders at multiple levels, from detailed project reviews to senior leadership updates.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Infrastructure Program Management, Datacenter Delivery, Engineering Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related field.
Proven experience driving large-scale, cross-functional technical or infrastructure programs across cloud infrastructure, hyperscale datacenters, physical networking, colocation, telecommunications, construction, or mission-critical facilities.
Strong understanding of infrastructure delivery lifecycles, including design, construction, colocation readiness, networking dependencies, implementation readiness, operational readiness, and handoff to delivery or operations teams.
Experience building and operating program mechanisms such as roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency trackers, risk registers, executive reporting, dashboards, and KPI-based performance tracking.
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, assess risk, evaluate trade-offs, prioritize competing demands, and drive decisions across engineering, construction, operations, supply chain, vendor, and business stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data to identify trends, isolate root causes, and drive process improvement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-ready updates and driving alignment across technical and business teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

About the project:

We are looking for a highly strategic and tech-savvy Project Manager
specializing in Product Discovery and AI-driven MVPs
to join our team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex client business problems and cutting-edge GenAI/AI solutions. You will lead cross-functional teams through the crucial initial phases of the product lifecycle — transforming ambiguous ideas into validated, technical AI prototypes and production-ready MVPs.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical foundation, thrives in the pre-sales/discovery phase, and possesses a deep curiosity for leveraging AI to drive business value.

Does this relate to you?

3+ years of experience in Project Management, with a proven track record of shifting projects from the discovery phase to MVP launch (preferably in an IT agency, studio, or outsource environment).
Hands-on experience working with AI tools, LLMs, and framework ecosystems (e.g., OpenAI API, Claude, LangChain, vLLM, or Hugging Face) to build prototypes, automate workflows, or optimize delivery. You aren't just reading about AI — you actively use it.
Previous hands-on experience in a technical role (Software Engineer, Data/QA Engineer, or Technical Analyst) is a must. You should be comfortable discussing LLM architectures, APIs, and data pipelines with engineers.
A strong understanding of modern AI capabilities, limitations, and prompt engineering concepts to evaluate technical feasibility during early scoping.
Demonstrated experience running discovery workshops, conducting client consultations, and crafting technical/commercial proposals for new initiatives.
Mastery of frameworks tailored for rapid iteration and uncertainty (Lean Startup, Design Sprints, Agile/Scrum, Kanban).
Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into plain business value for non-technical clients.
Proven ability to manage multiple rapid-fire discovery tracks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Upper-Intermediate or Advanced English (both written and spoken) for leading client workshops.

A new team member will be in charge of:

Drive Strategic AI Initiatives: Actively advocate for and embed AI capabilities into project strategies to maximize outcomes, maximize ROI, and unlock new business value for clients.
Drive AI Product Discovery: Partner with clients to uncover business pain points and define how AI/Machine Learning can realistically solve them. Lead scoping, requirement gathering, and definition of the MVP boundaries.
Pre-Sales & Solution Engineering: Act as the primary technical PM during pre-sales, conducting initial client consultations, brainstorming AI-driven solutions, and crafting compelling technical proposals and estimations.
Oversee Fast-Paced MVP Delivery: Lead cross-functional teams (AI engineers, UI/UX designers, developers) to build, test, and ship high-quality MVPs and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) rapidly.
Technical Feasibility & Risk Assessment: Collaborate closely with AI architects to evaluate data readiness, compliance, and technical feasibility of proposed AI models before development begins.
Manage Client Expectations: Act as the strategic point of contact for clients, managing the delicate balance of high expectations surrounding AI against realistic timelines and technology constraints.
Agile Delivery & Iteration: Define project scope, prioritize the MVP backlog based on value/effort, and manage rapid feedback loops to pivot or scale the product based on initial user/client testing.
Risk & Cost Management: Proactively identify project risks (e.g., data quality issues, scope creep, API dependencies) and implement mitigation strategies to keep MVP development lean and cost-effective.

How We Support Your Success:

Remote or hybrid? The choice is yours. We offer a highly flexible approach to time off and personal days, empowering you to manage your own work-life balance.
We invest in your proactive mindset. Access dedicated professional training and development opportunities, customized to align with your career goals.
Sharpen your cross-cultural communication with our dedicated in-house English tutor.
Influence our growth and culture. Participate in our Referral Bonus program to get rewarded for bringing top talent to the team, and benefit from our Recognition Reward program, which celebrates and rewards your productivity and contributions as a team member.
We recognize that life happens outside of work. Enjoy special perks to celebrate your birthdays, weddings, and the arrival of new family members.
We handle the logistics so you can focus on ownership. Benefit from dedicated invoicing assistance, tech admin support, and proactive People Partnership.

Please note: Specific financial allowances, insurance options, and localized administrative support vary by country. We will gladly discuss the tailored package available in your specific location during our conversation!

Job Summary

The Cyber & Information Security Portfolio & Program Manager serves as a senior, trusted advisor to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and is a core member of the Cyber & Information Security leadership team.

This role is responsible for the operational, financial, and governance foundation of the C&IS organization—ensuring that security initiatives are well prioritized, effectively executed, and transparently managed.

The C&IS Portfolio & Program Manager drives portfolio and program oversight, leads smaller security initiatives, streamlines internal processes, and ensures the organization is fully prepared for executive and Board level engagement.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring deep experience, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently with minimal direction.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities/Duties

Provide end‑to‑end oversight of the C&IS initiative portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise risk priorities and strategic objectives.

Project management support for smaller, cross‑functional initiatives that do not warrant dedicated project teams.

Process Optimization & Operational Excellence

Identify, design, and implement opportunities to simplify and streamline internal C&IS processes and services.
Establish lightweight, repeatable operating rhythms for planning, execution, reporting, and follow‑up.

Governance, Executive & Board Support

Translate complex security topics into clear, executive‑level narratives and decision points.

Business Continuity & Preparedness

Experience working in the healthcare industry and/or within cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, or highly regulated environments preferred.

Advanced portfolio and program management skills, including prioritization, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome‑based reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Strong operational execution skills, with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, establish operating rhythms, and drive follow‑through.

Strong judgment, discretion, and decision‑making skills, with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, high‑impact situations.

Who We Are:

CAE Vision: Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness. 
CAE Defense & Security Mission: CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness. 
CAE Values: Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed. 

What We Have to Offer:

Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work-life balance 
A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe 
Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions 
Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun! 

Summary 

The Cybersecurity Manager leads all cybersecurity and Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities for the C‑17 Training System, ensuring full compliance with contract requirements and U.S. Government directives. This role oversees planning, staffing, execution, and continuous governance of the cybersecurity program, including NISPOM/DAAPM/JSIG RMF, eMASS workflow, and customer‑specific Information Assurance requirements. Serving as the primary security interface with internal and external stakeholders, the manager coordinates cybersecurity proposal inputs and BOE development, maintains the cybersecurity program schedule, and provides oversight to all ISSOs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities 

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Responsible for planning, organizing, staffing, managing, and controlling the C-17 TS Cybersecurity/Risk Management Framework (RMF) Program across 16 geographically separated locations.
Manage the preparation, review, and submission of RMF documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
Ensure that system security controls are correctly implemented, continuously monitored, and aligned with USAF and DoD requirements.
Guide the team through the accreditation process to achieve and maintain Authorization to Operate (ATO) status for all systems. Ensure accuracy of eMASS documents and ACAS scans.
Ensure that cybersecurity measures are integrated into all aspects of C-17 simulation and sustainment systems, including hardware, software, and network configurations.
Oversee vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, and system security audits to identify and address potential risks.
Collaborate with sustainment and simulation engineers to ensure secure integration of system updates, patches, and new capabilities without compromising security posture.
Manage and respond to security incidents, ensuring timely containment, investigation, and reporting.
Ensure that all cybersecurity activities are compliant with DoD, USAF, and NIST policies, including NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, and DoD 8500.01.
Work closely with USAF leadership, IT, and engineering sustainment teams to ensure all systems supporting C-17 simulation and training systems are compliant.
Interface with external auditors, inspectors, and regulatory bodies to support security assessments and address compliance issues.
Act as the primary point of contact for cybersecurity matters related to C-17 simulation and sustainment systems, coordinating with program managers, system engineers, and external stakeholders.
Communicate complex cybersecurity risks and issues to non-technical personnel and leadership in a clear and concise manner.
Prepare and present reports on the security status of systems, risks, and recommended mitigations to USAF leadership and program stakeholders.
Develop and deliver cybersecurity training and awareness programs to team members and system users involved in C-17 sustainment and simulation activities.
Foster a security-conscious culture within the team, ensuring adherence to security best practices across all activities.
Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day progress of ISSO support staff in maintaining government compliance.
Responsible for scheduling personnel, managing labor and material expenditures.
Attends meetings, manages delivery schedules and coordinates configuration management activities.
Ensure a safe and secure work environment is established and maintained.
Responsible for supervision and oversight of ISSO cyber resources and personnel.

Qualifications And Education Requirements 

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science or related field
A minimum 8 years of experience in cybersecurity field
Information Assurance Manager (IAM) Level I (Level II preferred) or Information Assurance Technician Level II certification in accordance with DoD 8570-01 or corresponding level under DoD 8140
Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Word
Must exhibit high performance and capability to work in a team environment
Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Word.
Must be able to effectively deliver oral presentations to management and customers
Must be able to work independently, with minimal supervision
Must be able to work overtime as required.
Must be willing to work any shift or day of the week as required.
Understanding of military protocols and customs is essential
Domestic and international travel as required.
Incumbent must be eligible for DoD Personal Security Clearance.
Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role. 

Security Responsibilities 

Must comply with all company security and data protection / usage policies and procedures.  Personally responsible for proper marking and handling of all information and materials, in any form. Shall not divulge any information, or afford access, to other employees not having a need-to-know. Shall not divulge information outside company without management approval.  All government and proprietary information will be accessed and stored electronically on company provided resources.   

 Incumbent must be eligible for DoD Personal Security Clearance.  

Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role. 

Work Environment 

Work is typically performed in a professional office setting using standard IT and office equipment.
Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.
Work may involve exposure to operational training environments that include risks associated with electrical systems, hydraulics, elevated temperatures, airborne particles, and loud noise levels.

Physical Demands 

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.   

Ability to walk, climb stairs, and access simulator or cockpit environments.
Ability to stoop, bend, and crawl on or under training devices when necessary.
Ability to detect environmental indicators such as odors or noises associated with mechanical or electrical issues.
Ability to distinguish colors required for system indicators, wiring, or display diagnostics.

Other Duties

Onsite – Phoenix, Arizona

Division:
Embedded Intelligence Services (EIS)

Schedule:
Full-time: 7-3 Business Hours, Monday-Friday

Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring at least five (5) years of intelligence experience, advanced analytical tradecraft, and demonstrated success operating in complex, client-facing environments. This individual will serve as a senior member of the embedded team, providing strategic insight, mentoring junior analysts, and delivering high-impact intelligence products aligned to executive and operational decision-making. Occasional travel and after-hours support may be required.

Position Overview

Reporting to the EIS Intelligence Manager and working closely with client leadership, the Intelligence Analyst will support the Security Operations Center (SOC) activities for a client. The analyst will integrate geopolitical, protective, and security intelligence into decision workflows by providing forward-looking, actionable insights that mitigate risk to personnel, assets, operations, supply chain continuity, and reputation. This role requires strong independent judgment, the ability to manage complex intelligence requirements, and the capability to guide analytical standards across the team while maintaining a collaborative, non-managerial posture within the client environment.

What You Will Work On

Strategic Intelligence Analysis

Conduct anticipatory geopolitical, security, and protective intelligence analysis aligned to client priorities. Deliver tailored intelligence products, including horizon scanning reports, scenario forecasts, executive SITREPs, and impact assessments. Integrate global monitoring into risk decision workflows, identifying both threats and emerging opportunities.

Protective & Security Intelligence

Lead open-source, deep web, and social media monitoring to identify and assess threats to executives and enterprise leadership. Conduct Persons of Interest (POI) investigations, threat actor assessments, executive vulnerability reviews, and due diligence reports. Produce travel threat assessments, route assessments, event security assessments, and site-specific risk evaluations.

Operational Support & Incident Response

Monitor global events in real time and assess operational impact. Support crisis response and emergency incident management in accordance with established best practices and client SOPs. Triage client intelligence requests and deliver timely, decision-ready analysis.

Collaboration & Advisory Support

Serve as a strategic intelligence partner within the SOC environment, aligning intelligence priorities with organizational objectives. Liaise with client stakeholders to understand operational footprint, evolving risks, and intelligence requirements. Mentor analysts in research methodology, structured analytic techniques, writing standards, and briefing delivery. Contribute to continuous improvement of workflows, intelligence products, and playbooks. Support tracking of production metrics and program performance.

Additional Support

Provide ad hoc briefings, executive support, and special analytical projects as required.

What You Will Bring

Education

Bachelor’s degree required.

Experience

5+ years of experience in intelligence analysis, geopolitical risk, protective intelligence, incident response, or enterprise security. Experience supporting senior stakeholders in a corporate, government, or consulting environment. Demonstrated experience mentoring analysts and leading complex analytical projects.

Skills & Qualifications

Advanced knowledge of the intelligence cycle and structured analytic techniques. Strong expertise in OSINT collection, global risk monitoring, and investigative methodologies. Exceptional analytic writing and executive briefing skills. Experience producing strategic intelligence products for senior decision-makers. Familiarity with intelligence and risk management platforms (e.g., Crisis24, Everbridge, Dataminr, Ontic, etc.). High proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and mapping/visualization tools (Google Earth, GIS platforms). Strong client engagement skills and ability to manage expectations in high-stakes environments. Ability to operate independently, prioritize competing demands, and maintain quality under pressure. Foreign language proficiency and international experience are advantageous.

Additional Requirements

Must work onsite in Phoenix, Arizona. Flexibility to support 24/7 mission requirements, including occasional evening or weekend coverage. Occasional travel may be required. Successful completion of background check and writing/technical aptitude assessments required.

Important Note About This Position

This position focuses on geopolitical risk, global threat intelligence, and monitoring events that could disrupt client operations, including political, economic, social, and security factors, as well as natural events such as severe weather and other disasters. The role emphasizes qualitative research, investigative analysis, and intelligence reporting rather than technical, IT, cybersecurity, data analytics, or business intelligence functions. Potential applicants with primary experience in technical or data-centric fields should carefully consider whether this role aligns with their background.

Information Security

Protect the data and systems of Crisis24 and its stakeholders by adhering to policies, reporting incidents and potential problems, completing regular training, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Crisis24 is dedicated to equal opportunity in employment. We are committed to a work environment that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate against any individual based on race, color, sex, national origin, age, religion, marital or parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any factors protected by applicable laws.

We operate at the intersection of advanced engineering, cutting-edge design, and user-centric innovation, delivering safe, effective, and enabling solutions for both commercial and defence applications.

Annual Leave – Entitlement to 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

Lead the planning and delivery of assigned projects, ensuring performance against scope, schedule, and budget.

Support the implementation of project controls, including schedule management, cost tracking, and risk reporting.

Required

Teamwork, mutual respect and collaboration

About Us

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare! We build software that simplifies the process of choosing the right health insurance for individuals. Our solutions help our health plan and government customers with the administration, reporting, and operational requirements of their plans. By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.

Our Company Culture

Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and appreciation. We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.

At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Business Operations Manager to join our team. This role involves overseeing and optimizing business processes, driving operational excellence, and supporting strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership and analytical skills, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Please note that the requirements of this role are beyond the 9am - 6pm scope. It is expected that all managers are available to the organization when needed.

You Will:

Operational Management & Process Improvement

Oversee day-to-day business operations to ensure smooth and efficient processes across departments
Identify, design, and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality throughout the organization
Ensure business operations comply with industry regulations and company policies, maintaining high standards of quality and integrity

Contribute to the development and execution of strategic plans that support business growth and operational excellence
Collect, analyze, and interpret data to identify trends and insights that inform business decisions and drive operational improvements

Lead and manage project management activities, including planning, execution, and monitoring of projects to ensure timely and successful completion
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities for the operations department

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including finance, sales, marketing, and product development, to support business operations and align on strategic goals
Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends, the competitive landscape, and emerging technologies relevant to the healthtech sector

Continuous Improvement & Documentation

Lead initiatives that promote continuous improvement and operational excellence within the organization
Maintain detailed documentation of processes, procedures, and analysis to ensure transparency and knowledge sharing within the team

Talent Management

Collaborate with the Talent team to actively engage in the hiring and recruitment process, including but not limited to participating in interviews
Leverage industry networks and expertise to identify and attract top talent that aligns with the company's objectives and values
Provide guidance and mentorship to team members within your department and across diverse functions
Play an integral role in shaping and reinforcing the overall company culture, promoting values that enhance teamwork, collaboration, and employee engagement

Must be available for on-call duty during peak periods, providing support outside of regular working hours as needed to ensure the timely resolution of critical issues
Availability to work occasional weekends and overnight hours as needed
Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles require in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience
Must reside in the Eastern or Central time zone. Eastern Time working hours required
Travel up to 5% required

You Have

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Information Technology, or a related field. Degree in STEM is strongly preferred
A Master's degree is preferred

Experience

5-7 years of experience in business operations, project management, or a related role within the healthcare or technology sectors, with at least 2 years in a managerial position
Experience within a STEM field is required
Excel experience required. Some SQL experience preferred

Certifications

Must complete Six Sigma Green Belt Certification within 6 months of hire, if not already certified

Knowledge

In-depth understanding of healthcare industry standards and regulations
Experience working within the healthcare or technology industry required

Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in data analysis tools and software (e.g., Excel, SQL, Tableau)
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
Attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems

Attributes

Client-focused with a strategic and proactive approach to operations
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Eagerness to learn and adapt in a rapidly changing environment

Benefits

What We Offer

Softheon offers every full-time employee a comprehensive compensation and benefits package including:

For this position we offer a base pay of $90,000-$110,000, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation, and benefits. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as candidate location, qualifications, skill level, and competencies
Work from your home company with a one-time home office stipend
Comprehensive benefits package that includes health, vision and dental coverage for you, your spouse and dependents
Additional benefits, including a monthly wellness stipend and internet stipend, 401K w/ a match; immediately vested, employee assistance program, disability/life insurance, and parental leave
15 days to discretionary PTO based on YOS
9 additional paid holidays
Referral bonuses, discretionary bonus program, spot bonuses and professional development opportunities
Please note that candidates applying for this position must reside within the United States

jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Finance & Business Operations Manager ensures strong financial discipline, supports operational performance, and enables strategic execution across the operating unit. This role drives efficient processes, optimized resource use, and alignment across teams to deliver consistent, measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management

Coordinate core business management activities including accounting, financial planning and pricing.
Ensure accurate and timely month-end close processes, including consolidation, reconciliations, EAC (Estimate-at-Complete) profitability assessments, and cash flow/balance sheet oversight.
Lead Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Long-Range Plan (LRP) development aligned with long‑term business strategy.
Provide clear financial analysis and reporting for operating unit and Group Senior Leadership.
Prioritize and manage Non-Contractual Technical Activity (NCTA) and Capital Expenditure investments, including obtaining required Group approvals.
Support end‑to‑end proposal development—from draft RFP review through award—including basis‑of‑estimate development, indirect rate application, pricing strategy, and leadership presentations.
Manage the operating unit compliance activities, including the relationship with independent auditors and tax advisors.
Deliver data-driven recommendations to support business and strategic decision-making.

Operational Leadership

Implement and maintain standard operating procedures across business management functions to ensure scalable and repeatable workflows.
Lead financial and business risk management activities across the operating unit, coordinating with functional leaders to ensure risks are appropriately identified, assessed and mitigated.
Coordinate cross-functional processes to ensure smooth handoffs and workflow continuity.
Track team performance against defined metrics, ensuring accountability and continuous improvement.
Support employee training and development initiatives to enhance operational capability.
Serve as the primary interface between the operating unit and outsourced HR support.

Strategic Execution

Translate organizational priorities into actionable plans with clear KPIs, milestones, and timelines.
Lead process‑improvement initiatives, including automation, workflow redesign, and cost‑efficiency efforts.

Success Indicators

Achievement of AOP financial commitments.
Consistent delivery of operating unit performance KPIs.
Effective execution of high‑priority strategic initiatives.

Basic Qualifications

Direct experience with a U.S. Government contractor, with significant expertise in program finance, accounting, EAC management, and long‑term contract revenue recognition.
Experience supporting proposal pricing, business planning and program financial management within a U.S. Government contracting environment
Bachelor’s degree and 9+ years of Aerospace Industry experience, or a Master’s degree and 7+ years.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operations Supply Project Manager
jobs.description:
Meet the Team

Join our dynamic team, where you'll work with great people from marketing, operations, supplier management, and finance to create the most efficient supply chain for the Next Generation Firewall Business Unit (NGFWBU) products. Oh, and you'll also work with your teammates, who are great.

The organization works with Contract Manufacturers (CMs) in, Regional Operations, Marketing, GSM, and Finance teams to create a best-in-class fulfillment supply chain.

The NGFWBU (GFO) team seeks someone who is exciting and worthy of joining the best planning and fulfillment team on earth and beyond. We're going to need your help to formulate a strategy because we value your opinion and need you to lean in here!

Your Impact

As a member of the NGFWBU, you’re going to change the way we work, live, play, and learn. As a Product Supply Lead (PSL), you'll navigate daily challenges in a dynamic and supportive environment. Your expertise in materials planning and fulfillment will give Cisco a competitive edge and enhance customer satisfaction.

You'll establish effective materials pipelines, optimize product lead times, and collaborate with regional teams to align build plans with business needs, focusing on fulfillment metrics (LTA, OTB, etc.). You will be the main contact for the BU, Regional S&OP, and Sales regarding order escalations and allocations.

Support Product Ops through all product life cycle stages, including key deal enablement, process optimization, and supply-demand balancing. Assist the Product Supply Chain Planning team with inventory metrics and key control points for E&O forecasting, cost, and scrap decisions.

Coordinate the Aging Inventory/Scrap/E&O process across the Security space, providing analytical support and ensuring alignment with BU stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

BA/BS or experience of a minimum of 10 years
Strong analytical skills (Demand Planning, Sales & Operations Planning)
Deep supply chain knowledge.
Expert level with MS Office Applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Sharepoint)
English language proficient

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of manufacturing processes and procedures
Excellent communication and business planning skills, while being self-motivated with a focus on execution.
Understanding of Supply Planning processes & tools
Experience with MRP/ERP systems, including material planning-specific software such as Kinaxis or Oracle.
Experience in materials planning, and fulfillment skills.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

About Supermicro

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Sr. Logistics Project Manager who would be responsible for ensuring the success of material shipping and delivery schedule. The candidate is expected to provide accurate shipping and delivery schedule for new and existing products by working closely with internal and external teams. The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate ability to integrate interior recourses to benefit the company by facilitating continuous growth and performance maximization.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Responsible for the material shipping and delivery schedule.
Have a knowledge of national and international import/export regulations and must be able to effectively troubleshoot any issues that may arise in international freight transportation.
Responsible for working with existing transportation suppliers on best-in-class delivery rate and delivery routing.
Coordinate internal teams on recommending optimal transportation modes, routing, equipment or frequency.
Establish or monitor specific supply chain-based performance measurement systems.
Control and follow up of incoming materials and outgoing finished products to ensure customers receive products on time.
Ensure all partners in the supply chain are working effectively and efficiently to ensure smooth operations.
Maintain metric, reports, process documentation, customer service log, as well as training and safety records.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Supply Chain, International Business, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
8+ years of progressively responsible experience in computer system applications, including three years of experience as coordinator/manager.
Ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams and multiple internal work group and coordinate with Sales, Operations, Purchasing, and Engineering to optimize delivery model.
Should have the following skill sets: coordination, active listening, critical thinking, reading comprehension, writing, monitoring, service orientation, time management, judgment and decision making and active learning.
Need to have PC or Server Hardware experience and knowledge.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.
Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.
Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About The Team

The Enterprise Customer Implementation Team at Gorgias works with our highest GMV merchants. Each implementation is truly custom based on the merchant’s business processes, procedures, and workflows. The team is successful when launches occur on time and merchants are promoters of Gorgias at the end of their implementation - excited to continue their customer journey with us.

Specifically, the team is responsible for both Helpdesk and AI Agent adoption and custom implementations. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we’re at the forefront of helping our largest, most complex businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one.

About The Role

As an Enterprise Implementation Manager you work with every merchant in your book of business from pre-sales discovery calls through launch, making sure every item identified in the launch plan is released and the merchant is satisfied. The milestones of a launch include:

understanding early what the merchant needs before they become a customer
migrating the merchant’s data to Gorgias
project managing custom builds and integrations to completion working cross-functionally with the technical solutions team
driving product adoption and AI Agent automation rate to 50%+ within 2 months of launch

What You’ll Do

Drive each of your merchants to a successful launch, supporting them from the sales journey through post-launch
Build an organized work-back schedule and timeline covering all key items needed to bring the merchant live, building trust and gaining buy-in early
Project manage cross-functional partners and workstreams to ensure successful go-live dates, such as custom builds (e.g., custom AI Agent actions, integrations)
Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.
Truly understand each of your merchants and their business needs by doing deep discovery in working sessions, mapping out business processes, and designing creative solutions tailored to their business
Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and driving value-driven adoption to achieve key business results
Document customer interactions and feedback meticulously, leveraging this data to continuously improve the product and overall customer experience
Conduct in-depth AI Agent implementation and optimization sessions, tailoring the configuration to drive automation rate and measurable business outcomes for each enterprise merchant
QA AI Agent responses and iterate on prompts and guidance to tune performance over time
Analyze and interpret each merchant’s e-commerce and support data to shape their automation strategy and continuously optimize AI Agent performance post-launch
Bring an assertive, executive presence to drive timelines - setting clear milestones, holding cross-functional partners and merchant stakeholders accountable, and removing roadblocks to protect go-live dates
Act as the primary liaison between the customer and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout onboarding
Align executive stakeholders and build a mutual success plan to keep enterprise launches on track
Be an expert at Gorgias products and functionality always bringing a consultative approach

Who You Are

Experience: 3+ years with Implementations or similar experience within SaaS, with at least 3 years’ experience working directly with Enterprise clients, understanding enterprise merchants and the level of service needed. Have experience driving discovery in the sales cycle, doing technical implementations, and ensuring successful launches through project plans and organization.
Strategic Project Management: 3+ years of experience crafting and overseeing complex, multi-workstream project timelines tailored to enhance activation among enterprise merchants. You bring an assertive presence to drive timelines - proactively setting milestones, holding both internal and merchant stakeholders accountable, and keeping launches on track - while encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.
Technical Experience: Have hacked solutions yourself or see a path to success with cross-functional engineering support. Comfortable configuring AI Agents and familiar with data migrations, APIs, integrations, and custom builds.
Communication Skills: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and attention to detail skills.
Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 20 accounts and projects. Adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.
Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on mitigating churn and driving engagement and product adoption.
Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.
AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with enterprise merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

Perks & Benefits

🏖️ 5-week vacation (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

🤕 Paid sick leave

🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

💻 MacBook Air

🏥 Health insurance with Sunlife and RRSP matching with Wealthsimple

💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to $900 CAD to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

📚 Get up to $2600 CAD of learning material per year (includes books, courses, training sessions that are easily identified and linked with your job scope. This also covers individual coaching!)

🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias

At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias

By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst – Project Solutions and Digital Delivery
jobs.description:
Job Overview

APTIM is seeking an experienced IT Business Analyst – Project Systems & Digital Delivery to support the organization's project systems delivery and digital transformation initiatives through the evaluation, implementation, optimization, and governance of project systems and digital delivery technologies.

This position serves as a critical liaison between project teams, project controls professionals, operations leaders, and technology teams to ensure business processes are effectively supported by scalable, integrated, and user-friendly technology solutions.

The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing APTIM's digital delivery strategy by helping select, deploy, and continuously improve project platforms and project information management systems.

This role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise-wide project delivery processes, technology strategy, and digital transformation initiatives while partnering with professionals across engineering, environmental, infrastructure, government, and construction-related projects. Job D
escription
:

The CX Operations team is seeking a Senior Customer Experience Operations Analyst
to build and own a series of CX Metrics dashboards that provide leading indicators and performance results across all Chief Customer Officer (CCO) functions: Professional Services, Customer Success, Analyst Services, and Support. In this role, you will become the go-to expert on CX data and data sources, working hands-on to investigate, clean up, and consolidate information that today is spread across multiple commercial and proprietary systems. The ideal candidate is curious, organized, and comfortable working in environments where data is messy and poorly documented. They are motivated by turning scattered information into something business stakeholders can actually use.

Please note that while this role is remote, candidates must be based in the Eastern Time Zone.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Develop a phased CX Metrics dashboard strategy. Start by delivering initial core metrics for each CCO function (Professional Services, Customer Success, Analyst Services, Support) and then build out a more robust dashboard and insights framework over time
Investigate and map CX data across multiple systems (including Salesforce, Gong, and proprietary applications) to identify which fields and field combinations are needed to produce each desired metric
Partner with IT, Application, and Data Warehouse teams to get access to source data, while owning the CX-layer logic for how that data is structured, transformed, and used for operational reporting
Perform hands-on data transformation and cleansing as an interim solution for immediate business needs and migrate to the data warehouse solution as that source evolves to meet the business needs
Design and build automated dashboard feeds that pull data from multiple systems into a single view of CX leading indicators and performance metrics
Become the CX organization's go-to person on data lineage, data quality, and source-system quirks. Proactively identify and resolve data integrity issues that affect metric accuracy
Work through ambiguous data situations by talking to people across departments, piecing together undocumented logic, and documenting the resulting data definitions and calculation methods
Share insights and recommendations from the dashboards with CX leaders and functional teams. This role is not just about building reports; we need you to surface trends, flag anomalies, and identify opportunities for improvement
Build and maintain a CX metrics catalog that documents the standard metrics for each CCO function, what they measure, where the data comes from, and how often it refreshes
Work with Revenue Operations, Data & Analytics, and Business Systems teams as a consumer and partner (not a substitute), making sure CX-specific reporting and insights needs are met without duplicating what those teams already provide
Leverage AI tools to accelerate data exploration, automate repetitive transformation tasks, and generate initial drafts of analyses or documentation

Qualifications & Experience:

3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data-focused roles within Customer Experience, Customer Success, or SaaS operations environments
Experience building dashboards and automated reporting using tools such as Tableau and Power BI with live data connections
Hands-on proficiency with data transformation and preparation. Comfortable writing SQL queries and simple ETL logic to manage data as an interim solution for immediate business needs while the data warehouse team implements the long term strategy
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce data architecture, reporting and dashboards and experience extracting, joining, and interpreting data from CRM and adjacent systems (e.g., Gong, Gainsight, proprietary platforms)
Familiarity with standard CX metrics (Customer Success, Professional Services, Renewals, Support) and an understanding of how each metric drives outcomes
Proven ability to work in situations where nobody has a clear answer. You should be comfortable interviewing stakeholders, reverse-engineering undocumented processes, and pulling together incomplete information into reliable metric definitions
Comfortable using AI and large language model tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude) to speed up data analysis, write or debug code, and draft documentation.
Strong communication skills. You will need to present findings to senior leaders and explain complex data concepts in plain business terms
Highly organized and self-directed. You will be managing a phased roadmap of deliverables across multiple functional stakeholders at the same time
Collaborative mindset with experience partnering across IT, Data Engineering, and business teams, while maintaining clear ownership boundaries appropriate to an operations role

The Program Manager, Product Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Affairs (PEC & RA) Global Logistics Operations (GLO) is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing global Regulatory Affairs and Product Environmental Compliance programs applicable to Global Logistics activities and distribution networks.

This role ensures that GLO Operations—including EU and global distribution centers —are compliant with applicable regulatory requirements related to environmental product compliance, packaging, batteries, and Economic Operator obligations. The Program Manager acts as the primary interface between GLO, Corporate RA/PEC programs, and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure timely, consistent, and compliant implementation of regulatory requirements.

Leading global RA & PEC programs applicable to Global Logistics, ensuring alignment with Corporate and Divisional regulatory strategies and timelines.
Establishing and maintaining program governance, including scope definition, milestones, risk management, dependency tracking, and executive reporting.
Coordinating implementation of Product Environmental Compliance (PEC) requirements impacting logistics and distribution activities, including packaging, batteries, and restricted substances.
Act as the official correspondent or responsible person to relevant health authorities for GLO sites.
Evaluating impact of changing global regulations, including PEC requirements, on the GLO network and communicating impact to leadership.
Supporting compliance with applicable regulations such as Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR), Battery Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (BWBR), and related implementing acts.
Report on budget actuals and project costs to management for activities supporting regulatory requirements.
Training staff on, executing and monitoring registration and listing obligations for GLO sites globally.
Supporting health authority and notified body audits as required and responding to health authority queries.
Collaborating with Regulatory Affairs function to identify, draft and communicate device shortages to relevant health authorities.
Coordinating RA‑related Economic Operator obligations (Importer and Distributor) as they apply to GLO operations, in close collaboration with Corporate RA and Legal.
Acting as the primary GLO liaison to Corporate PEC and RA programs to ensure consistent interpretation, deployment, and execution across regions.
Partnering with Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Packaging Engineering, Sustainability, Operations, and Business stakeholders to drive end‑to‑end regulatory readiness.
Ensuring appropriate regulatory documentation, evidence, and records are maintained to support audits, inspections, and market access requirements.
Monitoring program performance through defined KPIs and readiness indicators, identifying gaps and driving timely corrective actions.
Supporting continuous improvement of regulatory and compliance processes within Global Logistics.
Promoting awareness of regulatory and environmental compliance requirements throughout the GLO organization.

Education

Hon. Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering or related subject or equivalency is mandatory.
Masters degree in Science, Engineering or related subject is preferred.

8+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Product Environmental Compliance, or regulatory program management within a regulated industry (medical devices preferred).

Working knowledge of EU environmental, packaging, and battery regulations and their impact on logistics and distribution activities.
Experience working within ISO 13485 / MDR / FDA‑regulated quality systems.
