jobs.title: Design Project Manager, Data Centers
jobs.description:
JOB DETAILS:

Position:
Design Project Manager, Data Centers
Status:
Permanent; Full-time
Location:
Remote, must live in the contiguous U.S. or Canada
Closing Date:
Open until filled

ABOUT US:

NGEN Mission Critical is a U.S.-based provider of critical power and cooling infrastructure, serving data centers, AI factories, and utility-scale power generation. We reduce lead times by pairing global manufacturing scalability with a fully integrated American engineering and service platform. In a market defined by equipment scarcity, extended procurement cycles, and heightened regulatory scrutiny, NGEN delivers deployment certainty through disciplined regulatory compliance, coordinated sourcing, and lifecycle accountability. From engineering validation through commissioning and ongoing operational support, NGEN ensures compliance, documentation integrity, and performance continuity in mission-critical environments.

Our team works hard while maintaining a collaborative, respectful, and supportive culture. We are looking for colleagues with a sense of humor, who consider themselves “builders,” and who are excited to make an impact in a future-focused and fast-paced environment.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're hiring a Design Project Manager onto NGEN's Data Center Development team. You'll run design projects across the full lifecycle, from early site assessment and due diligence through design development to issue for construction, carrying two to three active projects at a time. You'll be comfortable in the drawings, not just the schedule, and you'll help make the handoff from design into procurement a clean one, because long-lead equipment sets the critical path on every project we touch.

You'll report to our Director of Project Design and work closely with the directors leading construction and procurement, which means you'll see more of a project than the same title would show you at a hyperscaler or a large consultancy. The systems, workflows, and standards are still being written, and you'll help influence them. If you’re energized by fast-moving work, we'd love to meet you!

YOUR MISSION:

• Manage design projects across the full lifecycle, from early site assessment and due diligence through design development to issue for construction
• Run design project schedules, scope and deliverable tracking, and keep consultants and internal stakeholders aligned to them
• Review design drawings alongside our in-house electrical and mechanical experts, coordinating across disciplines and catching errors
• Coordinate the design-to-procurement transition so that equipment specifications, approved submittals and release packages are complete and issued on schedule
• Support procurement on equipment release dates and long-lead equipment schedules, keeping procurement aligned to project sequencing
• Facilitate supplier meetings, escalate delivery risks early, and coordinate delivery logistics with the construction team
• Keep projects moving across the design, procurement and construction handoffs, including when one of the leads is heads-down or out of office
• Maintain project documentation, standards and templates, and improve them as the design function matures
• Communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to customers, consultants and the internal team

YOU'LL WIN US OVER WITH THIS KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

• You bring 5+ years of relevant experience across design, engineering, architecture or construction management
• You've taken projects through the full design cycle, from site due diligence to issue for construction, more than once. This one is a hard requirement
• At least one of those cycles was mission-critical work. Other large, complex capital projects count toward the rest
• You come from a civil, structural or architectural background. We have mechanical and electrical covered in-house
• You’re comfortable working within Revit and ACC/Forma
• You read a full set of documents critically and coordinate across disciplines
• You know how to put AI tools like Claude to work for you, and just as importantly, when not to
• You understand data centers and the development process, or you'll do the homework to get there quickly
• Exposure to procurement or equipment planning on large capital projects is a strong asset
• Construction management, commissioning or international project experience are all a plus
• A relevant degree helps but is not required. What you have delivered matters more to us than where you studied

WHO YOU ARE:

• You're comfortable without a lot of direction. Priorities here shift, sometimes by the day, and you're ready to dive in and ask good questions
• You're teachable and you treat that as a strength rather than a gap. You'd rather be brought up to speed on something new than pretend you have already done it
• You catch what doesn't line up. A dimension that disagrees between disciplines, an equipment release that's about to miss the sequence…You see it early enough that it's a quick fix instead of a fire drill
• You'd rather see the whole picture than stay in your lane. Working across design, procurement and construction appeals to you more than a narrow, well-defined scope
• You want your process improvements to stick. On a team this size, the way you decide to run a project becomes the way projects get run
• You're a good time! You roll with the jokes as readily as the punches, and you work hard without taking yourself too seriously

COMPENSATION PACKAGE:

• U.S. base salary: $135,000 - $165,000 USD
• Canada base salary: $130,000 - $160,000 CAD
• The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills
• Annual bonus of up to 25% of your base salary, based on performance
• 401k or RRSP match of up to 5% of your base salary
• Access to health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents
• Three weeks of paid vacation
• Five paid personal days
• Home office set-up support
• Remote working environment with flexibility and autonomy

INTERVIEW PROCESS & TIMELINES:

We're so excited that you are interested in joining our team! Our interview process will look like this:
• Aug 24th – 28th: 3-5 questions will be emailed to shortlisted candidates, confirming some basic information about you and why you're interested in this position (estimated time commitment 10-15 minutes)
• Aug 31st – Sep 4th: 30-minute virtual meeting with our recruitment team so that we can learn more about your career path so far, and you have a chance to ask us any questions that you have
• Sep 8th – 11th: A 1-hour meeting with the Director of Project Design and Head of People & Culture
• Sep 14th – 18th: Reference checks and an employment offer extended

We will do our best to follow the timelines outlined, and we will let you know if timelines shift!

HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI IN RECRUITMENT:

We believe in real humans hiring real humans.

• To keep things organized and thoughtful, NGEN uses AI-assisted tools for note taking during interviews. That said, every conversation, evaluation, and hiring decision is made by real people on our team (including initial resume screening). The only automated (not AI-augmented, just automated) step in our process is at the initial screening question stage when you first apply for the role.
• We are so excited to meet you and hear about all the incredible experiences and expertise you have built throughout your career. It's very important to us that we hear about those experiences and pieces of expertise in your own words – we prefer messy and authentic to polished with no depth. We mention this because we know how tight the labor market is and why some candidates may feel compelled to use an AI companion tool to help them answer questions live in interviews. Please be aware that if we suspect that you are using a tool like this, we will stop the interview and remove your application from consideration.
We do believe in using AI to support our everyday work in areas that we've identified as low value or low energy – we routinely use tools like Claude, Zapier, Fireflies.ai, and Grammarly. Bringing on a new teammate is very important to us, so this effort falls into neither of those categories of “low value” or “low energy”.

We will show up for you in this recruitment process! In turn, please show up (as you!) for us. We can't wait to meet you!

HOW TO APPLY:

If this role sounds like it's right up your alley, but you're worried about missing a few of the qualifications, please reach out with your interest anyway. We value the unique skill sets, experiences, and pathways that people take in their careers, and are aware that non-traditional routes are sometimes overlooked. We make hiring decisions based on skill, and we're excited to hear what you will bring to our team!
• This is a permanent, full-time position and a fully remote role with some travel required
• We are not in a position to sponsor visa applications of any kind. As a result, only candidates who are currently legally entitled to work in the USA and/or Canada will be considered for this role
• This position will typically work Monday to Friday within the normal business hours of the region in which the successful candidate lives. As a member of a globally remote team, some meetings outside of normal business hours will be required for this role

Please submit a resume and cover letter to careers@ngen-mc.com with the subject ‘ Design Project Manager Application
.’ We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams
Experience in Total Rewards, People Operations, or an adjacent HR domain
Familiarity with PM and collaboration tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
Familiarity with Total Rewards or HR systems (such as Workday, equity administration platforms, or benefits administration tools)
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or comparable structured-program training

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Republic Finance is a dynamic and innovative company at the forefront of the consumer finance industry. We’ve been in business for over 70 years, and we are proud to be a trusted lender in over 250 communities across the United States! We are driven by our shared mission to pursue excellence for our customers and are seeking a Project Manager
to join our team. If you’re passionate about managing projects, driving results, and contributing to our ongoing business transformation, we want to hear from you! The PMO team can work remotely from Baton Rouge, LA, or follow a hybrid schedule in Plano, TX or Charlotte, NC. For the right candidate, this position may be remote, provided the individual resides in a state where we currently operate, with low to moderate travel to our headquarters locations.

As a Project Manager
at Republic Finance you will play a pivotal role in planning, executing, and delivering projects on time and within budget. You will be responsible for ensuring project objectives are met, managing resources effectively, and encouraging strong cross-functional collaboration. We look for organized individuals that are self-starters, skilled in critical thinking, building project plans, and guiding large project teams to delivery of successful initiatives on time and under budget. Job responsibilities are as follows:

Lead projects from initiation to closure, including but not limited to, working with project leadership to define project scope, goals, and deliverables, developing, revising, and maintaining complex project plans, tracking tasks, timelines, and resource allocations and ensuring all project documentation is accurate and up to date.
Deliver clear, consistent, and effective verbal and written communication to project teams, project partners and Project Management Office leadership. Foster and maintain positive relationships within the project team and other departments.
Document and escalate project risks. Assist with identifying, preventing, and mitigating risks throughout the project to minimize impact on project timelines and deliverables.
Promote cross-team collaboration to assist project team members in completing tasks and resolving conflicts or issues that arise throughout the project life cycle.
Leverage Project Management Office (PMO) tools, templates, and standardized project processes. Actively participate in PMO process improvement reviews and special assignments.
Assist Senior Project Managers or Senior Program Managers on complex enterprise projects, special projects or PMO initiatives.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
2 years in a project coordinator or project management role.
Limited travel if located in Baton Rouge, LA or Plano, TX, or Charlotte, NC; travel up to 25% if located elsewhere.
Hands-on experience using project management tools and software.
Experience leading and completing projects according to scope, budget, and timeline.
Experience with scheduling, facilitating, and documenting collaborative small and large group meetings.
Experience with preparing for and presenting to project teams and partners.
Strong organizational skills including attention to detail and time management.
Ability to work under pressure and meet timelines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years in a project management role including experience in the Consumer Lending industry.
Experience with Microsoft Project, other project management tools, program and resource management applications.
Working understanding of project management disciplines: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.

Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including:

Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
15 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) to start + 1 additional personal holiday
401k + employer match
Company provided Life Insurance & Long Term Disability
Employee Assistance Program - Confidential mental health support

Additional benefits with Republic Finance include:

Access to LinkedIn Learning's library of 10,000+ professional development courses
Employee of the Month Program
Philanthropic support for multiple charities including an annual drive for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
Regular drawings for Sports tickets
Professional offices with a friendly team environment

For more information about Wilco Group, please visit our website: www.wilcogroupllc.com

100% Remote Position. 
Preference Given to Candidates in the DMV area (DC-MD-VA) in case requirements ever change.

Salary Range:
$ 130-140k

Requirements :

If you do not fulfill these requirements, please do not apply.

·       US Citizenship
: You must be a citizen and must be able to obtain Public Trust Clearance.
·       Experience
: At least 7 years; preferably with 5 years on Cloud projects (AWS, Azure) such that working with DevSecOps engineers is seamless.
·       Education
: Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
·       Skills
: Must have strong understanding of Agile methodologies, techniques, and scrum ceremonies as well as be adept with Agile collaboration tools like Jira and Confluence.
·       Strong communication skills:
Even though this is remote work; you must be fully engaged with the team and be able to drive team excellence.

Important Certification(s):
 Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent (if you do not already have this, Wilco Group is willing to sponsor you to take the 2-day remote course).  Having hands-on experience and PM skills is more important than the certification itself (e.g., if you have the certification, but do not have a lot of experience – this role is *not* for you).

Summary :
Responsible for managing and delivering a technical cloud operations and maintenance project with ~6 team members (Lead Architect, DevSecOps engineers, security engineer). This role involves running scrum agile ceremonies, collaborating with engineering teams, and customer stakeholders to drive the successful execution of Product development, manage risks, ensure alignment with business goals, and deliver incremental business value through working software.

Key Responsibilities :

1.    Agile Project Management:

·      Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including engineering teams, product managers, and external partners.
·      Monitor product development progress, identify potential issues, and implement corrective actions as needed.
·      Work with team members to create a monthly status report (MSR) for the customer
·      Act as the primary point of contact for project-related communications.
·      Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews, and sprint retrospectives.
·      Ensure that Scrum events are productive and focused on achieving the team’s objectives.
·      Provide guidance to the team on Scrum practices, principles, and Agile methodologies.
·      Help team members understand their roles and responsibilities within the Scrum framework.
·      Mentor team members and stakeholders to foster an Agile mindset and culture.
·      Identify and address obstacles that hinder the team’s progress and productivity.
·      Work with stakeholders and external teams to resolve issues impacting the team’s ability to deliver.
·      Foster a collaborative environment within the team and between teams.
·      Encourage open communication, transparency, and a culture of continuous improvement.
·      Collaborate with Product Owners to ensure the product backlog is well-defined, prioritized, and understood by the team.
·      Assist in the refinement and breakdown of user stories and backlog items.
·      Track and report on key Agile metrics, such as velocity, sprint burndown, and cycle time.
·      Provide insights and recommendations based on metrics to improve team performance and delivery.
·      Encourage and facilitate regular retrospectives to identify areas for improvement.
·      Support the team in implementing process improvements and experimenting with new approaches.
·      Act as a liaison between the Scrum team and external stakeholders.
·      Ensure that the team’s progress and challenges are communicated effectively to stakeholders.
2.     Technical Leadership:

·      Collaborate with technical teams to understand technical requirements, constraints, and dependencies.
·      Provide guidance and support on technical issues and project-related decisions.
·      Ensure technical solutions align with overall project goals and business objectives.
3.    Risk Management:

·      Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
·      Proactively address issues and roadblocks that may impact project timelines or deliverables.
·      Escalate critical issues to senior management as necessary.
4.    Process Improvement:

·      Evaluate and improve project management processes and methodologies.
·      Implement best practices for project planning, execution, and delivery.
·      Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the team.
5.    Documentation and Reporting:

·      Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including product roadmaps, status reports, and risk logs.
·      Prepare and present reports to senior management and other stakeholders.
·      Ensure accurate and timely documentation of project deliverables and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile/Scrum) is a plus.
Experience:
7+ years of experience in technical program management or project management roles within a Cloud-based technology environment.
Technical Skills:
Strong understanding of software development processes, methodologies (Agile, Scrum), and technical architectures.
Project Management:
Proven track record of managing complex technical projects from inception to completion.
Leadership:
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage stakeholder expectations.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to risk management.
Tools:
Proficiency in Agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Mural) and productivity software (e.g., Microsoft Office, SharePoint).

Differentiators (experience that will make your application stand out):

Experience with cloud technologies and platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
Familiarity with data-driven decision-making and performance metrics.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to convey STRONG COMMUNICATION SKILLS during the interview process.

The Whole Package: 

Premium health benefits (including medical, dental, and vision coverage);
Competitive 401k plan with matching;
Ability to telework using government-issued equipment (with home office stipend);
Professional growth and development opportunities (with training stipend);
Paid sick leave, vacation, and Federal holidays;
Competitive market salary

and be able to obtain a Public Trust Clearance from the U.S. government. Public trust security clearance investigations are managed by the U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Project Manager

Drive Operational Excellence

At Ashurst Perkins Coie US LLP

, our people are our greatest asset. We’re looking for a collaborative, detail-oriented Project Manager

to join our Projects and Programs team and help deliver an exceptional employee experience.

In this role, the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) drives firmwide initiatives across technology, HR, marketing, finance, and practice management. The EPMO leads projects spanning new applications, strategic planning, process improvement, and policy development—bringing technical know-how, legal industry insight, and strong project management to turn ideas into impact.

What You’ll Do

Project Management and Leadership

Independently manage complex technical and strategic projects across firm departments and practice groups, translating roadmaps into measurable results. Apply expertise in stakeholder management,

planning, scope and schedule management, communications, risk and issue resolution, vendor management, budget control, and program management.

Plan and Mobilize: Develop project charters, plans, schedules, resource strategies, and team expectations using the firm’s project management methodology.
Drive Scope and Delivery: Define and control scope, establish project baselines, manage schedules, and negotiate changes to keep initiatives aligned with objectives.
Lead Change and Communication: Build change management and communication plans; deliver clear status updates, recommendations, and insights to sponsors, stakeholders, and senior leadership.
Manage Risk and Issues: Identify risks early, implement mitigation strategies, and drive issues to resolution using proven project management practices.
Manage Vendors: Coordinate contracts, approvals, performance, and vendor relationships in partnership with procurement, business owners, and subject matter experts.
Own Budgets: Develop project estimates, manage expenses against approved budgets, and provide clear financial reporting.
Orchestrate Programs: Coordinate interconnected projects, managing dependencies, risks, issues, and priorities across business areas.
Exercise Leadership: Serve as an independent, decisive problem solver who brings sound judgment, agility, and accountability to complex initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

Agility and Adaptability: Ability to thrive in ambiguity, quickly adapting strategies and priorities to keep projects moving.
Executive Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly communicate proposals, risks, and outcomes to senior leaders.
Collaboration and Organization: Highly organized and effective coordination of cross-functional teams and leadership stakeholders.
Negotiation and Influence: Skilled negotiation with a proven ability to secure resources and build alignment across teams.
Strategic Execution: Experience with structuring complex or undefined initiatives, creating practical approaches that keep projects aligned to objectives.
Project and Time Management: Effective management of multiple projects while balancing scope, schedule, budget, resources, and competing priorities.
Financial Acumen: Development of accurate time, resource, and cost estimates and management of projects to budget.
Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a solutions-oriented mindset.
Facilitation: Expert facilitation of design, process improvement, decision-making, and technical and project closeout sessions—driving clear recommendations and decisive outcomes.
The position requires a minimum of five years of Project Management experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within a PMO and partnering with Business Systems Analysts.
Working knowledge of PMBOK and modern project management practices.
Familiarity with SDLC, Scrum, Agile, and other software development methodologies.
Proven experience with vendor management, project budgeting, and resource planning.
Proficiency with project management methodologies and tools, including Smartsheet and Visio.
Skill in developing and applying work breakdown structures for effective planning, estimating, and execution.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field.
Formal training in project management, risk management, and negotiation is highly desirable.
PMP or comparable certification is preferred but not required.

Why Join Ashurst Perkins Coie?

Join a collaborative, high-performing Projects and Programs team where your expertise will help shape the employee experience across our global organization. In this role, if you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and making a lasting impact, you will find meaningful opportunities to grow your career while helping create an outstanding experience for our people.

This position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, medical, dental, and vision insurance, accrued paid time off plan starting at 20 days annually, personal medical and parental leave, up to 10 paid holidays, and family care benefits. More information regarding benefits and programs may be found here .

This position may be filled in the following locations. The listed compensation range reflects the typical pay for this role, though it is rare for new hires to receive an offer at the top of the range. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, skills, market conditions, and internal equity.

Colorado compensation range: $106,080.00 to $164,120.00 annually

jobs.description:
Overview

Longenecker & Associates (L&A), a Geosyntec Company, is a trusted partner enabling critical missions across the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) complex for more than 30 years. We contribute to DOE’s nuclear security and environmental remediation enterprise by providing the highest-caliber staff and experts. We are seeking a motivated Technical Project Manager 4
to contribute to our mission supporting our remote
work at Los Alamos National Lab in Los Alamos, NM.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits, and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit: http://www.geosyntec.com/careers/ .

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Technical Project Manager (TPM) 4
is responsible for managing and ensuring timely completion of discrete technical project scope. This role manages technical requirements; defines and oversees project deliverables, budgets, schedules, and risks; while supporting and in most cases leads the project team in planning, tracking, and executing scope from initiation through turnover.

Duties Include But Are Not Limited To

TPM 4 manages project related activities in alignment with Triad prime contract and customer National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) requirements;
Activities are organized into control accounts and subsequent work packages, which define tasks necessary to satisfy programmatic needs;
TPM 4 reports to the Project Program Director and is responsible for day-to-day administrative and operational management within an assigned program area;
This includes development, implementation, and evaluation of policies, procedures, and standards; determining program service levels and enhancements; assisting in the development and monitoring of program budgets; and providing technical guidance to project teams, support departments, and matrixed resources; and
All scope managed by the TPM 4 is being performed within DOE Hazard Category 2, Security Classification 1 facility .

Education and Licensure

Bachelor’s degree in related field of study. (required)

Skills, Experience And Qualifications

At least 12 years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education and experience. (required)
Prior experience, prior nuclear facility and/or laboratory experience. (required)
Due to federal contract security requirements, this position requires U.S. Citizenship. (required)

jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

The Opportunity

We're doing an AI-first engineering rebuild for a company that already has an audience of 100M+ people. This is a zero-to-one build with no legacy constraints, multiple workstreams running in parallel, and a hard launch deadline. You're not here to run status meetings. You're here to make sure nothing falls through the cracks across internal engineering teams, external development partners, and a product that millions of people will use the day it ships.

The Product

You'll be the execution backbone of the Beast membership app, coordinating across Beast's internal engineering teams, our game development partners, and multiple vendors, ensuring every workstream is tightly aligned, every handoff is clean, and every risk is surfaced and resolved before it becomes a blocker. That means:

A complex multi-vendor, multi-team program where alignment gaps and handoff failures directly threaten the launch timeline.
Integration milestones that require meticulous tracking, structured check-ins, and proactive escalation when things slip.
A fast-moving engineering org that needs someone who can bring rigor without slowing down velocity.

What You'll Do

Own the program plan end to end across internal teams and external partners, covering milestones, dependencies, risks, and blockers.
Drive structured weekly check-ins with all key leads, ensuring alignment on integration milestones and surfacing issues early enough to course correct.
Enforce handoff standards so nothing ships without the receiving team being fully ready, including documentation, onboarding sessions, and acceptance criteria locked before any handoff closes.
Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product, and vendor partners, translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders and escalating to exec leadership when needed.
Build and maintain a "can't fail" execution culture by proactively identifying risks, owning follow-through, and holding teams accountable without micromanaging.

Who You Are

Execution-Obsessed: You run tight programs. You know the difference between a status update and actually moving something forward, and you default to the latter.
Multi-Vendor Experience: You've managed programs involving external development partners or contractors alongside internal engineering teams, and you know how to hold vendors accountable without burning the relationship.
Technical Depth: You're comfortable going deep enough to understand engineering dependencies, integration risks, and technical handoff requirements. You don't need to write the code, but you need to know when something isn't right.
Clear Communicator: You can run a crisp leadership sync, write a structured escalation memo, and tell a VP exactly what's at risk and what needs to happen, all in the same day.
Startup Ready: You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and know how to build a process that enables velocity rather than slowing it down.

5+ years of TPM or program management experience in a technical environment, with at least 2 years managing programs involving external vendors or development partners. Bonus points for experience in consumer app development, media or entertainment technology, or managing game SDK or mobile framework integrations.

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

Competitive Salary
Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance
Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
Company-provided technology package
Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager- ML
jobs.description:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.

About the Role

Our Perception & AI/ML organization runs several research and engineering programs at once, and they converge on the same robots in the same customer deployments. Priorities shift — that is the nature of the work — and when they do, someone needs to know what the shift costs, who it affects, and what we tell the customer.

That is this role. You will be the connective layer between what customers need, what the company has committed to, and what the research and engineering teams are actually building. You will report directly to the VP leading Perception & AI/ML and work closely with the broader leadership team.

This is not a process-administration job. You will be expected to hold an accurate picture of a large, fast-moving technical organization, form your own view of what is at risk, and say so early — including when that is unwelcome.

What You'll Do

Own the program-level picture across concurrent research and engineering workstreams: what is in flight, who owns it, what is due, and what is slipping.

Translate customer and product requirements into prioritized internal work, and keep delivery timelines honest against what has been committed externally.

Serve as a program-level point of contact for customer deployments — carrying their needs inward, and carrying status, tradeoffs, and timelines back out.

Surface risks and blockers before they become schedule problems, and drive them to resolution across teams.

Run the re-prioritization conversations when commitments change: what continues, what pauses, what gets reassigned, and who needs to hear about it.

Build reporting and tracking that engineers will actually maintain — enough signal to steer by, light enough to survive a fast quarter.

Partner with senior technical leads and the leadership team without directing the technical approach.

What You Have

4–7 years as a Technical Program Manager or equivalent, supporting AI/ML or data-driven engineering teams.

Experience across the AI/ML lifecycle — data collection and labeling, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders, turning their needs into internal priorities and timelines.

A demonstrated track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving technical programs.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, or related), or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart

Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, drones, embedded systems, or another autonomy domain.

Experience supporting AI/ML programs at scale inside a larger technology organization — recommendations, ranking, ads, or consumer AI.

Background in data operations, data security, or systems integration.

Experience supporting field operations or production customer deployments.

Comfort acting as a trusted technical point of contact for customers in mission-critical deployments.

Fluency with Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace — and the judgment to keep tooling minimal.

PMP, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.

Startup or high-growth experience, with a strong bias toward ownership and urgency.

Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?

In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.

You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.

Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution

jobs.description:
Maven AGI is an enterprise AI platform on a mission to unleash business artificial general intelligence (AGI), starting with customer service. Founded in July 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents capable of delivering accurate, autonomous support that delights customers at scale.

Our platform unifies fragmented systems, integrates knowledge and personalization sources, and enables intelligent actions - all without costly system changes. We’re laying the foundation for a future where our technology handles complex tasks, allowing people to focus on what they do best: creative problem-solving, relationship building, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

We’ve started by reimagining the enterprise customer experience with a support use case. We believe that today’s support experience is broken: slow and painful for customers, and expensive and human capital intensive for companies.

We are building Maven to deliver better, cheaper support, for both end users and agents. With recent advancements in Generative AI, it is now possible to deliver delightful customer experiences at a fraction of today’s cost.

Team

Maven has assembled a world-class team of Engineers from Google, Meta, Amazon, and Stripe, and is supported by executives & Advisors from OpenAI, Google, HubSpot, and Stripe.

About The Role

This role is the operational and technical backbone of Maven's most complex, highest-stakes customer implementations. It exists because the work requires someone who is simultaneously a builder, a tracker, and a communicator who won't let things fall through the cracks.

What You'll Do

Owns execution end-to-end on strategic pilots. Not coordination, ownership. You'll track every open item across customer-facing trackers and internal tools (Linear, ClickUp, Notion), know what's blocked, know who needs to be chased down, and drive things to resolution without being asked. Tickets are clean, unambiguous, and mapped correctly. You don't wait for someone to flag a gap, you catch it first.
Understands the platform deeply enough to be useful, not just present. You know Maven's platform and how it interacts with external systems. You can debug a broken integration, read an API error and know where the problem lives, recognize when an intelligent field evaluation is causing a downstream cascade, and describe what's wrong clearly enough that an engineer can fix it immediately. You won't need hand-holding on the technical environment.
Translates between customer and engineering. You join working sessions with customers and come out with crisp, actionable documentation. You write the kind of meeting notes and tickets that engineers want to work from. You understand what customers are trying to accomplish, can spot when a request is misframed, and know when to push back internally versus when to escalate.
Tests relentlessly before go-live. You run test suites, document what broke and why, validate fixes, and track edge cases with rigor.
Runs the operational rhythm. Daily standups, go-live checklists, readiness reviews, metrics readouts — you own the structure that keeps a complex multi-team pilot from going sideways. You're the person who notices when the ClickUp tracker hasn't been updated and fixes it before the Monday client session, not after.

Who You Are

Organized to the point of being vocal about it.
Technically credible without being an engineer.
Comfortable sitting in rooms with enterprise stakeholders and with product engineers on the same day.
Does not need external motivation to chase someone down when something is stuck.
Gets things done.

What We Offer

High Impact in cutting-edge field: Be at the vanguard of AI innovation.
Compensation Package: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity stakes.
Inclusive Culture: A diverse and welcoming work environment where everyone’s voice is heard.

What unites us are our values and the passion we share to live by them:

Do right for our customers
We are data-driven
Be entrepreneurial
Strive to be better, together

jobs.description:
At American Vision Partners (AVP)
, we partner with the most respected ophthalmology practices in the country and integrate best-in-class management systems, operational infrastructure, and advanced technology to provide the highest quality patient care possible. Our practices include Barnet Dulaney Perkins Eye Center, Southwestern Eye Center, Retinal Consultants of Arizona, M&M Eye Institute, Abrams Eye Institute, Southwest Eye Institute, Aiello Eye Institute, Moretsky Cassidy Vision Correction, Wellish Vision Institute, West Texas Eye Associates and Vantage Eye Center. We are focused on building the nation’s largest and most comprehensive eye care practices and currently operate more than 100 eye care centers in Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, California and Texas – including 25 ambulatory surgical centers.

At AVP we value teamwork, providing exceptional experiences, continuous improvement, financial strength, and hard work. We are committed to providing best-in-class patient care, pioneering research and technology, and most importantly, rewarding and recognizing our employees!

Overview

The Project Manager is responsible for leading complex business, operational, technology, and acquisition integration initiatives across the organization. This role serves as a strategic bridge between Applications, IT, and business leadership, ensuring successful execution of projects that improve operational efficiency, integrate new capabilities, and support organizational growth. The Project Manager (PM) drives project governance, change management, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of new practices while delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

Responsibilities

Serve as the PM lead for strategic projects and technology initiatives, driving them from intake through implementation and closeout while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and stakeholders.
Act as the primary liaison between Applications/IT and departmental leaders to ensure value is delivered from technology initiatives through discovery, testing, and adoption of new processes and solutions.
Collaborate as an Applications/IT partner with the Diligence & Integration team to successfully plan and execute acquisition integrations.
Manage multiple concurrent projects while effectively prioritizing competing business and technology needs.
Develop and maintain standardized processes and documentation for project execution, leveraging EPMO best practices to enhance efficiency and scalability.
Drive program integrity and stability by maintaining EPMO governance, documentation, practices, templates, policies, tools, and partnerships that improve organizational project delivery capabilities.
Work autonomously to manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, from discovery and data collection to field trials, implementation planning and deployment, ensuring smooth execution across all phases.
Lead project meetings while preparing and maintaining clear project documentation, presentations, action logs, status reports, and executive summaries.
Facilitate accountability across departments by tracking action items, monitoring commitments, and ensuring task completion.
Direct and coordinate cross-functional team resources, resolve project conflicts, and escalate obstacles and risks to leadership when necessary.
Track issues and risks while ensuring resolution through probing questions; actively identify and support teams in removing obstacles, waste, and distractions that may impede project delivery.
Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and executive leadership regarding project status, milestones, risks, issues, resource constraints, scope changes, dependencies, and key decisions.
Ensure effective organizational readiness by coordinating communication, training, and change management activities that support successful project adoption and minimize operational disruption.
Coordinate with vendors, third-party partners, and internal technical teams to support system implementations, integrations, migrations, and other technology-related initiatives.
Partner with FP&A to track project budgets, integration costs, anticipated synergies, and realization timelines.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Health Care

Administration, or other related field.

3+ years project management or equivalent experience
Project management experience in healthcare preferred
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) preferred
ADKAR training preferred
Experience working with and presenting deliverables to an executive-level leadership team
IT experience preferred, with an understanding of software development process, system implementations, application integrations, infrastructure environments, and the ability to effectively partner with technical teams.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a solution-oriented approach.
Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
Thorough understanding of project management phases, techniques and tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships while working in a moderately complex and matrixed team environment.
Ability to facilitate discussions and hold team members accountable without having positional authority.
Ability to handle multiple tasks, set priorities, schedule and meet deadlines.
Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Possess quality presentation skills and experience in presenting complex plans and designs to executive-level leadership.

Benefits & Perks

Your health, happiness and your future matters! At AVP, we offer everything from medical and dental insurance, significant eye care discounts, child care assistance, pet insurance, continuing education funds, 401(k), paid holidays, PTO, Sick Time, opportunity for growth, and much more!

We combine our expertise in space electronics with right-sized development processes to create innovative, high-performance space-based electronic systems that meet our customers' evolving needs.

We are a mission partner supporting DoD, Intelligence Community, and Civil space customers. We develop complex, radiation effects mitigated, designs that balance competing requirements in modern space programs, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enable our customers to achieve more in space.

Position Summary

Trident seeks an Operations Program Manager that will lead day-to-day Operations execution of activities that support Space Electronic Systems. This position reports directly to the Trident Operations Director in Chantilly and Sterling, VA.

The position will lead and coordinate cross-functional programs within the manufacturing operations department. This role requires a strong leader who can manage multiple projects, drive process improvements, and ensure that all operational goals are met efficiently and effectively. The Operations Program Manager will work closely with production, supply chain, quality assurance, and engineering teams to align activities with business objectives and deliver high-quality results on time and within budget.

Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality. Utilize Lean, Six Sigma, or other methodologies as appropriate

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for key programs and products, serving as the central integrator between program, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and operations timelines.

This position partners cross-functionally to ensure alignment between engineering schedules, supply chain lead times, and delivery commitments in a dynamic, high-mix NPI manufacturing environment.

What You'll Do

Own the IMS. Develop Integrated Master Schedules for products, programs, capabilities, and production sites. Sequence development, procurement, construction, equipment installation, and qualification activities across concurrent NPI and factory-buildout workstreams for feasible schedules.
Own updates and ensure the schedule is a trusted tool for decision-making and reliable source of valid data.
Track schedule performance against baseline, proactively identifying risk, quantifying impacts of changes, and surfacing key insights. Drive solutioning to achieve milestones and maintain delivery commitments.
Facilitate cross-functional schedule reviews and ensure stakeholder alignment on milestone dates, deliverables, and resource trade-offs. Drive accountability for on-time delivery.
Support definition of scheduling philosophy, standards, and patterns. Systematize and automate to efficiently scale scheduling.

What We’re Looking For

7+ years of experience in integrated scheduling, project management, or engineering or manufacturing planning.
Demonstrated experience developing and managing an Integrated Master Schedule.
Strong knowledge of scheduling methodologies and principles, including for estimating durations and qualifying risk.
Experience using scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheets, etc) and building automations and connectors.
Ability to partner with stakeholders and drive accountability. Strong communicator and relationship builder.

What Will Set You Apart

Experience in development and scaling phases of aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other complex hardware manufacturing industries.
Undeterred by ambiguity and proven delivery of meaningful outcomes.
Ability to bring structure and process to fast-paced environments while maintaining velocity
Experience supporting multi-site or multi-program production environments and/or working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar analytics tools.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $160,000-$220,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

401k

Flexible vacation policy
Equity

jobs.title: Program Manager, Security GRC
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Stripe Security team is dedicated to improving the security of Stripe and its users. Our users trust us with some of their most sensitive information, and we make security a first-class consideration in everything we do. Security concerns are ever-evolving, creating an extremely dynamic environment for the Security team.

The Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SGRC) team at Stripe provides security governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities to allow Stripe to make strategic security decisions, measure our risk and control posture, and represent Stripe Security to internal and external entities. The successful operation of our organization accelerates Stripe by optimizing the communication and expectations of our security program.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Security GRC Program Manager with deep expertise in security compliance to serve as the primary interface between Stripe's Security organization and external auditors, regulators, and compliance stakeholders. In this role, you'll represent the Security team in audit engagements, articulate how Stripe's security controls are designed and how they operate, and ensure that compliance obligations across a complex global regulatory landscape are met with consistency and rigor.

In this role, you will act as a proxy between external entities like regulators and auditors, and our internal security teams, ensuring consistency in compliance responses and helping maintain a lean and effective compliance program. The ideal candidate is adaptable and finds structure in an evolving and maturing organization.

Responsibilities

Act as an information security subject matter expert during cross-functional audit engagements, representing the Security team in walkthrough meetings with auditors and regulators
Serve as the internal liaison (proxy) between and the Security organization to ensure audits are managed effectively and consistently
Create and maintain a central repository of audit evidence artifacts required for compliance with SOC 2, PCI DSS, SOX, and other global regulatory standards
Perform security risk and control assessments against common frameworks to ensure compliance with Stripe's Information Security Policy and Standards and applicable regulations (e.g., ISO 2700x, PCI DSS, SOX, NIST, COBIT)
Support control owners with guidance on security control design and redesign to ensure continued compliance and effectiveness
Facilitate security compliance support for Stripe's legal entities with regulatory obligations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to track and report on control remediation efforts
Support broader GRC team program initiatives, including policy writing, security awareness training, and third-party security risk assessments

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

Subject matter expert in information security frameworks, practices, policies, standards, and procedures (e.g., NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/2, or equivalent)
6+ years of experience in Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance or Technology Compliance roles with a strong understanding of audit processes
Exposure to global regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA, FFIEC, EBA, NYDFS) and experience integrating them into compliance programs
Experience conducting security audits and supporting compliance across complex, overlapping regulatory frameworks
Strong program management skills with proficiency in coordinating security assessments and managing multiple stakeholder engagements across time zones
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build relationships at all levels and translate technical security concepts for auditors, regulators, and executive audiences

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $161,300 - $241,900. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

Location: Alexandria, VA

Accrete is an agentic managed services company: an AI workforce that does high-stakes, judgement-heavy work for government and enterprise clients — at the economics of software, not labor.

At the core is Accrete’s Knowledge Engine, a dynamic context graph that captures an organization’s tacit knowledge, resolves data across silos, and builds a living, auditable ground truth. Expert agents reason against that ground truth to act on complex, high-stakes decisions — not just answer questions about them.

From national security to commercial operations, Accrete delivers the work on one platform, with unlimited expert agents and expert judgement.

The Role

As a Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for coordinating the delivery of complex technology programs from planning through deployment. You will work closely with software engineers, AI/ML teams, product managers, government customers, and leadership to ensure projects remain aligned with technical requirements, customer objectives, timelines, and budgets.

This is a highly execution-oriented role. You should be comfortable communicating and managing high-touch relationships with Government Senior Executives, Contracting Officers, Contracting Officer Technical Representatives, and industry partners. You will be expected to direct and manage technical teams, understand “the realm of the possible” with AI software, AI development lifecycles, identify project risks, manage dependencies, and translate customer requirements to technology implementation teams inside and outside of Accrete.

The ideal candidate is organized, technically fluent, and able to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and requirements can evolve.

What You'll Do

Project Management

Own day-to-day execution of complex technical projects and programs
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies
Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, AI/ML, product, data, security, and customer organizations

Manage technical dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
Facilitate project planning, standups, technical reviews, status meetings, and retrospectives

Establish project priorities and ensure teams remain aligned on the highest-impact work
Escalate issues appropriately and drive them toward resolution
Identify opportunities to improve project execution and delivery processes
Help standardize program management practices across Accrete Government

Manage client relationships and communications at the Senior Executive to the ultimate end user level
Translate customer requirements and mission objectives into actionable technical project plans
Manage customer expectations around scope, schedule, priorities, and technical dependencies
Track contractual deliverables, milestones, and program commitments
Prepare and deliver program status updates to internal and external stakeholders
Support customer meetings, technical demonstrations, testing, deployment, and acceptance activities
Ensure project execution remains aligned with government security, compliance, and operational requirements

Technical Coordination

Develop a strong understanding of the technical architecture, capabilities, and limitations of Accrete's products
Work closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements, implementation challenges, and delivery timelines
Help translate product and customer requirements into actionable engineering work
Help ensure technical documentation and project artifacts remain current and accurate

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in leading teams, technical project management, program management, engineering project management, or a related role
Willingness to work 50% - 100% time on client site
Experience managing complex technical projects involving software, data, AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, or other technology
Experience working directly with engineering and technical teams
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and modern engineering practices
Ability to understand technical requirements, system dependencies, and engineering constraints
Strong project planning, organizational, and execution skills
Experience managing multiple projects, workstreams, or stakeholders simultaneously
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers as well as senior executives and government customers
Experience identifying and managing project risks, dependencies, and blockers
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain organization across complex programs
Ability to operate independently and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment
Active TS/SCI clearance with a Counterintelligence or Lifestyle Polygraph

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting the Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other federal customers
Experience working in a government contracting or national security environment
Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or other modern software development methodologies
Experience with Microsoft Project or similar project management tools
PMP, CSM, or similar certification
Experience working in classified, secure, or air-gapped environments
Ability to obtain and maintain additional security clearance accesses to Special Access Programs (SAP) or Access Compensatory Control Measures (ACCM)

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means technical teams are aligned, projects are moving forward, risks are surfaced early, and customer commitments are consistently delivered
.

You will serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product, leadership, and government customers. You won't be expected to write the code yourself, but you should be technically fluent enough to understand what engineering teams are building, identify potential issues, ask the right questions, and keep complex technical projects on track.

The strongest candidates will be highly organized operators who can bring structure to ambiguous problems, communicate clearly across technical and non-technical teams, and take ownership of getting projects across the finish line.

Why Accrete Government

Work on advanced AI capabilities supporting U.S. government and national security missions
Partner directly with engineering, AI, and product teams
Own the execution of high-impact technical programs
Work directly with government customers and mission stakeholders
Help deploy cutting-edge technology into real-world operational environments
Operate in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership and impact

Salary
: 185k-225k

Impact

You take full ownership and accountability for your work, consistently seeing projects through from inception to completion with a strong bias for action. Proactively identifying challenges, you drive solutions rather than waiting for direction, and hold yourself and others to the highest standards for delivering results. With strategic thinking and a problem-solving mindset, you make informed decisions leveraging data and expertise, always looking for ways to improve processes, optimize workflows, and enhance outcomes beyond your immediate responsibilities.

Collaboration

You work seamlessly across teams, prioritizing shared goals and team success over individual credit. Engaged listening and open, candid communication are at the heart of your approach, ensuring alignment and synergy throughout the organization. You value diverse perspectives, seeking input from others to drive better results. By treating colleagues with respect and professionalism, you help build a culture of trust, supporting each other through challenges, celebrating successes, and constructively addressing conflicts to strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

Passion for AI & Innovation

You are deeply excited about the transformative potential of AI and committed to contributing to a company shaping the future of work. With curiosity and a growth mindset, you continuously seek to learn, adapt, and stay at the forefront of new developments. Your enthusiasm for innovation drives you to explore new ideas, challenge the status quo, and find creative solutions that deliver meaningful impact. You approach your work with energy and a desire to advance both technology and the way we work.
