jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager, Lob Logistics
jobs.description:
Lob was founded in 2013 by technical co-founders with a vision to connect the world one mailbox at a time. Today, we're transforming the way businesses use direct mail and bringing the power of technology to a traditionally manual channel.

Our modern logistics and fulfillment engine helps businesses to build and scale high-quality, personalized direct mail programs without the operational burden. As we grow to meet the evolving needs of our customers and expand our product offerings, we’re building a team to shape the future of direct mail.

Technical Implementation Manager, Lob Logistics

About The Role

Lob Logistics is looking for a Technical Implementation Manager to lead the technical onboarding and integration of new customers and logistics partners.

You will own customer integrations from verbal commitment through launch and the first 30 days in production. You will work directly with customer technical, operational, and postal teams to understand their workflows, design the integration, configure APIs and customer profiles, troubleshoot issues, coordinate postal requirements, and ensure the solution works successfully in production.

Lob Logistics is intentionally built around a white-glove customer experience
. Our customers are often integrating complex technology, production, postal, and logistics workflows, and we believe the best implementations require more than handing customers documentation and asking them to integrate themselves. The Technical Implementation Manager will work closely with customers throughout the process, including traveling onsite when appropriate for project scoping, technical working sessions, testing, and finalizing integrations.

This is a hands-on technical role. You should be comfortable working with APIs, data, developer tools, and AI coding tools such as Claude Code. We are looking for someone who can solve technical problems directly rather than simply coordinate work between customers and Engineering.

The right person will be equally comfortable sitting with a customer’s engineering team to design an integration, troubleshooting an API or data issue, working with a commingling partner on postal requirements, and walking a customer through the final steps required to successfully launch.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Implementations

Own new Lob Logistics customer implementations from verbal commitment through the first 30 days in production.
Lead technical discovery and scoping with customers, including understanding their existing systems, mail workflows, data requirements, production needs, postage strategy, billing and integration architecture.
Travel to customer locations as appropriate to lead project scoping, technical working sessions, implementation planning, testing, and final integration activities. This role will have regular, consistent travel.
Develop and document the technical implementation plan and define requirements, dependencies, testing criteria, and launch readiness.
Configure customer profiles and integrations across Lob Logistics systems working with commingle partners on integrations.
Own testing, UAT, go-live, and the first 30 days of production stabilization before transitioning the customer to the long-term account owner.
Maintain a high-touch, white-glove approach throughout implementation, ensuring customers have a clear technical owner who remains accountable from initial scoping through a successful production launch.

Build & Troubleshoot Integrations

Work directly with customers to integrate with Lob Logistics through our APIs or customer portal.
Understand and troubleshoot API requests, JSON payloads, authentication, webhooks, data mappings, and integration errors.
Use Claude Code and other development tools to navigate code, investigate issues, build scripts and utilities, create working examples, and accelerate customer integrations.
Identify whether technical issues originate with the customer, Lob, a partner, data, configuration, or the underlying integration and drive them to resolution.
Look for opportunities to automate repetitive implementation work and build tools that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

Scope Technical Solutions

Determine when customer requirements can be solved through configuration or existing capabilities and when custom development is required.
Scope custom technical requirements and partner with Product and Engineering on solutions requiring platform changes.
Provide clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical context to Engineering.
Partner with the implementation project manager to ensure technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and timelines are reflected in the broader implementation plan.

Own Postal & Partner Setup

Coordinate the technical and operational requirements necessary to successfully move customer mail through Lob Logistics.
Ensure customer implementations meet USPS and commingling requirements, including PAFs, postal promotions, customer profiles, mail owner and mail service provider configurations, and other applicable requirements.
Work directly with Lob’s commingling partners on new customer setup and ensure all technical, operational, and postal requirements are completed before launch.
Partner with internal postal subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required while maintaining ownership of the overall implementation.
Ensure the customer’s technical integration works across the entire physical mail workflow, not simply at the point of API acceptance.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, technical consulting, implementation strategy, solutions architecture, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role working with technology and systems.
Strong understanding of how business systems, applications, and data integrations work together, with familiarity with concepts such as APIs, data flows, authentication, and system integrations.
Experience in direct mail, print manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, shipping, payments, EDI, or another environment where software connects to complex physical operations.
Understanding of USPS mail preparation, Intelligent Mail barcodes, PostalOne!, Mail.dat/Mail.XML, PAF requirements, postal promotions, commingling, drop shipping, or destination entry.
Experience working with customers to understand their existing technology landscape, identify requirements, and recommend practical solution approaches.
Ability to translate ambiguous customer needs and business processes into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and implementation plans.
Comfortable partnering with customer engineers, IT teams, and internal technical resources to guide integrations and troubleshoot implementation challenges.
Ability to identify potential technical risks, dependencies, and gaps and coordinate with the appropriate engineering or technical teams to resolve them.

As a Digital Business Analyst (Data & AI Projects)
, you will play a key role in helping Ofgem realise the value of its digital, data and AI investments. Working across multidisciplinary teams, you will understand and analyse business needs, data challenges and operational processes to support the design and delivery of data-enabled products and services that improve outcomes for colleagues, consumers and the organisation.

Acting as a bridge between business and technical stakeholders, you will help shape solutions that are aligned with user needs, organisational priorities, governance requirements and regulatory requirements.

This is a highly collaborative role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, engaging with stakeholders and driving meaningful change through data and technology.

You will be responsible for:

Undertaking research and analysis to understand how business areas operate, with a particular focus on data, processes, systems, people and technology.
Ensuring new products, data services and process changes meet business needs and align with strategic objectives.
Understanding and assessing the impact of business, policy, security, regulatory and governance constraints and their implications for data usage and service design.
Working within architectural guidelines, data standards and governance frameworks to support the development of pragmatic and scalable solutions.
Working with stakeholders to understand data-related challenges and opportunities and support the development of effective, user-centred solutions.
Identifying, analysing and documenting business and user needs, translating them into clear, testable requirements.
Collaborating with business and technical teams throughout discovery, design, development and testing activities.
Using structured analysis techniques to support scoping, options analysis and decision making.
Lead the business analysis for small to medium data-related projects and AI proof-of-concept initiatives. Support larger programmes by contributing analysis under guidance.

We are looking for:

A collaborative, analytical and delivery-focused Business Analyst with experience working across digital, data and technology environments. You will be passionate about using data and insight to solve business problems and support better decision-making.
You will be confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels, building strong relationships and facilitating productive conversations between business and technical teams. Comfortable working across multiple initiatives and priorities, you will be skilled in gathering requirements, analysing complex information and translating needs into clear, actionable outcomes.
Experienced in delivering business analysis within agile and multidisciplinary environments, you will be able to assess opportunities, evaluate options and support the successful delivery of data-enabled products and services.

You will demonstrate:
Proven experience working as a Business Analyst within digital, data and technology environments, supporting the delivery of data-enabled products, services or change initiatives
Experience applying Agile business analysis approaches, including iterative delivery, agile requirements techniques, prioritisation, and continuous improvement.
BCS Practitioner Certificate or equivalent certification.
Strong understanding of data concepts, including data quality, metadata, lineage, integration, data modelling and analytics and the ability to apply these concepts to improve business outcomes and decision-making.
Experience analysing business processes, systems and data flows to identify opportunities for improvement, inform solution design and support evidence-based decision-making.
Experience adapting business analysis approaches, outputs, and ways of working to align with different delivery methodologies, project contexts and team needs.
Experience eliciting, reviewing and prioritising requirements, balancing business value, user needs with technical and operational constraints.
Experience in building effective working relationships with key stakeholders.
Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams to deliver successful digital, data and technology outcomes.

It would be beneficial if you also have experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Visio, BPMN, Miro or Trello.
This is an opportunity to play an important role in enabling Ofgem's digital, data and AI transformation. You will help shape innovative solutions that support the organisation's strategic ambitions while contributing to a more sustainable energy future at a time when our work has never been more important.

Person specification

Essential Criteria
Proven ability as a Business Analyst working in Data projects, within digital, data and technology environments. (Lead Criteria)

Proven experience of applying agile approaches to Business Analysis (e.g. working iteratively, agile requirements techniques, inspecting and adapting) (Lead Criteria)

BCS Practitioner Certificate (or comparable equivalent) (Lead Criteria)

Strong understanding of data concepts (quality, metadata, lineage, integration, data modelling, analytics) and how they affect business outcomes.

Experience using tools like JIRA, Confluence, Visio, BPMN, Miro, or Trello to support analysis and collaboration.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Provide Lessons Learned Program Support
Implement and maintain lessons learned processes at each designated place of performance in adherence with MCO 3504.1, the MCCLP
Review and submit lessons learned materials with proper classification and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings prior to submission to MCCLL SharePoint/Joint Lessons Learned Information system (JLLIS)
Maintain MCCLL SharePoint/JLLIS lessons learned web page content for topics within the cognizant of their designated command
Submit weekly situational reports
Provide Lessons Learned Collection and Analysis Support
Develop/implement the MCCLL annual lessons learned collection campaign plan
Prepare and submit lessons learned collection topics associated with designated Command, based on the analysis of lessons learned requirements
Prepare the mid-year review of the annual lessons learned collection campaign plan to revalidate existing topics, and solicit emerging topics as required
Prepare briefings for senior military and government officials on collection campaign topics
Develop and submit lessons learned collection proposals, collection plans and collection debriefs, per the annual collection campaign plan. Perform lessons learned collection efforts by conducting lessons learned interviews of commanders and staff, as approved in the collection plan, topic within the following prescribed parameters: 10 Focus areas per collection, 20 Interviewees per collection, 20 questions per interviewee, and 45 minutes per interviewee, during a 14-calendar day period
Utilize the MCCLL SharePoint Battle board to capture and document all aspects of the planning and execution of the annual lessons learned campaign plan
Provide Event Support
Prepare responses for lessons learned requests for information (RFI) for the planning and execution of operations, deployments, exercises, and experiments
Prepare units for exercises and operations by providing applicable lessons learned documentation from previous operations, exercises, deployments, and experiments
Collect and submit lessons learned materials (e.g., after-action reports) to MCCLL SharePoint for all Major operations, deployments, exercises, and experiments
Attend planning conferences, work group sessions, meetings and other seminars required to support the lessons learned planning aspects of operations, deployments, exercises, and experiments
Assist in the post event hot wash reviews
Submit and maintain designated units Training Exercise and Employment plans in MCCLL SharePoint. The TEEP information will sufficiently detail what is to be used to track AAR

submission requirements for completed events for the prior 6 months and forecast AAR submissions going forward 6 months.

Perform other duties as assigned

None.

Demonstrated experience in military operational planning
Ability to interact and effectively communicate with Marine Corps senior uniformed officers and senior executives
Excellent oral and written communications skills; writing ability commensurate with article submission to military publications; demonstrated expertise in military presentation

jobs.description:
Job Description And Duties

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to the safety, security and well-being of the workplace? Do you have a passion for project management and thrive in an environment that allows you to travel to different offices throughout California? If so, the Department of Industrial Relations’ (DIR) Safety and Security team is looking for you! As a DIR Safety and Security Analyst, you will help lead and facilitate the Department's Emergency Preparedness and Security efforts for over 3000 employees across 40+ office locations statewide.

The Safety and Security Unit is responsible for the safety of all buildings, working with local staff, management, property managers and partners in law enforcement, the Office of Emergency Services, CalFire, and other local agencies. In collaboration with other members of the Safety and Security Unit, this role is responsible for coordinating emergency preparedness drills, exercises, evacuations, and developing, implementing, and monitoring office emergency preparedness policies and security procedures.

In this role, the incumbent will coordinate with DIR and building staff in the event of an emergency or natural disaster by working with internal and external subject matter experts to maximize the safety and security of people and property. The Safety and Security Unit independently manages the development and annual submission of the Department’s Business Continuity Plan, Business Impact Analysis, and Business Continuity Checklist to the California Office of Emergency Services (CalOES). They also lead the development, training, and testing of the roles and responsibilities of the Business Continuity Plan.

The Safety and Security Analyst Independently conducts investigations and provides reports for workplace health and safety incidents, accidents, and exposures. They also act as the Department-wide point-of-contact for health and safety issues. Additionally, the incumbent independently manages DIR's access badge systems in all state owned and privately leased locations including the installation, removal, maintenance, and modification of access badge systems, card readers, and related equipment in DIR locations. This position offers opportunities for a hybrid telework schedule.

The Role

As an Applied AI Data Analyst, you will bridge the gap between our massive, unstructured financial and operational datasets to our core R&D team. You will own the evaluation platform of our agentic workflows forecasting pipelines, as well as improve customer facing insights leading to mission-critical decisions.

Algorithm & LLM Evaluation: Analyze edge cases, model predictions, hallucination rates, and extraction accuracy for our LLM-driven document processing systems and agentic workflows.

Prepare presentations and management reports.

Collaborate with internal teams, including operations, accounting, and commercial affairs.
Research relevant legislation, regulations and standards related to sustainability to ensure compliance across all markets of operations.
Support climate risk and impact assessments, contribute to reporting under voluntary and regulatory frameworks and research strategies for risk mitigation.
Conduct the collection, analysis and reporting of quantitative and qualitative sustainability data and metrics.

Contribute to emissions accounting for Scopes 1, 2 and 3, in line with GHG Protocol standards and third-party assurance requirements.
Prepare periodic reports that track progress toward project workstreams.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, cost savings and improved resource management.
Review external statements and policies annually.

Other projects and duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Third Party Risk
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) team is accountable for defining, maintaining, and overseeing the third-party risk framework, policy, and inventory in accordance with management expectations and best practices. We are focused on assessing and managing risks exposed through our relationships with third parties, adhering to regulatory guidance, and driving operational efficiencies across risk teams.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll support and maintain a robust framework for identifying, assessing, and managing third-party risks to protect Stripe. You'll partner with cross-functional Risk Domain Owners, Procurement subteams, Legal, and other stakeholders to apply a unified Third Party Risk Framework across risk and compliance areas. You'll maintain the existing Stripe Third Party Risk Program, Policy, and Standards, while further developing new Standards to propel the maturity of the Third Party Risk Program.

Responsibilities

Maintain the Global Third Party Risk Management Program, Policy, and Framework, ensuring alignment with relevant regulations, standards, and best practices
Launch and mature nascent risk domains to increase overall program maturity
Design and support an enhanced oversight model for specialized third-party types including Partnerships and Contingent Workers
Design and enhance elements of the existing Third Party Risk Framework including offboarding and incident monitoring, among other areas
Build and oversee the third-party performance management function and define performance standards, including metric templates and ongoing monitoring activities, to ensure third-party health
Design effective reporting to monitor and communicate the third-party risk program status, key issues, and remediation plans to governance committees, senior leaders, and relevant stakeholders
Serve as subject matter expert and coordinator of system business requirements among risk domain owners and stakeholders—prioritizing effective requirements (Users First and Risk Focused)

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

4+ years of experience in risk or compliance roles, preferably third-party risk in a regulated environment
Proven experience managing distinct projects and programs, with particularly strong skills in stakeholder management
Strong written and verbal communication skills—including the ability to communicate effectively with different stakeholders across the business such as risk domain owners, internal audit, and the broader risk and compliance community
Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, including navigating leadership and interpersonal working relationships
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to handle multiple assignments while comfortably managing ambiguity
Ability to assess and analyze data in order to solve problems and draw insightful conclusions

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience building third-party risk programs
Previous experience implementing programs around regulatory frameworks
Understanding of risk program elements including policy and risk appetite creation and maintenance
Understanding of risk areas such as information security, privacy, business continuity, finance, reputation, operational, and ESG
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization tools

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $123,600 - $185,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

jobs.title: Lead GTM Data Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Why This Role, Why Now

GTM Data Strategy & Operations stood up from scratch with no predecessor. Today the function runs on three offshore contractors and zero FTEs
, managed by a single leader who is simultaneously building the agentic infrastructure, operating it in production, and driving major initiatives (hierarchy redesign, data quality assessment, vendor optimization).

The operating model is deliberately agentic AI–first
: a multi-agent pipeline (Cartographer, Sentinel, Resolver, Reporting) handles detection, enrichment, hierarchy mapping, and conflict resolution at scale. This is not a future-state vision, these agents are live and processing enterprise account families in production today.

The problem:
one person cannot build, operate, and extend this system while also managing strategic workstreams. The function currently covers only core Tier‑1 fields. Dozens of account, contact, and lead signals remain unaddressed. Every pipeline run, every failure diagnosis, and every offshore handoff flows through a single point of failure.
This role is the first onshore execution hire for an agent operator who can keep the system running, improve it, and extend detection and resolution coverage as GTM leadership prioritizes new data elements.

Role Summary

Sit between AI systems and GTM data. Operate, tune, and extend our agentic data quality pipeline (detection, enrichment, hierarchy mapping, conflict resolution) so it runs reliably, improves continuously, and expands to cover more of the data landscape. Own the handoff between automated output and human review, managing quality and throughput with our offshore team. You don’t build agents from scratch, but you run them, evaluate their output with GTM data judgment, and make them better.

Core Responsibilities

Agent Pipeline Operations

Run and monitor production pipeline sessions (Cartographer, Sentinel, Resolver) across scheduled cadences; diagnose and resolve failures (API errors, session timeouts, data anomalies) without escalating to the function lead.
Execute pipeline runs in Claude Claude and tmux; manage long-running batch processes; interpret logs and output to confirm data integrity before downstream handoff.
Maintain pipeline orchestration scripts and configuration; extend agent coverage as new data elements are prioritized by GTM leadership.

Agent Tuning & Improvement

Refine detection rules, prompt logic, and confidence thresholds based on output analysis and false-positive/negative patterns.
Evaluate agent accuracy by segment (Enterprise vs. MM/SMB) and recommend rule or workflow changes backed by evidence.
Run bake-offs (vendor vs. AI enrichment) to optimize cost, coverage, and accuracy; document results for decision-making.

Sentinel → Offshore Resolution Loop

Own the handoff between Sentinel detection output and Concentrix triage queues; define queue structure, priority tiers, and resolution instructions.
Monitor offshore resolution quality and throughput; refine detection rules based on patterns surfaced through triage.
Close the feedback loop: track resolution outcomes back to agent configuration to reduce recurring false positives and improve detection precision.

Data Quality & Enrichment Operations

Maintain ops-only staging fields; manage the promote-to-production flow with audit controls.
Design and run AI-assisted enrichment workflows (Clay + LLM prompts) with evidence links and confidence thresholds.
Monitor fill-rate, sampled accuracy, freshness, and cost-per-record by source and segment; surface vendor performance issues and recommend changes.
Keep data dictionaries, SOPs, and runbooks current as agents and processes evolve.

Cross-Functional Partnership

GTM Systems (SFDC): field configuration, permission sets, automation, flows.
Data Engineering: source availability, ID mapping, lineage (no pipeline coding).
Reporting: define metrics and acceptance criteria; partner on dashboard requirements.

Qualifications

3–6 years in Data Ops, Sales Ops, or GTM Ops with hands-on data quality ownership for account and contact data.
Proficiency with Snowflake (SQL for querying, analysis, validation) and SFDC (object model, field configuration, data flows).
Working experience with Claude Code or comparable LLM-based tooling in an operational (not just experimental) context.
Experience designing and running AI-assisted enrichment workflows (e.g., Clay + LLM prompts) and evaluating accuracy/coverage.
Comfort operating in a command-line environment: tmux, shell scripts, log analysis, batch process monitoring.
Process design mindset with a bias toward measurable outcomes; strong written communication.

Strong Plus

Experience with account/contact data vendors (D&B, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, StoreLeads) and waterfall enrichment logic.
Python for QA scripting, sampling, or light automation.
Familiarity with prompt engineering, confidence scoring, and AI guardrails (evidence capture, versioned prompts, QA sampling gates).

Tool Stack

Core:
Snowflake (SQL), SFDC, Claude Code, Clay
Pipeline:
Shell orchestration, Cartographer / Sentinel / Resolver agents
Enrichment:
D&B, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, StoreLeads, LLM prompts
Nice to Have:
Python, SOQL, prompt engineering frameworks
AI Guardrails (Expected Practice):
Confidence floors, evidence capture, versioned prompts, 10% QA sampling gates, audit-on-promote, drift alerts, and privacy/compliance checks. This role is expected to uphold and improve these practices, not just follow them.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Facilities Planner III supports the execution and governance of facility operations activities across a client portfolio. The role helps ensure that operational records, maintenance data, performance reporting, and supporting documentation are complete, accurate, and aligned with account requirements, Buyer objectives, critical performance indicators (CPIs), and service level agreements (SLAs).

This is an account-level operations support position focused on portfolio consistency, information quality, performance visibility, and continuous improvement. The role works with account leadership, Critical Facilities Managers, site teams, and support functions to identify gaps, standardize processes, track commitments, and improve the effectiveness of facility operations. The position does not perform site-level work assignment, technician dispatch, or development of the detailed maintenance schedule.

JOB OBJECTIVE

Enable reliable and consistent facility operations by providing account-level planning, coordination, data stewardship, and performance support. The Facilities Planner III/Analyst helps translate operational requirements into effective processes, accurate records, actionable reporting, and improvement plans that support safe execution, asset reliability, contract compliance, and achievement of CPI and SLA commitments.

Salary Range

$106,400 - $197,600 Annually

The pay listed is the hourly range or the hourly rate for this position. A specific offer will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

Benefit Information:

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Responsibilities

Support account leadership and site teams in the execution of facility operations programs, standards, and contractual requirements across the portfolio.
Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of facility operations records, maintenance data, asset information, and supporting documentation.
Monitor operational performance against Buyer objectives, CPIs, SLAs, and internal account metrics; identify trends, exceptions, and areas requiring corrective action.
Prepare and maintain recurring operational reports, scorecards, dashboards, and supporting analysis for account reviews and client performance discussions.
Coordinate follow-up on operational action items, deficiencies, audit findings, overdue activities, and improvement initiatives through documented closure.
Support governance of preventive and corrective maintenance programs by reviewing account-level data for compliance, backlog, aging, completion quality, and recurring issues.
Partner with Critical Facilities Managers, Critical Environment Directors/Engineers, and site planning/scheduling resources to improve work management practices without directing individual technician assignments or building site maintenance schedules.
Support development, standardization, and continuous improvement of account-level operating processes, workflows, templates, records, and reporting methods.
Assist with maintenance strategy, asset lifecycle, risk, and reliability initiatives by organizing data, tracking recommendations, and supporting portfolio-level analysis.
Coordinate collection and validation of information required for client reviews, internal audits, compliance activities, operational readiness, and management reporting.
Analyze work order, asset, maintenance, and performance data to identify recurring failures, process gaps, workload trends, and opportunities to improve efficiency and reliability.
Support change control, shutdown, commissioning, and major maintenance activities at the account level by tracking required documentation, milestones, dependencies, and completion status.
Work with account leadership, engineering, supply chain, finance, technology, and other support functions to resolve operational data or process issues and improve service delivery.
Maintain historical performance information and account records to support trend analysis, benchmarking, forecasting, and continuous improvement.
Promote consistent use of approved systems, processes, and documentation standards across the portfolio and help identify training or process-adherence gaps.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in facilities management, engineering, business, operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.

3-5 years of experience in facilities operations, maintenance management, planning, data analysis, or performance management; mission critical or data center experience preferred.
Working knowledge of CMMS/work management systems and maintenance records, including preventive and corrective maintenance data.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Power BI, and reporting or dashboard tools; experience analyzing operational performance data.
Ability to interpret service requirements, CPIs, SLAs, procedures, and operational data and convert them into clear actions and reporting.
Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and written/verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple sites and functions, manage competing priorities, and follow issues through closure.

About Us

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Job Location:
Melville, NY or Boca Raton, FL
Hybrid Work Schedule: Must be able to reliably commute to either our Melville, NY office or Boca Raton, FL office.

Company Description:

Sheer Science is dedicated to improving lives through innovative products that deliver real results seen and experienced by our customers. We identify and bring to market effective products backed by clinical studies, earning trust and confidence through their performance. Our culture emphasizes an open, honest environment where every employee's voice is valued, fostering a fun, collaborative atmosphere. We live our values of honesty, transparency, and commitment to excellence, ensuring every team member feels engaged and motivated.

Role Description:

The Data Analyst will play a key role in supporting data quality, reporting accuracy, and analytics across the business. This mid-level role will own recurring validation and reconciliation efforts, investigate discrepancies across source systems, warehouse tables, and Power BI outputs, and support the maintenance and enhancement of dashboards, semantic models, and reporting datasets. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, structured data analysis, and data documentation, along with the ability to troubleshoot data issues, communicate findings clearly, and partner with stakeholders to turn business questions into reliable, actionable insights.

What you’ll do:

· Own recurring data validation and quality checks across reporting datasets, pipelines, and source systems.
· Investigate discrepancies between source systems, warehouse tables, and Power BI/reporting outputs.
· Perform routine SQL analysis and troubleshooting, including joins, aggregations, reconciliation queries, duplicate detection, and missing record investigations.
· Maintain and enhance existing Power BI reports and semantic models.
· Handle stakeholder requests for recurring reports, extracts, segmentation, and ad hoc analysis.
· Document business logic, table definitions, pipeline dependencies, and reporting rules.
· Perform first-level troubleshooting on failed Azure/Synapse pipelines before escalating deeper engineering issues.
· Maintain data dictionaries and lightweight lineage documentation.
· Support QA for new datasets, dashboards, and pipeline changes before production deployment.

What you’ll need:

We’re looking for an experienced data professional with strong SQL, Power BI, reporting, and data validation skills. The ideal candidate can troubleshoot data issues, document business logic, and translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insights. E-commerce or direct-to-consumer (D2C) experience is preferred, especially with customer, order, marketing, web, subscription, or product data.
· Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field.
· 3+ years professional work experience
· Strong SQL fundamentals
· Basic Python skills, plus use of Jupyter Notebooks for EDA, and presentation.
· Strong Power BI skills
· Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts
· Familiarity with cloud data platforms; Azure experience would be ideal.
· Understanding of APIs, HTTP requests, authentication, and JSON responses.

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data expert like you to bring your expertise to the Navy to understand their data and support Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst embedded with a DOW client, you’ll work closely with our customers to understand their data questions and then dig into their data-rich environments and tools to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Brief Description

About Us

At FreshDirect
, we are reinventing the grocery experience.

Since day one, our mission has been simple: bring the best, freshest food directly from the farm to people’s homes — faster, fresher, and smarter than anyone else.

We’re not just a food company. We’re a technology-powered, customer-obsessed team building one of the most innovative end-to-end food supply chains in the industry. From proprietary routing systems to our state-of-the-art fulfillment center, every part of our business is designed to deliver unmatched quality, convenience, and care.

We partner directly with farmers, fishermen, and artisans to source the highest quality ingredients — then use smart data, automation, and logistics to deliver them at peak freshness.

It’s grocery shopping reimagined — and we’re just getting started.

If you’re passionate about innovation, care deeply about what people eat, and want to help build the future of food, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

The Demand Planning Data Analyst supports the Demand Planner Manager in operating the forecasting engine that drives FreshDirect's inventory planning and procurement processes. This role is responsible for creating accurate product forecasts based on anticipated customer demand, analyzing performance metrics, and ensuring optimal in-stock levels and service standards. Key responsibilities include managing weekly forecasting processes and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance forecast accuracy. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills to convey technical concepts to non-technical colleagues, along with a commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.

What You’ll Do

Responsible for the creation, maintenance, and updating of demand forecasts by Base-Material-Plant-Day for the next 150 days (in base units), using the company's demand-planning platform alongside other tools.
Execute and refine the weekly forecasting process, continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
Analyze and interpret complex datasets from multiple sources to inform decision-making.
Apply statistical forecasting models to produce data-driven predictions.
Achieve consensus for forecasts by collaborating with merchandising, purchasing, marketing and Supply Chain, Production, Operations, etc.
Partner with the Demand Planner Manager to account for promotional impacts in forecasts.
Track and report on forecast accuracy and related KPIs — including service levels, promotion impact, scrap, out-of-stock, and days on hand — to drive continuous improvement.
Own root-cause analysis on forecast misses and lead weekly or biweekly consensus meetings with merchant partners to drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on sales or forecast-related projects as needed.
Communicate forecast trends and their alignment with business changes to non-technical stakeholders.
Manipulate and manage data sets with good governance.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
1-4 years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, or analytics roles at least.
Fast learner with strong analytical skills.
Proven ability to evaluate large data sets and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with visualization tools required.
Working knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and reporting required.
Experience with RELEX, Blue Yonder, o9, or similar demand planning platforms preferred.
Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and root causes in complex datasets
Ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build consensus across merchandising, purchasing, and supply chain stakeholders
Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and a sense of ownership over forecast outcomes
Comfortable operating with ambiguity and making forecast calls under time pressure
Self-directed, with a track record of proactively identifying forecast risks before they affect service levels
Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive decisions without direct authority

Our Values at FreshDirect

We live these values every day:

A Passion for our customers

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We listen, innovate, and act quickly to exceed expectations with every order and interaction.

One team, one mission

Everyone contributes & every role matters. We break silos, lift each other up, and share a relentless focus on delivering results. That way, we win together.

Delivering excellence, every time

We take pride in the quality of our food, service, and the experience we create. Our team goes above and beyond to earn trust and guarantee 100% freshness.

Act with integrity

We operate with honesty, respect, and accountability in how we treat our customers, teammates, and partners. We own our outcomes and always do what’s right, even when no one is watching.

Make fast, bold decisions

We challenge the status quo, embrace technology, and take smart risks to build a better future. At the same time, we stay true to our NYC roots and care for our community.

We love food. Yes, literally all of us.

What You’ll Love About Working Here

A fast-paced, innovative environment where ideas turn into action
Opportunities for growth — many of our leaders have risen through the ranks
Direct impact on how thousands of customers experience food every day

We are looking for people who excel in this environment, where physical presence enhances connections and engagement. At FreshDirect, we've created an environment that thrives on teamwork, where associates can innovate, grow, and have successful careers. At ITAC, you'll be part of a collaborative team that works hard to make life better. For more information, visit itac.us.com.

The position involves managing scope, schedule, and budget, coordinating engineering and construction resources, and driving project success through proactive leadership and client engagement.

Project Management

Lead project development efforts, including scope definition, cost estimating, and scheduling

Ensure quality standards are met across all deliverables and services

Address project and client issues promptly and professionally
Support business development by pursuing new opportunities and assisting with proposals and pricing

Administrative

Participate in professional development activities and contribute to company growth initiatives
Promote and enforce Assured Project Management (APM) principles and company standards

Requirements

Education

Bachelor of Science degree from an ABET-accredited institution in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Architecture, or equivalent experience
Management degree preferred but not required

Experience

10+ years in engineering, construction, or project management roles within the Industrial space (increasing with seniority)
Multidiscipline project design experience
Demonstrated experience in electric vehicle (EV) systems and advanced battery technologies, including design, integration, and performance optimization
Familiarity with commissioning, startup, and construction support tasks
Proven ability to manage complex projects and lead diverse teams
Experience in manufacturing and industrial construction environment
Experience in overseeing industrial projects from conception and design to completion and startup.

Skills

Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and project management tools
Strong organizational and planning abilities
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues under pressure
Leadership qualities with the ability to teach and mentor others

Certifications

PMP or Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred for senior-level positions

From internships to seasoned professionals, our growing company provides career opportunities for all levels of experience. jobs.description:
We Put the World on Vacation

Travel + Leisure Co. is the world’s leading vacation ownership and travel membership company, with a dynamic and growing portfolio of resort, travel club, and lifestyle travel brands. Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide.

Lead. Deliver. Transform.

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives on taking ownership, solving problems and seeing projects through from concept to completion?

Travel + Leisure Co. is seeking a highly motivated Project Manager – Hotel Refurbishment & Projects
to join our Refurbishment & Projects team and deliver a diverse portfolio of hotel, resort and commercial refurbishment projects across Australia and internationally.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in transforming our resort portfolio and delivering projects that directly enhance the guest experience.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on, end-to-end project delivery role
.

You will take responsibility for assigned refurbishment and capital projects from initial scoping and feasibility through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and final handover to Resort Operations.

Working closely with Resort Managers, internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, suppliers and trades, you will be responsible for delivering projects safely, efficiently, on time and within approved budgets.

You will be expected to take ownership of your projects, identify issues early, develop solutions and drive delivery rather than simply administer the process.

What you’ll be doing

Lead refurbishment and construction projects from inception through to completion and operational handover.
Develop project scopes, budgets, programmes and procurement strategies.
Engage and manage architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, suppliers and specialist trades.
Prepare and manage tenders, quotations and construction contracts.
Negotiate commercial outcomes and manage contractor performance.
Monitor project costs, commitments, forecasts and variations.
Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost savings.
Manage construction programmes and critical path activities.
Conduct regular site inspections and maintain a hands-on understanding of project progress.
Coordinate works within operational hotels and resorts while minimising disruption to guests and Resort Operations.
Manage quality, safety, compliance, defects and practical completion.
Resolve construction issues, latent conditions and project risks.
Provide accurate project reporting, forecasting and financial control.
Successfully hand over completed projects to Resort Operations.

About You

You are a self-starter who takes ownership
.

You don’t wait for problems to resolve themselves and you don’t need to be constantly directed. You are comfortable making decisions, coordinating multiple stakeholders and driving projects forward in challenging environments.

You Will Ideally Bring

Proven experience delivering refurbishment and construction projects from inception to completion.
Strong hotel, resort, hospitality, commercial or accommodation refurbishment experience.
Excellent knowledge of construction processes, building practices and project delivery.
Strong tendering, procurement and contract administration experience.
Demonstrated commercial and budget management capability.
Proven ability to manage contractors, consultants, suppliers and trades.
Strong planning, programming and organisational skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
A practical, solutions-focused approach.
High attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
The ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with a broader team.
Relevant tertiary qualifications in Construction, Building, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management or a related discipline are desirable; equivalent industry experience will be considered.

National & International Travel

Travel Is An Essential Part Of This Role.

The successful candidate must be comfortable undertaking significant national and international travel
, including extended periods working on site at resorts and project locations.

This is not a traditional office-based Project Manager role. You will need to be comfortable being where the project is, sometimes for extended periods, and working closely with Resort Operations, contractors and trades to achieve successful project outcomes.

Why join us?

You’ll join a team delivering a significant portfolio of refurbishment and capital projects across a leading global vacation ownership and resort organisation.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

Work on a diverse portfolio of resort and hospitality projects.
Take genuine ownership of projects from start to finish.
Work across Australia and internationally.
Collaborate with experienced property, development, procurement and resort teams.
Make a tangible difference to the guest experience.
Be part of a business that puts the world on vacation.

If you’re a commercially minded, hands-on Project Manager who enjoys being accountable for getting things done, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and tell us about the refurbishment projects you’ve delivered and the outcomes you achieved.

Where Memories Start with You

Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel + Leisure Co. Here, you’ll find an inclusive environment where we deliver excellence and take time to have fun, celebrate together, and support one another. We're always looking ahead to what’s next and how we can strengthen our business, its neighboring communities, and the customer experience. Join our global team and build a career where memories start with you.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Utility-Scale Solar & Battery Storage
jobs.description:
About Samsung C&T Corporation

Samsung C&T Corporation was founded in 1938 and is the parent company of Samsung Group. It is a Global Business Partner and Lifestyle Innovator pioneering new trends in the construction, trading & investment, fashion and resort industries. Its Trading & Investment Group operates in over 40 countries managing energy projects
and industrial commodities (chemicals, steel, materials). It acts as a specialized trader and developer, focusing on renewable energy (solar/wind/ESS), LNG and new business ventures such as data centers.

In the United States, Samsung C&T Renewables
has a track record of developing over 38GW of renewable energy projects since 2016. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, it currently manages a 20GW+ PV/BESS pipeline across 24 states, backed by a solid team of 100+ employees across the US and Seoul, South Korea. In addition, it has full development cycle capabilities, including in-house site acquisition, real estate, permitting, interconnection, engineering, pre-construction and much more.
In Canada, Samsung has successfully developed, constructed, and continues to manage operation services for a 1.3GW solar+wind energy cluster.

🔎 About the Role

Samsung C&T is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead utility-scale solar PV and battery energy storage (BESS) projects from mid/late-stage development through NTP, construction, and COD. As an owner-side Sr.PM for a developer/IPP, you will coordinate internal teams and external EPCs/contractors and consultants to ensure projects are bankable at NTP and successfully delivered in the field.
This is a remote role with periodic travel (typically monthly site visits plus key milestones) to project sites, EPC offices, and occasional in-person team meetings.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Project Leadership (Owner-Side)

Serve as the primary owner representative and single point of accountability for assigned projects from mid/late-stage development through COD.
Lead cross-functional coordination between Development, Engineering, Interconnection, Legal, Procurement, Construction Management, Finance, and Operations.
Establish and maintain project execution plans, defining scope, schedule, budget, and risk profile aligned with portfolio and financing requirements.

2. Pre-Construction & Development Support

Support mid/late-stage development with scope definition, basis of design, and execution strategy for utility-scale PV and BESS projects.
Help coordinate internal and external engineers to ensure bankable, constructible design packages that comply with applicable codes and utility interconnection requirements.
Review and challenge EPC assumptions on design, means and methods, productivity, and logistics.
Participate in site due diligence (desk-based and periodic site visits) including layout optimization, access and logistics, and early constructability reviews.
Support M&A and greenfield development by providing CAPEX/ schedule input and reviewing technical due diligence materials.

3. Budgeting, Estimating & EPC/Contract Support

Work with estimating and EPC partners to develop and validate project budgets and CAPEX for investment decisions and NTP approvals.
Lead preparation and management of RFPs for EPC packages; support Procurement Team with RFPs for major equipment, including scope definitions, bid evaluations and recommendations.
Lead negotiating EPC Contracts, and assist with key supplier contracts, providing technical and commercial input to ensure alignment with project risks and financing conditions.
Track and communicate key commercial assumptions (contingency, escalation, allowances) to internal stakeholders.

4. Scheduling & Portfolio Coordination

Develop and maintain high-level integrated project schedules from mid/late-stage development through COD, aligned with portfolio and financing timelines.
Coordinate with EPCs on detailed construction schedules and monitor critical path activities, especially interconnection, long-lead procurement, and commissioning.
Ensure project schedules tie into portfolio milestones (NTP, COD, tax credit deadlines, lender milestones).

5. Construction Oversight (Monthly Site Visits)

Provide owner-side oversight of EPC/contractor performance, primarily through remote coordination plus monthly site visits and targeted milestone visits (mobilization, mechanical completion, energization, performance testing).
Review EPC reports, three-week look-ahead, manpower curves, and progress photos; challenge and validate reported progress and forecasts.
Participate in regular construction progress calls and meetings, ensuring safety, quality, and schedule expectations are clearly communicated and enforced.
During site visits, perform field walks with EPC and owner’s engineer to validate progress, quality, and compliance with contract documents.

6. Cost Control, Change Management & Reporting

Own the project budget from NTP through COD on the owner side, maintaining up-to-date forecasts and contingency positions.
Evaluate and negotiate EPC and supplier change orders, aligning with contract terms and protecting project economics.
Develop and deliver monthly project reports covering schedule, cost, risks, safety, and key decisions for internal leadership and investment committees.
Coordinate with Finance on drawdowns, cash flow forecasts, and lender reporting requirements.

7. Quality, Commissioning & Turnover to Operations

Coordinate with the EPC, Owner’s Engineer, and internal technical teams on QA/QC, inspections, and testing.
Oversee commissioning plans, performance testing, and punch list closeout to meet contractual and financing requirements.
Ensure delivery of complete as-built documentation, test reports, warranties, O&M manuals, and spare parts as required by contracts and lenders.
Lead project handover to Asset Management/O&M, including lessons learned and long-term risk items.

8. Risk Management, Compliance & Stakeholder Interface

Maintain and actively manage a project risk register from mid/late-stage development through COD, with mitigation strategies and action owners.
Coordinate with utilities, AHJs, landowners, and community stakeholders as needed, usually in partnership with Development and Construction Management.
Ensure compliance with environmental permits, interconnection agreements, and lender requirements.

🎯 Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of experience in project management, pre-construction, or construction management for utility-scale solar and/or BESS projects (≥20 MWac), including time in an owner, IPP, or developer environment or closely interfacing with one.
Demonstrated experience managing projects through both:
Pre-construction (design coordination, estimating/budgeting, contracting), and
Construction/commissioning oversight (schedule, cost, quality, and turnover).
Strong understanding of EPC delivery models, contract structures, and risk allocation on large power projects.
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Primavera P6 or MS Project for schedules; Excel, and a PM platform such as ProCore for tracking and reporting).
Excellent remote communication skills, able to lead distributed teams and manage EPCs largely from afar with targeted site visits.
Ability and willingness to travel approximately once per month to project sites and occasional in-person meetings (overall ~15 - 25% travel).

Preferred
Experience in a developer/IPP role directly interfacing with investors, lenders, and tax equity partners.
Familiarity with project finance, NTP and COD conditions, and lender/IE processes.
Experience overseeing BESS integration and commissioning alongside PV.
Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, or CCM.

Competencies

Owner’s mindset – focused on long-term asset performance, not just project completion.
Strong commercial and technical acumen, able to interrogate EPC assumptions and protect project value.
Comfortable working remotely with multiple time zones, using structured communication and clear documentation.
Skilled at building constructive relationships with EPCs, suppliers, and internal stakeholders while holding them accountable.
Highly organized, with strong prioritization and follow-through, especially across multiple projects in a portfolio.
Deep commitment to safety, quality, and ethical conduct.

💡 Why Join Samsung C&T

Work with a global team delivering innovative, large‑scale energy solutions.
Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for international collaboration.
Work with a global organization committed to innovation and sustainability
Opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic, mission‑driven environment
Competitive compensation, benefits, and international collaboration opportunities

The expected salary range for this position is [$150,000 – $180,000 annually]
. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, and location. Samsung C&T Corporation also offers a comprehensive benefits package, performance‑based incentives, and opportunities for professional development.

No Solicitation / Agency Policy

Samsung C&T Renewables America does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from recruiters, search firms, or staffing agencies. Any unsolicited candidates presented to the company will be considered the sole property of Samsung C&T and may be used without any obligation to pay fees or compensation to the submitting party.

jobs.title: AI Legal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.
The Role
As AI Legal Program Manager, you will play a key role in navigating the legal and regulatory landscape of Block's artificial intelligence initiatives. You will partner with legal, engineering, product, and compliance teams to develop frameworks that enable responsible AI innovation while ensuring regulatory compliance and risk management across our AI products and services.
You will:
Drive the development and implementation of AI legal and compliance frameworks, including policies for model development, deployment, and monitoring that align with emerging AI regulations and industry standards.
Participate in cross-functional reviews of AI project initiatives to identify legal risks and opportunities, ensuring compliance with regulations while enabling innovation.
Develop and maintain AI governance documentation, including model cards, algorithmic impact assessments, training data compliance records, and legal risk assessments.
Partner with engineering teams to implement legally compliant AI development practices, including requirements for transparency, fairness, and accountability.
Create and maintain processes for AI incident response, model monitoring, and legal compliance validation.
Build scalable processes for AI legal reviews across various stakeholders.

You have:
5+ years of directly related experience in technical program management, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML initiatives in a technology-driven environment.
Strong understanding of emerging AI regulations (EU AI Act, state AI laws, etc.) and their practical implementation.
Experience developing legal frameworks for AI governance and responsible AI development.
Track record of partnering with technical teams to implement legal requirements in AI systems.
Understanding of IP considerations in AI development, including training data rights, model ownership, and output licensing.
Experience with AI risk assessment methodologies and mitigation strategies.
Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional initiatives.

Even better:
Experience with large language models (LLMs) and generative AI legal considerations
Background in open source software licensing and AI model licensing
Familiarity with AI ethics frameworks and algorithmic fairness principles
Experience with AI procurement and vendor assessment
Knowledge of global AI regulatory developments and policy trends
Background in privacy law and data protection regulations
Technical background or demonstrated ability to understand AI/ML concept

jobs.title: Research Project Manager - Study Support
jobs.description:
Responsible for providing oversight and leadership necessary for successful implementation of designated projects, initiatives, and/or studies of a complex nature, including those that are multi-year, multi-site, or involve multiple stakeholders. Supports leaders and investigators to effectively manage scope, deliverables, timelines, and budget. Areas of responsibility include organizing and leading project meetings; preparing reports, presentations and timelines; feasibility assessment; data evaluation; direct project management including budget management in accordance with grant and/or contract requirements.

Major Responsibilities

Leads the planning, execution, and oversight of AARI projects, initiatives, and/or multi-year, multi-site, multi-stakeholder pragmatic clinical trials and research studies; collectively referred to as “project(s)”.
Manages project timelines to ensure that project goals and deliverables (including reports, study subject recruitment) are met on time.
Tracks the execution of projects against project timelines and communicates project status to internal and external collaborators. Creates and delivers customized project plans, project charters, reports and presentations. Updates and ensures timely and effective deployment of implementation plans and measurable returns.
Oversees project activities assigned to research personnel and works closely with project team to develop and implement strategies to achieve project objectives, improve efficiency of research processes and procedures (including recruitment), and subsequently execute improvements, working with leaders as appropriate.
Manages project plans, project meetings, and agendas for project teams working with clinical and research leaders, investigators, clinical staff, other internal stakeholders (including IT), and external collaborators in academia and industry.
Independently builds relationships with research teams and collaborating institutions and assists in the development of new project proposals, including working closely with Sponsored Program Services, legal, privacy, compliance, and IT to secure appropriate administrative approvals.
Ensures that all study activities are completed by strictly following Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), institutional and departmental research guidelines (e.g., IRB), and federal, state, and local agencies.

Education Required

Master's Degree in Business or related field, or
Master's Degree in Health Science or related field.

Experience Required

Typically requires 5 years of experience in research project or program management in a large health care system, industry or academic environment.

Preferred Qualifications/Experience

Experience building collaborations and overseeing research teams in academic medical settings
Experience working with NIH-, PCORI-, or other federally funded research programs (including communication with and reporting to safety monitors/officers)
Proficiency with REDCap, including data entry, creating databases and questionnaires, survey management, and developing reports/custom dashboards
Proficiency with Microsoft365 products, including use of Excel to develop pivot tables and reports, and/or basic skills related to using at least one statistical software package (e.g., SPSS, SAS, or R)
Proficiency with Epic for participant identification, recruitment, study implementation, and data collection activities
Familiarity with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) such as OnCore
Experience with developing and implementing plans to recruit and retain community and patient populations in trials with multi-year follow-ups
Experience with reviewing, reading, and summarizing scientific literature, especially literature focused in the areas of health behavior change, weight management, nutrition, physical activity, cardiovascular disease, and/or type 2 diabetes
Experience managing data capture related to dietary intake and physical activity, especially using newer technologies (e.g., via the NCI ASA24, smartphone apps, wearable devices)

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

Knowledge of health services research including subject recruitment and consenting processes.
Ability to problem solve, work independently with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, organizational and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Skilled in identifying opportunities to improve efficiency of research processes and procedures and subsequently execute improvement.
Ability to provide effective leadership and motivate others. Ability to mentor staff and prepare training plans.
Experience managing diverse clinical and research teams.
Experience in project management and ability to drive progress in complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Will generally be exposed to rapid-pace and complex health care environment.
Remote work with in-person presence (e.g., site visits, recruitment activities, meetings) as needed.
This position may require ability to drive and/or travel to work related meetings/functions and thus is exposed to road, weather, and normal travel hazards.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Transformation
jobs.description:
Description

Join the Workforce Staffing (WFS) Transformation team in driving the future of WFS through data-driven program execution, process engineering, and strategic analysis. Supporting global hiring strategies and key initiatives, you'll play a pivotal role as a Program Manager driving end-to-end delivery of analytics-powered solutions that optimize our global recruitment processes across tier 1 associate hiring—impacting more than 1 million hires and over 5 million applications worldwide annually.

This role sits at the intersection of program management and deep data analytics. You will own the strategy, execution, and delivery of programs that leverage advanced analytics, generative AI, and process engineering to drive measurable business outcomes. You'll translate complex data into actionable insights, build scalable solutions, and drive progress across cross-functional teams—operating with ambiguity and owning outcomes end-to-end. The ideal candidate is a creative, demonstrated leader with superior ability to learn new technology and make data-driven decisions for project deliverables.

This is an opportunity to operate in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets scale. You'll develop deep expertise in workforce analytics and process engineering while contributing to mission-critical hiring operations that directly impact our ability to serve customers worldwide. The role offers extensive opportunities to demonstrate key leadership principles including Customer Obsession through candidate-centric process improvements, Ownership by taking end-to-end responsibility for program deliverables, Dive Deep through comprehensive data analysis, and Deliver Results by providing actionable insights and scalable programs that drive hiring and operational success.

Key job responsibilities

Drive end-to-end program execution for data analytics and process engineering initiatives across global workforce staffing operations (1M+ hires, 5M+ applications annually across the globe)
Own program strategy, roadmaps, and delivery for analytics solutions — dashboards, automated reporting, and insight generation tracking hiring funnel performance, cost per hire, and fill rate metrics
Lead process engineering to drive global standardization of metrics and build scalable frameworks that improve efficiency and quality of hire
Analyze large datasets using SQL to generate insights for workforce planning, risk detection, and early attrition signals enabling faster intervention on quality-of-hire indicators
Leverage generative AI to accelerate insight generation, automate workflows, and develop innovative solutions enhancing program delivery
Manage stakeholder relationships across multiple geographies, translating analytical insights into actionable recommendations tied to "Must Win" goals
Drive cross-team collaboration, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver executive-ready white papers and presentations communicating program outcomes to senior leadership

A day in the life

Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic program execution, deep data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. You might start by querying large datasets to uncover optimization opportunities in recruitment processes, then shift to driving a stakeholder review on program milestones and dependencies. You'll leverage generative AI tools to accelerate insight generation, facilitate alignment across regional teams, and translate thousands of lines of data into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership. Expect to move fast, operate in ambiguity, and own outcomes—balancing process engineering with analytics to drive measurable progress rather than just output.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience in written and oral communication, including the ability to communicate with all levels in the organization (technical, business, executive)
2+ years of SQL experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
Experience in process engineering and operational improvement methodologies
Experience with ETL pipelines, data modeling, or scripting languages (Python)
Track record of successfully launching programs that combine process engineering with analytics at scale
Ability to move fast, operate with ambiguity, and own outcomes end-to-end
Master's degree in Business, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field
