jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Experience and Insights Team
jobs.description:
Description

The Ring and Blink teams are making neighborhoods safer with innovative security products and services — from the Doorbells and Cameras to endless features accessed in the App’s. The Ring and Blink Customer Support teams help bring this mission to life every day by supporting our neighbors at every point in their journey with us.

The Customer Experience & Insights Team (CEIT) is pioneering AI-driven customer experience transformation. We leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and automation to identify and resolve root causes of customer contacts at scale — from purchase and first product setup, to subscribing to a Protect Plan, and everything in between. By combining AI-powered insights with strategic execution, CEIT drives meaningful improvements that reduce friction and elevate the overall customer experience.

As a Program Manager on CEIT, you will be an AI-forward practitioner who sits at the intersection of artificial intelligence, customer insights, and cross-functional execution. This role is responsible for designing and driving resolution of customer contact drivers and pain points through AI-powered data intelligence, machine learning-assisted workflows, scalable automation frameworks, and strategic stakeholder management. You will leverage generative AI tools daily to accelerate decision-making, surface hidden patterns in customer data, and build intelligent workflows that scale across the organization. Your tactical execution and AI-enabled cross-functional collaboration will directly impact Ring and Blink's ability to deliver an exceptional customer experience — at scale.

Key job responsibilities

AI Strategy & Innovation: Leverage generative AI tools (Amazon Quick Suite, Bedrock, PartyRock) daily to identify root causes, surface insights, and accelerate decision-making. Develop AI-assisted workflows and intelligent automation that scale organization-wide as best practices. Apply machine learning to analyze customer contact data at scale, identifying defects and patterns impossible to detect manually. Pioneer new AI applications within CEIT and contribute to team AI strategy development. Train cross-functional partners on AI adoption and champion AI-forward problem-solving. Stay current on emerging AI/ML technologies to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience

Program Management & Execution: Manage small-to-medium programs and complex cross-team projects with limited oversight. Analyze operational data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities. Drive continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies, defects, and customer pain points. Define program requirements, mobilize teams, and drive goal achievement. Design scalable SOPs, intake workflows, and program frameworks. Optimize cross-team processes to improve efficiency and delivery timelines. Implement change management strategies and measure performance using KPIs. Balance time, quality, and resource trade-offs while identifying risks and escalating appropriately. Mentor junior team members and build team AI capability through hands-on training.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Partner with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations) to align priorities. Prepare executive-level analytics and reporting weekly and monthly for VP and C-suite stakeholders. Lead stakeholders through process transitions with training and documentation. Communicate program status, risks, and decisions to leaders up to three tiers above level. Facilitate meetings, working sessions, and decision-making forums. Build cross-functional partnerships to amplify program impact. Track, analyze, and optimize performance against established goals.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of program or project management experience
Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Hands-on experience applying AI tools (e.g., generative AI, machine learning platforms, automation software) to operational workflows, reporting, or decision-making processes with measurable efficiency gains
Demonstrated ability to analyze operational and business performance data (e.g., KPIs, SLAs, cost metrics) to identify trends, surface root causes, and develop actionable recommendations
Proven experience designing, documenting, and implementing AI-enabled SOPs, intelligent intake workflows, and automated operational frameworks that improve efficiency and reduce friction
Track record of partnering with cross-functional teams (Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations) to align on priorities and drive program outcomes without direct authority

The Selling Partner Satisfaction & Strategic Insights (SPSSI) team owns the measurement, research, and strategic insights that inform how Amazon improves the selling experience for over 2 million sellers worldwide. Description

Prime Video is how hundreds of millions of customers around the world discover, buy, and watch the content they love. Behind every offer a customer sees - every subscription, channel, rental, purchase, bundle, and deal - is a set of world-class systems built and owned by our Commerce team in Bengaluru.

We are the Prime Video Offers team: the front of the funnel for Prime Video's global commerce. We own critical services that determine what every customer in all countries can purchase, rent, or subscribe to - what price they see, what promotions apply, and how offers are composed across product lines. Our systems process billions of requests per day and sit on the critical path for every Prime Video transaction globally.

We are at an inflection point. We're expanding Prime Video Commerce into dozens of new markets while simultaneously transforming the underlying architecture - evolving to deliver flexibility across our products and offers more than ever. These aren't sequential bets; they're happening in parallel, across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations, each with their own roadmaps and constraints. The TPM who owns this will navigate that complexity and make it land.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of these programs. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, product, and business — making trade-off decisions, unblocking cross-org dependencies, driving operational cadence that gives executive leadership confidence without requiring their intervention, and delivering complex multi-org programs.

Key job responsibilities

Strategic Leadership: Own the delivery strategy for programs with senior leadership visibility - international expansion across new markets, architecture transformation milestones, and cross-product capability launches. Define the sequencing, the critical path, and the trade-offs.

Cross-Org Program Execution: Coordinate delivery across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations. Own the workback plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths that keep multi-quarter programs on track across organizational boundaries.

Architecture Transformation Delivery: Drive the program execution of a multi-year architecture plan — platform buildout, API migration across dozens of consumers, interface harmonization across services, and shared capability rollouts. Sequence these against feature delivery so they compound rather than compete.

Operational Cadence & Mechanisms: Build and run the review cadences and launch readiness mechanisms that drive accountability across stakeholder teams. Give leadership clear, honest visibility — with a path to green, not just a status report.

Capacity & Resource Strategy: Map engineering bandwidth against the launch calendar, surface gaps well before they become blockers, and drive trade-off decisions when demand exceeds capacity.

Efficiency & Automation: Drive programs that reduce manual launch effort dramatically — automation targets, test coverage milestones, and effort reduction metrics that turn multi-quarter launches into repeatable, scalable processes.

Stakeholder Influence: Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to align priorities, negotiate timelines, and resolve structural blockers. Represent program health in leadership forums with clarity and conviction.

Your morning starts with a launch readiness review for a new territory — multiple teams on the call, you're making the go/no-go call. Before lunch, you're reviewing a migration burndown with engineering and deciding whether to re-sequence. In the afternoon, you're in a roadmap discussion with Product and senior leadership, making trade-off decisions on what to prioritize. You end the day preparing a status update for the leadership staff meeting — clear, honest, with a path forward. You operate across time zones, hold teams accountable without being adversarial, and know when to push versus when to pull in leadership.

Inclusivity is how we work - we believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard.

Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.

Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?

If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telangana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.

You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.

Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!

Key job responsibilities

Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 5+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.

The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.

A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts

About The Team

Diverse Experiences:

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Description

Love sports? Want to change the world? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Rolland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. Every day we face the challenges of a fast-paced market and expanding technology set. And we're building at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded-owner, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling new experiences to our customers. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

What We're Looking For

We need a highly talented Senior Technical Program Manager to build resilient, highly available, and operationally excellent systems that power our vision. You'll anticipate availability risks, manage critical incidents and escalations, and balance business SLA commitments against technical constraints and operational trade-offs.

You must break down complex reliability initiatives into manageable operational improvements, develop comprehensive availability specifications, and deliver measurable enhancements to system uptime and operational health. We seek someone with a strong curiosity to build and nurture an operationally mature, reliability-focused engineering culture—fostering proactive monitoring practices, blameless post-mortem disciplines, and integrating emerging observability and chaos engineering technologies into our operational excellence framework.

What You Will Do Here

You will own and drive product features partnering with SDMs in our Seattle,WA Austin, TX and Arlington, VA teams. You'll collaborate with Prime Video teams including Catalog, Commerce, Offers, X-Ray, Prime Video Channels, Store Front Automation, devices and more. You will look around corners, anticipate bottlenecks, and use technical judgement to land complex programs for our business. You will also influence and shape how we execute and help drive velocity with high quality. You will manage complex, high-impact availability and operational excellence initiatives spanning multiple teams. Balance competing priorities while maintaining focus on system reliability, operational health, and measurable availability outcomes.

You will transform operational incidents, availability gaps, and reliability concerns into prioritized technical specifications by partnering with engineering and operations teams to identify high-impact reliability requirements. Help teams distinguish between tactical incident fixes and strategic availability solutions, consolidating related operational needs into cohesive reliability improvement projects with clear business value and customer impact.

This role involves regular communication with senior, director, and VP level management on project status and risks, broad cross-team coordination on project execution, creating effective project management strategies to meet deliverables and organize teams, and regular updates to Critical Program Reviews and other reporting mechanisms.

If you’re excited about helping to build the future of live sports or just want to have fun creating something you can be proud to show your family and friends, reach out. We’d love to chat.

A great team to work with and the chance to build a top tier services at a proven top tier company. You will get a startup like culture with the stability of an established industry leader. You will get support and resources from some of the smartest people in the industry to continue learning.

Be involved in designing, implementing, and testing of major features
Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and rollout system changes that meet requirements for functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, and adherence to development goals and principles.

jobs.description:
Description

Our organization spans three distinct Amazon India businesses — Amazon Business (comprising Self-Service Registered / SSR and CPS enterprise sales), Private Brands, and ReCommerce — each on a multi-million-dollar, WW-leading growth trajectory. Delivering that growth depends on executing large, complex, cross-organizational programs across CX, SX, sales, tech, pricing, supply chain, and operations, often with dependencies on Worldwide and partner teams. Increasingly, the most valuable of these programs are AI-powered — agentic buying assistants, AI-driven pricing and selection, intelligent automation across returns and recovery — so AI fluency is central to the role, even as the mandate spans the full breadth of the org's most critical programs.

We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the most critical and complex programs across the portfolio, with a primary focus on Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) and targeted support for the largest, highest-complexity programs in Private Brands and ReCommerce. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning three separate businesses: you will drive alignment across engineering, product, and business leaders.Many of these programs are customer-facing AI products; others are platform, pricing, expansion, supply-chain, or compliance programs — you will own the hardest ones regardless of type.

You will inherit a portfolio of the org's marquee initiatives. Success looks like complex programs delivered on time across team boundaries, dependencies sequenced before they become blockers, and leadership given a single, trusted view of program health.

Key job responsibilities

Own the largest and most complex programs in Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) — the primary focus of the role — driving them end-to-end from definition through launch across engineering, product, pricing, GTMO/sales, and operations. These span customer-facing AI products as well as platform, pricing, expansion, and compliance programs.

Lead delivery of customer-facing AI experiences where they are on the critical path — turning fast-moving AI capabilities into shipped products with clear customer value — while applying the same rigor to the org's other complex, high-stakes programs.

Provide targeted program leadership to Private Brands and ReCommerce — two separate businesses — for their largest and most complex initiatives only, prioritizing where cross-org complexity and business impact are highest.

Drive cross-business and cross-org dependency management — identify, sequence, and unblock the dependencies (tech, data, model/evaluation readiness, tax/accounting, supply chain, WW partner teams) that cause complex programs to slip.

Establish and run program governance — mechanisms, status reporting, and leadership reviews that give each business a single view of health, risk, and critical path.

Be an AI-forward operator. Use GenAI and internal AI tooling extensively to accelerate planning, synthesize status, model dependencies, and compress work that traditionally took days into hours — and help raise the bar on how the broader team adopts AI in program management.

Partner with SDMs and business leaders across all three businesses to convert strategy (OP1/OP2, 3YF/LRF) into sequenced, resourced, executable plans, and mentor other PMs/TPMs on execution rigor.

You start with AI as your co-pilot — synthesizing overnight status across your programs and flagging the two dependencies now on the critical path. If this sounds like the type of experience you'd like to help build - apply here and let's chat!

Who We Are

We are deeply connected with the idea that live sports events are fundamentally different: there is only one shot at delivering the moment until it is forever lost. Our mission is to make sure that our customers never miss a single moment of the sports they love. To do this we need to deliver best-in-class live sports infrastructure, testing, monitoring, and operations to optimize the delivery of live sports experiences at scale. Our team engineers for speed, quality, availability, and scale. As Prime Video has grown, we've increased the depth and breadth of video products we support, with a corresponding increase in the associated size and complexity of our engineering activity and the load on our services. Our goal is to adapt our architecture to maintain and improve our velocity of delivery for customers in the face of these changes, and for our services to be on and error-free 24/7, especially for high-profile, exclusive content. With AI as a transformative force, we're at an inflection point that enables us to unlock new opportunities in predictive analytics, automated defect analysis and mitigation, and automated operations that were previously beyond our reach.

What We're Looking For

We need a highly talented Senior Technical Program Manager to build resilient, highly available, and operationally excellent systems that power our vision. You'll anticipate availability risks, manage critical incidents and escalations, and balance business SLA commitments against technical constraints and operational trade-offs.

You must break down complex reliability initiatives into manageable operational improvements, develop comprehensive availability specifications, and deliver measurable enhancements to system uptime and operational health. This role involves regular communication with senior, director, and VP level management on project status and risks, broad cross-team coordination on project execution, creating effective project management strategies to meet deliverables and organize teams, and regular updates to Critical Program Reviews and other reporting mechanisms.

If you’re excited about helping to build the future of live sports or just want to have fun creating something you can be proud to show your family and friends, reach out. We’d love to chat.

The Data Center Field Engineering Team is the engineering owner for the lifecycle of AWS data centers. This includes supporting new designs/innovations through data center end-of-life, with a focus on root cause analysis of failures, capacity and availability improvement, and optimization of the existing fleet.

As a Field Engineering Technical Program Manager, you are an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally. You will lead multi-discipline and highly technical teams. You will have experience of working in a complex engineering environment and will have worked on increasingly complex projects in multiple disciplines. Your experience includes data center MEP infrastructure technologies including HVAC, power distribution systems, and controls. You will generate and maintain enhanced reporting, meaningful KPIs, and process/automation improvements to ensure team efficiency and visibility of global program efforts to critical stakeholders and leadership.

You will partner with other engineering teams, operations staff, and project execution/delivery teams regularly. You will make strategic decisions regarding specific projects and overall program direction. You will be capable of connecting long-term strategies with rapid growth patterns of AWS, as well as guide specific operational needs of the business.

You must be adept at identifying and communicating upcoming risks, issues, and bottlenecks as well as be instrumental in resolving those issues, often cross multiple departmental boundaries to achieve your goal. You must possess a strong sense of organization, communication and team building skill-sets that foster robust working relationships for both internal and external stakeholders.

Job Description

What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

A Little More About The Role…

WSP’s Project Security Managers sit within the Security Management function and deliver security assurance to all projects within their respective government sector. This could be Defence, Nuclear, or any other Government departmental area. They are responsible for complete security assurance for all prospects and projects with the aim of protecting our client’s most sensitive assets.

As a Project Security Manager, you will play a key role in providing an excellent security assurance service to our clients while identifying improvements to existing security programmes and processes. The role will manage all aspects of classified project delivery across the domains of Personnel, Physical and Information Security. You will be the focal point for all security assurance activity within your respective sector, providing targeted security direction and guidance as required.

Key responsibilities

Regular liaison with client security and project delivery teams in interpreting, implementing, and monitoring client security requirements as outlined in contractual security schedules or Security Aspects Letters (SALs).
Supporting the security accreditation and certification process for all external compliance requirements associated with your respective sector.
Supporting the development and implementation of governance and processes associated with security assurance for your respective sector.
Planning and delivery of assurance activities as required by contractual obligations, including but not limited to induction briefings, project-specific security briefings, supplier onboarding, and security awareness training.
Measuring and assessing the performance and effectiveness of security controls, identifying and implementing solutions where corrective action and improvements are needed.
Reviewing the competencies of WSP’s supply chain in all security assurance domains: Personnel, Physical and Information.
Collaborating with business areas in the identification, management, and mitigation of risks to WSP and its clients.
Supporting the development and maturity of WSP’s Security Management System.
Supporting investigations for all security incidents, including near misses, reported within your respective sector.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Hold SC clearance or the ability to achieve it.
Experience as a security manager or security controller in a regulated sector (e.g. Defence/Nuclear) is desirable.
Demonstrable knowledge of HMG security documentation (e.g. GovS:007), frameworks, policy and controls is essential.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence peers and seniors on matters concerning project security compliance and assurance.
Knowledge of risk management methodologies and practical experience of application.
Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and deliver to tight timescales.
A highly motivated and driven individual who adopts a flexible and adaptable approach.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can.
Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. Overview

Bring your project management experience. Support secure delivery. Make an impact.

At AtkinsRéalis, our Project Managers help bring structure, control and confidence to secure, complex delivery. You'll help manage the deliverables, commitments and contractual obligations we have with our clients, with accountability matched to your capability, experience and the scale of assignment. You'll join a collaborative delivery community and work alongside project, technical, commercial and transformation specialists who valueclear thinking, reliable controls, good governance and shared learning.

We are recruiting for multiple Project Manager roles across a range of capability and accountability levels. We welcome candidates with experience managing delivery in supplier-side, consultancy or complex internal delivery environments, particularly where this involves contractual commitments, client-facing governance and delivery against agreed outcomes. We are also open to applications from people looking for part-time or flexible working arrangements.

You'll Benefit From

Purpose-driven work at the heart of secure-government delivery.
Hybrid working, with time onsite to build relationships, access secure systems and operate effectively in high-integrity environments.
Opportunities to build your project delivery capability and take on broader accountability as your experience grows.
Training, tools and frameworks to support planning, governance, risk, assurance, commercial management and project controls.
A supportive delivery community with access to experienced colleagues, mentoring and practical development opportunities.

Your role

As a Project Manager within our Delivery Optimisation sub-practice, you'll work in secure, client-facing supplier delivery environments where structure, judgement and reliable controls matter. The scope of each role will reflect your experience, from managing defined deliverables or smaller projects through to taking broader accountability for more complex contracted assignments.

You may define delivery roles and ways of working, manage plans, schedules, risks, quality arrangements and reporting, and monitor progress against cost, schedule, quality, commercial and contractual commitments.
You may also manage suppliers, partners or internal delivery teams, support client-facing governance, and identify opportunities to strengthen delivery, resolve issues and add value within the scope of our contracted work.
For more complex assignments, you may coordinate multi-disciplinary delivery teams, manage dependencies and support the successful delivery of agreed outputs, outcomes and benefits.

All our roles are subject to a minimum of 3 days in the office, either onsite with our clients or at one of our AtkinsRéalis offices, pro-rated for part-time employees. We are open to discussing flexible and part-time working patterns where these can support both the role requirements and individual circumstances.

About You

Project management experience in supplier-side, consultancy or complex internal delivery environments.
Experience supporting or leading project activities such as planning, governance, reporting, risk, assurance, finance, commercial management, change or delivery control.
The ability to work with data, delivery tools and project information to support effective decision-making.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, suppliers and clients, particularly where expectations, deliverables and responsibilities need to be managed carefully.
Commercial awareness, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, change control and contractual commitments appropriate to the role.
An understanding of project delivery lifecycles, governance and the importance of robust controls in complex environments.
A proactive, collaborative and considered approach, with the judgement and professionalism to operate effectively in secure, client-facing supplier delivery environments.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud service provider, providing virtualised infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services to customers all over the world. AWS runs a globally distributed environment, operating at massive levels of scale. Businesses, from start-ups to enterprises to large government customers, run their operations and applications on AWS’ highly secure infrastructure.

As a Senior Security Technical Program Manager (Sr. TPM) within our team, you’ll influence and own long-term security outcomes for AWS. You’ll be working with external customers and regulated industries to understand their needs. You’ll be able to design security systems and solutions that enable them to operate more effectively, securely and safely. You will work with your team, partners, and customers to innovate and deliver on the vision and purpose of your programs. While working directly with AWS service teams, infrastructure, and administrative teams, you’ll identify opportunities to improve AWS’ project security posture. This will include building tools, driving process improvements, and working with service owners to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges.

You will be responsible to identify, plan and deliver program security outcomes by independently engaging a broad set of internal and external stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

Coordinate security-related engagements with both internal and external customers, ensuring effective communication and alignment of security objectives.
Coordinate security related engagements with internal and external customers.
Identify security packages of work and meticulously plan for their delivery within agreed timeframes, leveraging strategic foresight to anticipate and address potential challenges.
Implement ISM, PSPF, DSPF, ASIO T4, NIST and/or other security compliance frameworks into design and build baselines to achieve the agreed security posture.
Be proactive to removing roadblocks, fostering innovation, and managing multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, driving continuous improvement and efficiency.
Create, optimize, and support cross-functional working groups and projects, fostering collaboration and synergy across departments to enhance security capabilities.
Utilize domain expertise to develop thought leadership material on cloud and emerging technologies, contributing to industry discourse and organizational knowledge sharing.
Manage tight deadlines with precision and drive results, exhibiting exceptional attention to detail and ensuring the successful completion of projects and initiatives.
Orchestrate cross-functional teams (e.g. services teams, network teams, infrastructure teams, physical security teams, and operations teams) to align technical dependencies, manage competing priorities, and ensuring synchronised progress towards program milestones.
Engage in technical architecture discussions about security controls, understand complex system dependencies across logical and physical domains, and make informed trade-off decisions that balance security rigour with delivery timelines. Maintain a "top-down" strategic view of timelines, risks, and resource constraints across the program while possessing technical credibility to challenge engineering approaches and identify early architectural risks.
Identify and manage risk through the security lens to mitigate security risk that may impact on assurance outcomes, which in turn may impact program delivery.

Hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www1.defence.gov.au/security/clearances).

You'll immerse yourself in teams and leaders from different program stakeholders and businesses at AWS. You'll play a vital role in ensuring security outcomes crucial to our mission. You'll own the responsibility of shaping and implementing processes to meet our program's goals.

jobs.description:
Company Bio

Legal Aid Ontario employees are committed to making a difference in the lives of our clients.

As an integral partner in the Justice system, working at Legal Aid Ontario is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to help people who need it the most; to ensure each client receives the access to justice afforded to them under the law.

If you are looking for a new challenge in your already meaningful career with a team dedicated to justice, and innovation in a flexible and supportive work environment consider this opportunity below.

Primary function

Department Overview

The Enterprise Strategy Management (ESM) department, within the Strategy and Public Affairs (SPA)Division, leads Legal Aid Ontario’s strategic and business planning processes, and strategic initiative delivery. ESM is responsible for the development of LAO’s 5-yearStrategic Plan and its activation across the organization, ensuring alignment of divisional and corporate priorities to government direction, the Letter of Direction (LoD), and LAO’s mandate.

ESM manages LAO’s project delivery framework and provides Project Delivery and Change Management Consultants to support the implementation of strategic initiatives. The department oversees the portfolio and prioritization of projects, ensuring that initiatives are aligned with LAO’s strategy and deliver on government and organizational priorities. ESM also ensures compliance with the Agency and Appointment Directive (AAD) through the Business Plan and Annual Report.

As a central hub, ESM tracks and reports on the status of strategic initiatives and corporate performance for executives, the Board, and the Ministry of the Attorney General (MAG).

The Program Manager, Strategy and Integrated Planning supports the Director, ESM, by leading the operational delivery of LAO’s business planning and performance reporting functions. The Program Manager is responsible for the development of the Annual Business Plan and Annual Report in compliance with the Agency and Appointment Directive (AAD), the activation of LAO’s 5-year Strategic Plan, and the preparation of performance reporting for executives and the Board.

The role also contributes to the successful delivery of LAO’s strategic initiatives by working closely with project delivery staff and change management consultants. In this capacity, the Program Manager ensures initiative reporting aligns with enterprise planning and may support or take a lead role in implementation depending on organizational needs. The position further provides direction and resource management to assigned consultants and analysts supporting planning.

Not applicable

Director, Enterprise Strategy Management

Key accountabilities

Strategy & Integrated Planning

Lead development of LAO’s Annual Business Plan and Annual Report in compliance with the Agency and Appointment Directive (AAD), ensuring alignment with government priorities, the Letter of Direction (LoD), LAO’s strategic plan, and organizational mandate.
Activate and operationalize LAO’s 5-year Strategic Plan, translating priorities into actionable initiatives and integrated planning activities.
Develop and maintain a planning and reporting framework that integrates strategy and business planning.
Support the Office of the CEO with the preparation of the CEO’s report back to the Board, ensuring alignment with organizational performance and strategic commitments.
Coordinate development of Vice-President (VP) commitment letters, including:
Forward-looking letters that establish divisional priorities for the year ahead.
Retrospective summaries of achievements against those priorities, which are rolled into the Annual Report and the CEO report back to the Board.
Provide oversight and guidance for divisional business planning, ensuring consistency, alignment, and integration with LAO’s enterprise planning framework.
Prepare and deliver performance reporting, including KPIs (Key Performance Indicators), KRIs (Key Risk Indicators), and key initiative dashboards to executives and the Board.
Ensure reporting on strategic initiatives is aligned with enterprise planning, business plan commitments, and board/executive reporting requirements.
Work in partnership with the Business Intelligence team to prepare accurate and timely KPI and KRI reporting, ensuring consistency across data sources and alignment with LAO’s performance measurement framework.
Monitor progress and provide regular reporting on key milestones, performance metrics, and deliverables.
Act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on planning and performance insights.

Leadership & Collaboration

Provide direction, coaching, and resource management to assigned staff (consultants/analysts supporting integrated planning), including workload planning, priority-setting, and performance management.
Support staff development through training, feedback, and mentorship to build internal capacity in strategic planning
Build collaborative relationships across LAO.
Promote a culture of accountability, transparency, and results-oriented decision-making.

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, public policy, or a related discipline (Master’s degree preferred).
Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in program management, strategy development, and business planning, ideally within the public or broader public sector.
Experience leading the development of corporate business plans, annual reports, and strategic plans in alignment with government directives.
Strong project management, leadership, and change management skills.
Demonstrated ability to analyze complex information, synthesize insights, and provide strategic advice to senior leadership.
Experience managing and developing professional staff, including consultants or analysts, with proven resource management and coaching capabilities.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience in facilitation, negotiation, and presenting at the executive/Board level.
Strong written communication skills to prepare business plans, briefing notes, and submissions.
High level of organizational and time management skills; able to manage competing priorities and adapt to changing needs.

Description

Amazon's transportation network is a critical driver of the customer experience flywheel, where faster delivery speeds and lower shipping costs attract more customers, generate more volume, and enable continued investment in network expansion. As a Senior Program Manager on the Canada Transportation team, you will be the single point of accountability for Canada's overall Cost to Serve (CtS) owning strategy and execution across last mile, middle mile, air, linehaul, sort center and network design. You will drive LMPP improvement, New facility sort point planning, linehaul capacity planning for events, and end-to-end FC and FDI launches. This is a senior strategic role that blends network design optimization, financial planning ownership, and hands-on execution, requiring you to influence across operations, finance, and planning organizations and drive parity with the best in class in the network.

Key job responsibilities

Own Canada's overall Cost to Serve as the single point of accountability — consolidating tracking, reporting, and delivery across all network segments and partnering cross functionally for integrated CtS management
Drive LMPP metric improvement through leading indicators (fill rate, touch ratio, length of haul), and influencing to reduce IRIS/IRA deviation versus plan
Own Length of Haul (LH) model validation — establishing the LH Plan of Record, measuring deviation between modeled and actual performance, and revising to improve accuracy
Deliver high-fidelity OP1, OP2, QXG, and STP input submissions for Touch Ratio, Length of Haul, and Package Cube forecasts to Finance and planning partners; serve as POC for financials across all planning cycles ensuring PoP, YoY improvements with levers identified and entitlement substantiated,
Manage linehaul HVE planning and capacity optimization converting constraints into speed and cost goals, and systemically addressing constraints
Own end-to-end launches — planning sort points and dock door requirements, creating launch playbooks, working backwards plan, coordinating network design changes, and managing execution - Partner with Finance leadership on Canada finance strategy alignment,
Responsible for driving cost improvement initiatives for all planning cycles, reporting out WBR/DBR/Planning Cycle updates to senior leadership.

A day in the life

You start your day reviewing Cost to Serve performance and leading indicators across all miles. By mid-morning, you lead a linehaul capacity review ahead of an HVE, converting a middle-mile constraint into an addressable plan. After lunch, you validate Athena model outputs against actuals and revise recommendations ahead of the OP2 submission. You close the day coordinating a 1P FC launch playbook with network design and partners, quantifying CX and cost impact for senior leadership. High visibility role requires all encompassing view of supply chain and ability to multi task on initiatives with conflicting delivery timelines.

About The Team

The Canada Transportation team sits within Global Transportation Services (GTS) and Network Design & Planning Execution (NDPE). We own the strategy and execution of Canada's outbound delivery network — Cost to Serve, capacity planning and execution across last mile, middle mile, network design and optimization and facility launches. We partner with fulfillment, sort centers, middle mile, last mile, air, external carriers, Finance, cross border teams and planning organizations to move packages efficiently from shelf to doorstep. We are a collaborative, data-driven team solving complex logistics and financial-planning challenges at scale, with a mandate to drive parity with the US network.

5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

jobs.title: Business Program Manager, Prime Video Commerce Tech
jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video Commerce is the team that powers how hundreds of millions of customers buy, subscribe, and access content on Prime Video — across every country, every device, every payment method. Our Bengaluru site is home to the engineering and leadership teams that own offer vending, payments expansion, and architectural transformation for PV Commerce globally.

We're looking for a Program Manager to run the operating rhythm of our organization. You'll be in every room that matters — taking notes, tracking actions, following up relentlessly, and ensuring the org's written artifacts (MBRs, newsletters, reviews) are sharp, current, and delivered on time. You'll own the systems that keep a 100+ person distributed engineering org running: SharePoint structure, wikis, intake mechanisms, OpEx budgets, attrition tracking, and goal management.

This is a high-agency role. You won't wait to be asked — you'll see what's missing, build it, and drive accountability across leaders. You'll heavily leverage AI tools to automate repetitive work, synthesize information, and operate at a pace that would otherwise require a team. The core of the role is strategic operations: ensuring teams have the information, structure, and mechanisms to make decisions and move fast. You'll also handle logistics and coordination for leadership — but your real value is in the operating system you build around the org, not in any single task.

Key job responsibilities

**Strategic operations and org rhythm**

Be in key meetings — take notes, capture decisions, track actions, and follow up until closed. Nothing falls through.
Own MBR write-ups, newsletters, and leadership communications — drafting, editing, and ensuring they ship on schedule
Follow up on org-level actions across all leaders — you're the accountability mechanism for commitments made in reviews, 1:1s, and staff meetings
Own the org's information architecture: SharePoint sites, wikis, intake mechanisms, and knowledge repositories. Build structure where none exists.
Manage the OpEx budget — track spend, flag anomalies, partner with finance on forecasting
Maintain the attrition tracker, headcount plan, and hiring pipeline status — always current, always accessible to leadership
Provide offline goal summaries and pulls — leaders always have a current view of progress without asking
Manage mechanisms on metrics, artefact reviews, newsletters, OPRs and identify topics that need more attention or documentation that needs work.
Calendar and logistics coordination for the org leader
Pre-read preparation and materials assembly for senior leadership reviews
Use AI to handle the rote parts so your time goes to the higher-judgment work above

**AI-first execution**

Heavily leverage AI tools (Claude/Kiro, internal agents, automation) to synthesize meeting notes, generate first drafts, track patterns across data sources.
Build and maintain AI-assisted workflows for recurring tasks: weekly digests, goal freshness checks, cost trend reports, action item tracking
Continuously identify manual processes that can be automated and implement solutions

**Org level community and culture building**

Run the local community program for PV Commerce BLR: townhalls, team gatherings, social events.
Program manage content for townhall events — sourcing speakers, curating topics, managing logistics, and ensuring each event delivers value

A day in the life

You start the morning by running your AI-assisted digest: it's scanned last week's action items across three reviews and flagged two that are overdue with no update. You send direct follow-ups to the owners before the 10am staff meeting. In staff, you're taking notes — not transcribing, but capturing the three decisions made and four actions assigned. By the time the meeting ends, those are already in the tracker and owners have been pinged.

Mid-morning, you're drafting next week's MBR narrative. You've pulled the data, written the first draft using AI, and are now working with the team to sharpen or explain the narrative.

After lunch, you're in the metrics review taking notes. A leader asks about attrition in one team — you already have the numbers and share them in the chat before anyone needs to go look. Later, you're planning next month's townhall: you've identified speakers, drafted the invite, and coordinated AV. You close the day by sending the weekly ops newsletter to all of Commerce BLR: what shipped, what's coming, who joined, who's leaving, and one thing to celebrate.

About The Team

We are the Prime Video Commerce team in Bengaluru — engineers, managers, and operators who build and own the commerce experiences that customers across the globe interact with every day. We put offers, subscriptions and payment methods on the shelf for hundreds of millions of Prime Video customers, operating across 59+ countries with obsessively high reliability. We are a worldwide team, and we operate like one — working across time zones with genuine empathy. Inclusivity isn't a value we list on a slide; it's how we work. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively create space for every voice to be heard, regardless of level, background, or tenure.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Cisco Networking Group

Meet the team

Cisco's Networking (CN) organization is one that builds on the wonderful history of Cisco inventing and leading the global networking industry. The opportunity in front of all of us is unbelievable. Networks around the globe have been growing for over 35 years, and we are still at the beginning! It’s hard to imagine that three billion of the world’s eight billion people are still unconnected or underserved. Soon enough, we will move from billions of connected things and people to trillions of connected things and people. With the rise of the public cloud, connectivity is no longer simply physical access but includes virtual connectivity. And all this connectivity is central to every experience and every economy around the world. Cisco has been synonymous with connectivity for the last 35 years, and we are excited about creating the next era of connectivity with you.

One of the things that stands out to me is the amount of amazing innovation and passion in every single team. We build great products with employees who have a deep passion for winning and want to help our customers solve their greatest connectivity challenges.

Cisco has always had great innovation, but in the past this innovation and our potential have often been hindered by organizational and product silos. By bringing our teams closer, centralizing and synchronizing our operations, we will accelerate innovation to enable our customers to simplify everything! Central Operations is a new business unit within Cisco’s Networking organization who has been tasked to centralizing our practices as a service across. Our mission is to transform Cisco’s operational efficiencies by using real time data and insights and synchronized business processes to drive business decisions and accelerate the delivery of our strategic agendas. This will enable our vision, which is to increase both the human and cost efficiencies within Cisco, that will enable faster execution of our employees as well as free up capital that will allow us to afford resources earlier than would have been expected. The result is increased Operational Leverage generated by increased operating income, profit, and revenues for Cisco. You would be joining the Networking team, and the Central Operations organization to fulfill this mission and vision.

Your Impact

As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of processes surrounding the commitment of funds within Cisco. You’ll need to understand the policies within Cisco which instruct and require certain aspects of the funding request to be fulfilled and execute to those policies. You will also be responsible for entering each funding request, following them through the approval process, and helping to answer any questions or modify the entry as required. This general approach to managing the commitment of funds extends to our cross-charge functions, as well as our accrual processes. With this responsibility, you will be working intimately with our Business Units across CN and with our partner organizations such as Finance, and Procurement – GSM and GPS & Security Compliance orgs. We are looking for an experienced order fulfillment individual to drive more effective funds commitment and management processes within the business. When there is a roadblock working with other partner organizations, it’s your job to assist. We fulfill each above function by working within our own internally developed Business Operations Command Center Toolset while providing our organization the necessary training, documented procedures, operations, and tools to succeed. You would support many of these activities in support of your team.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who understands the purchasing systems and policies necessary to fulfil purchasing commitments with ease. Someone who makes perfect sense out of every field in SmartBuy, iProcurement, FinABC, GPE/BATS, Fieldglass, CCW and other purchasing and cross charge systems. You have been doing this for years, and desire to begin working more closely with the business units.

We need you if you have a strong interest and experience in business operational practices and can assist in executing processes in a uniform fashion across CN. The processes and systems you will be maintaining will report and analyze intelligence metrics that will set, monitor, and drive improved financial results across CN. It is imperative that the information we enter and the contracts we submit for funding approval be aligned to policy. It’s our job to create efficiencies through quality work products. You will be responsible for reviewing, learning, maintaining, implementing, and improving systems and processes that help the organization scale and run more efficiently. You are a self-starter; able to create a look forward and clear potential issues before they become roadblocks.

You achieve success through strong cross-functional relationships, engaging coworkers, and stakeholders to jointly design and deliver what an individual team could not. You also have a great passion for quality in your execution, you have great attention to detail, and you focus easily to drive tactical tasks to completion. You understand the needs of your cross-functional stakeholders and customers. You measure success in the impact of your programs and breadth of cross-functional contribution. This role is highly collaborative with tactical daily requirements. We will work with many organizations to deliver value to our business unit as well as across the Cisco Enterprise Networking group.

You should have a strong understanding of Cisco systems used to execute our Procurement process, a general understanding of budget management, a tenacious desire to help people become more efficient. You value tactical and operational duties and have no issues spending cycles performing these duties with great attention to their details. You have a solid work ethic, and are ok with working global work hours, as many of your day-to-day customers will be based internationally.

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for overseeing and executing all Purchase Order (PO) and Sales Order (SO) Commitments (CCW Requests)
You will be responsible for supporting finance in our accrual processes
End to end ownership of Beeline (C-Worker Connect) transactions
Manage mid-quarter adjustments and amendments
Work with stakeholders on pending budgets to ensure approved funds are consumed.
Assist requesters in the buying process
Assist in onboarding new suppliers
You will review each contract before submitting it for approval to ensure it has the necessary attributes to be approved by our Finance teams.
You will work across businesses to execute all Cross Charges for the BU
Understand and execute precisely to the GPS / GSM / Finance Policies

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon is seeking an experienced Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to own the strategy and delivery of complex, first-time automation infrastructure deployments across our global fulfillment network.

Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale.

You'll define deployment strategies and plans where none exist, own the full lifecycle of complex cross-functional infrastructure builds from concept through go-live and steady-state handover, and build the mechanisms and predictable process paths that enable downstream teams to scale without direct oversight.

You'll influence within a VP organisation, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy and trade-offs, and actively mentor and develop junior engineers. Working across multiple technologies and regions will accelerate your impact through exposure to diverse stakeholders, regulatory environments, and technical challenges.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Düsseldorf, Munich, Barcelona, London or Vercelli with ~50% travel across Europe during peak deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities

Define and own the end-to-end infrastructure deployment strategy for complex, first-time automation technologies where deployment plans and build strategies do not yet exist
Manage the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional infrastructure builds — unblocking teams, increasing speed of delivery, and negotiating resources and priorities across multiple teams
Lead cross-functional alignment within a VP organisation, advising Senior Managers and Directors on technical trade-offs, deployment decisions, and infrastructure build prioritisation
Define infrastructure build requirements and dependencies for new complex technical products; identify when deployment issues stem from technical design issues and provide feedback to engineering teams
Build scalable deployment mechanisms, frameworks, and tooling that convert first-time deployment complexity into predictable, repeatable process paths adopted organisation-wide
Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term sustainability, using data-driven decision-making and regular metrics review
Mentor and develop junior deployment engineers, perform TIPM promotion assessments, and drive engineering best practices across the deployment organisation
Evaluate and deliver large-scale automation technologies including conveyance, sortation, and robotics systems across multiple countries and building types
Improve, streamline, and eliminate excess process; influence teams to decouple from dependencies and eliminate problems that stifle innovation or cause development collisions

A day in the life

You'll define the deployment strategy for new automation infrastructure, making trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term scalability. During deployment execution, you'll be on-site leading complex first-time implementations through go-live while simultaneously coaching your team and capturing learnings into scalable mechanisms.

You will interact daily with diverse functional teams across multiple time zones. You'll write effective narratives and present to Directors and VPs, conducting regular meetings with internal teams, stakeholders, and vendors. You'll build consensus on contentious deployment decisions, communicate across an increasing diversity of areas (legal, regulatory, finance, operations), and provide context for business and technology choices with a long-term perspective. No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for professional growth as part of a collaborative, focused team.

About The Team

Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon's leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfilment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites
Experience managing complex infrastructure technology programs or deployments end-to-end
Experience defining infrastructure deployment strategies for new technologies where build plans did not previously exist
Ability to define infrastructure build requirements and dependencies for new complex technical products
Experience identifying when deployment issues stem from technical design issues and providing actionable feedback to engineering teams
Experience influencing within a VP organisation and advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy and trade-offs
Experience mentoring and developing engineers
Experience with written communication including authoring narratives and presenting to Directors and VPs

project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification
Experience with robotic deployments in warehouse or fulfillment environments across multiple countries
Experience managing vendor relationships and external contractors at programme level
Experience with Amazon Robotics or similar warehouse automation platforms
Experience training and developing field deployment teams at scale
Multi-country deployment experience with demonstrated ability to adapt processes across regulatory and operational environments
Familiarity with infrastructure deployment automation systems

Amazon has all kinds of jobs for all kinds of people, and prides itself on hiring individuals with all types of background and experiences and celebrates diversity of leadership and thought as a key component in its mission to create the most customer-centric company in the world.

This position requires full-time in-office presence 5 days per week at our CBD location.

Key job responsibilities

Analyse data and dive deep into business metrics to develop actionable strategies that improve cost efficiency and customer outcomes.
Be passionate about customer experience and delivering innovative enhancements on behalf of our customers.
Identify opportunities across the customer returns journey and operational processes, and work with partner teams to deliver innovative solutions.

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst, Special Projects & Investigations - Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

Are you ready to own threat intelligence initiatives that protect millions of Amazon sellers worldwide? The Threat Intelligence team within Special Projects & Investigations (SPI) is obsessed with staying ahead of threat actors and defending our Selling Partners across the Asia-Pacific region. We dive deep into dark and clear web intelligence to uncover unknown abuse vectors, potential internal threats, and organized cyber fraud schemes before they impact our customers and platform.

As a Threat Intelligence Analyst based in Singapore, you will be a core member of our APAC intelligence operation, proactively hunting threat actors, running deep investigations into fraud schemes and abuse networks targeting Amazon, and leveraging AI-native tools and automation to scale your investigative reach across the region. This is not a reactive role. We are building a team that finds threats before they find us, with the goal of doing it with the most advanced AI-augmented intelligence workflows in the industry.

Key job responsibilities

Proactively hunt threat actors and fraud networks operating across Mandarin-language and broader APAC online communities targeting Amazon's seller ecosystem
Conduct deep investigations into organized abuse schemes including seller fraud, account takeover, counterfeit operations, and platform manipulation, from initial lead to actionable intelligence output
Build, operate, and continuously improve AI-augmented investigation workflows that scale threat detection and intelligence production, reducing manual toil and expanding coverage velocity
Produce clear, concise, and actionable finished intelligence that drives decisions by partner teams across enforcement, policy, and legal
Apply structured analytic frameworks to map threat actor TTPs, build actor profiles, and contribute to the team's threat picture
Collaborate with global partners SPI TI counterparts to integrate APAC intelligence findings into the worldwide threat picture and inform proactive detection models
Support partner team requests, bringing investigative depth and regional expertise to complex, high-priority cases
Identify intelligence gaps and develop collection requirements that strengthen the team's proactive posture

A day in the life

Your morning starts with a sweep of deep, dark web forums, Telegram channels, and Mandarin-language communities, looking for signals before they become incidents. When something surfaces, you investigate: mapping actors, reverse engineering the tactics used, building the picture. Your findings become finished intelligence that enforcement, policy, and legal teams act on. Between investigations, you're refining the automation and workflows that make tomorrow's work faster and wider in reach. No two days are identical, but the focus never shifts, find threats before they land.

About The Team

We're a global threat intelligence team with a simple mission: find threats before they find us. We blend rigorous analytic tradecraft with AI-native tools to investigate fraud networks, track threat actors, and protect sellers across Amazon's marketplace. We work closely with enforcement, policy, and legal partners who act on what we produce. We're a small team that writes well, thinks critically, and genuinely geeks out on how threat actors operate. If you want to build the most advanced intelligence operation in e-commerce, and do it alongside people who care about doing it right, you'll fit in here.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
3+ years of experience in threat intelligence, fraud investigation, trust & safety, corporate intelligence, or a related investigative discipline
High proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (speaking, reading and writing) for China market-focused research and communication purposes.
Demonstrated experience conducting proactive OSINT investigations and threat actor tracking using professional-grade intelligence collection and analysis tooling
Demonstrated use of AI tools, LLMs, or automation frameworks to accelerate or scale analytical and investigative workflows
Experience producing finished intelligence products with clear analytical assessments and risk recommendations for non-technical stakeholders
Familiarity with the threat landscape including regional fraud ecosystems, cybercrime forums, and threat actor communities
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Background in e-commerce fraud, marketplace abuse, or platform integrity at a technology company, corporate intelligence, financial crime, or trust & safety experience is equally valued alongside government or military intelligence backgrounds
Degree or coursework in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline
Familiarity with APAC regional threat dynamics, fraud ecosystems, and the regulatory environment across Southeast Asia
Experience with dark web intelligence collection, actor attribution, and structured analytic tradecraft
Experience contributing to or building intelligence automation pipelines using scripting or workflow tooling
Relevant certifications in intelligence analysis, cybersecurity, fraud, or data analysis

Summary

The Market & Business Intelligence Manager, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, will lead the development and execution of analytics strategies that support firm-wide decision-making, portfolio optimization, and sector intelligence. This role will manage a team of business analysts, ensuring high-quality delivery of data products and insights that power various intelligence initiatives. This role will also itself have responsibilities to gather, analyze and provide insights that inform firm strategy, talent strategy, and business development. The ideal candidate combines technical depth, strategic thinking, ability to communicate clearly with senior executives and staff, and strong leadership capabilities.

Location

This position can sit in our Reston, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Raleigh, San Diego, Seattle, Short Hills, Washington DC, or Wilmington office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Development: Manage and mentor a team of analysts, fostering a collaborative, high‑performance culture.
Strategic Planning and Execution: Design and implement analytics strategies that align with firm goals, including proactive intelligence delivery and client segmentation.
Project Management: Lead analytics projects from scope to delivery, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations are met.
Stakeholder Engagement: Partner with senior leaders across Sector Practices, Practice Groups, Business Development & Marketing, and corporate groups to understand needs and deliver actionable insights.
Data Governance and Compliance: Ensure adherence to data governance policies, maintaining data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
Tool Development and Enhancement: Oversee the evolution of internal tools for advanced business analytics, workflow automation, and reporting capabilities.

Statistical Analysis & Data Mining: Proficiency in statistical methods and techniques to extract insights from complex datasets, including expertise with AI for market & business analysis. Advanced Analytics: Deep knowledge of analytics methodologies, tools, and technologies, including predictive modeling and segmentation. Programming & Database Management: Strong skills in the Microsoft environment (e.g., Fabric, Azure), Python, R, or SQL, with experience in querying and managing large databases. Project Management: Skilled in managing multiple projects with competing priorities and stakeholders. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to translate complex data into clear insights and influence decision-making across departments.

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.

Preferred Education   

Masters Degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, or related field.

8 years’ progressive experience working in the business analytics, market research and/or competitive intelligence environment.

Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required.

Comply with all firm policies and practices.
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed.
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.
