The job

The Senior Market and Competitive Intelligence Manager is a strategic, high-impact individual contributor role designed to shape and elevate AVEVA’s global market, competitor, and customer intelligence capabilities. This role is critical in driving our Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy by providing actionable, data-driven insights that empower senior sales and marketing leadership.

The ideal candidate is a highly organised self-starter and a builder who thrives in a dynamic environment, possessing deep expertise in software solutions serving industrial segments (including Chemicals, Oil & Gas, MMM, Power, EPC, Marine, and Life Sciences). You will take ownership of complex intelligence projects—ranging from strategic market trends, industry analyses, and customer segmentation to deep-dive competitor analyses for competitive takeouts, account segmentation, and analysis. By managing intelligence databases, synthesising complex market data into clear, executive-ready narratives, and collaborating across global functions, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our intelligence function and directly influencing AVEVA’s commercial success and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities

Competitor & Market Analysis: Conduct deep-dive competitor analyses and provide critical intelligence for marketing and sales strategy, competitive pitch preparations, and quarterly competitive compass internal presentations.
Strategic Intelligence Leadership: Lead the development and execution of market and competitive intelligence programmes that directly inform AVEVA’s GTM strategy, yearly strategic planning, and commercial priorities.
GTM & Sales Enablement: Drive intelligence initiatives that support global and regional campaigns, including supporting the development of global Target Account List (TAL) frameworks, customer/prospect segmentation, and cross-sell/upsell strategies.
Executive Storytelling: Synthesise complex data from a wide array of sources into simple, highly relevant, and visually compelling reports and presentations for senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and Business Area Leadership.
Tool & Database Management: Oversee, optimise, and extract maximum value from market intelligence tools, databases, and dashboards (e.g., Internal PowerBI / IIR dashboards), ensuring data is accessible and actionable for commercial teams.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a trusted advisor to Sales Leaders, Lead Development Representatives (LDRs), Global and Regional Sales and Marketing teams, and Business Areas, translating market trends to support sales and marketing strategies.
Function Building: Proactively identify opportunities to mature and expand the intelligence function, driving continuous improvement and angling the team's output toward proactive intelligence-based GTM enablement.

5–8+ years of experience in market intelligence, competitive intelligence, strategic marketing, or a related analytical role, ideally within the B2B enterprise software sector.

Exceptional ability to distil complex, multi-faceted data into clear, concise, and relevant insights for senior executive audiences. Strong presentation and storytelling skills.
Proven experience managing and extracting insights from intelligence tools, databases, and dashboards. Strong data analysis capabilities.
Highly autonomous and proactive, with a strong desire to take ownership and help build/mature an intelligence function.
High degree of flexibility with the ability to influence without authority, seek win-win solutions, and collaborate agilely across global, matrixed teams.
Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, engineering, science, or a related field.

Through integrated reputation, demand, engagement and enablement programs, we are at the very heart of advancing AVEVA’s mission to spark industrial ingenuity and drive responsible use of the world’s resources.

Whether you’re crafting world-class events and experiences or defining the go-to-market strategy for a particular region, industry or solution, you’ll be driving the success of AVEVA and our remarkable community of sellers, partners and customers.

This position is flexible and hybrid, conducted at the Mark Center in Alexandria, VA, the Pentagon, and via telework.

Join a collaborative team of 8 multi-disciplinary science & technology, legal, and security professionals who are on a mission to advance the economic security priorities of OUSW(R&E) and the United States
Shape the policy and enforcement landscape of U.S. economic security with respect to the OUSW(R&E) Critical Technology Areas and other technology protection priorities.

Write code to loop AI API over business intelligence data to look for national security risks.

Use AI to comb through corporate filings for red flags.
Suggest contractual language to mitigate foreign investment risks.

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed together
Trusting – we choose to trust each other
Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
Future Focused – we accelerate change
Curious – we turn knowledge into action

The Opportunity

Global wind and solar capacity additions now exceed all other generation technologies combined, and the accuracy of weather-driven production estimates has become a first-order determinant of asset value, financing cost, and curtailment risk across every region Wood Mackenzie covers. As markets move toward hybrid, storage-paired, and round-the-clock renewable structures and merchant price exposure rises, the gap between a well-specified and a poorly-specified production profile translates directly into basis points on project IRR and into real disputes between developers, lenders, and offtakers.

Wood Mackenzie's Power & Renewables research is the reference point utilities, IPPs, developers, investors, and financial institutions turn to for independent, defensible power market and asset-level views worldwide. That standing rests on the credibility of the data underneath it, and weather-to-power modelling is one of the least commoditised, highest-leverage parts of that data stack. The function is also evolving fast: machine learning and AI-based approaches to weather nowcasting, satellite-derived resource estimation, and calibration are moving from research curiosities to production tools, and there are relatively few analysts who combine meteorological data fluency, power market context, and modern ML tooling, making this a distinctive and fast-growing skill set to build early in a research career.

Joining this function gives you direct exposure to how resource assessment assumptions flow through into capacity expansion outlooks, price curves, and asset valuations used in live client transactions across multiple global markets, rather than working on production forecasting as an isolated technical exercise.

The Role

We are looking for a technically strong Research Analyst to build and maintain the weather and production profile datasets that underpin Wood Mackenzie's global power market research. You will work closely with Senior Analysts and Principal Analysts across regional teams to translate raw meteorological, satellite, and asset-level data into hourly generation profiles that feed directly into our capacity expansion models, price forecasts, and asset-level revenue models.

This is a hands-on, technically-oriented role. You will spend the majority of your time working with weather and satellite datasets, asset characteristics data, calibration and validation workflows, and increasingly with machine learning and AI-based methods, building and QAQCing hourly production profiles and validating model output against observed plant generation across multiple geographies.

Key Responsibilities

Weather data processing and quality control

Source, clean, and process gridded weather datasets, including reanalysis products (ERA5, MERRA-2), satellite-derived irradiance (e.g. NSRDB, CAMS, SARAH), and numerical weather prediction (NWP) output, for use in production profile modelling
Perform quality control on raw weather inputs, including gap-filling, bias correction against ground-station or satellite reference data, and consistency checks across data vintages
Maintain structured weather databases across South Asia and APAC, ensuring version control and traceability of underlying data sources

Wind and solar production profile modelling

Build and maintain hourly wind and solar production profiles at site and portfolio level, incorporating asset characteristics (turbine model and hub height, panel technology and tilt/azimuth, inverter specification, layout and spacing) alongside power curve modelling, wake loss adjustment, system losses, degradation, and curtailment assumptions
Support long-term resource assessment (P50/P90 exceedance analysis) for utility-scale wind and solar assets globally, applying inter-annual variability and measurement-correlate-predict (MCP) techniques where relevant
Apply machine learning and statistical methods (e.g. gradient boosting, random forests, neural network-based weather-to-power mapping) to improve production profile accuracy where they outperform physical or engineering-based approaches, under the guidance of senior team members
Translate site-level weather, satellite, and asset data into generation profiles that feed into Wood Mackenzie's capacity expansion, dispatch, and asset revenue models

Model validation and back-testing

Calibrate production profile models against actual SCADA or grid-metered generation data, and validate forecast accuracy by quantifying and documenting forecast error (MAPE, RMSE) by technology, geography, and time horizon
Support back-testing of forecast methodologies against realised generation, identifying systematic biases (e.g. wake modelling, soiling, curtailment under-estimation) and feeding corrections back into the calibration workflow
Assist in evaluating and piloting AI/LLM-assisted tools for data processing, documentation, and anomaly detection within the production forecasting workflow

Research and data support

Track and interpret weather-driven trends relevant to renewable output across global markets, including seasonal and inter-annual variability, and their implications for capacity factors and revenue forecasts
Support Senior and Principal Analysts with data preparation, chart production, and analysis for client deliverables, research notes, and bespoke advisory projects
Maintain thorough documentation of modelling assumptions, data sources, and methodology to ensure model outputs are transparent, defensible, and repeatable across markets

Requirements

Qualification and experience

2–5 years of relevant experience in renewable energy resource assessment, meteorology, wind/solar production forecasting, or power system data analysis; experience at a renewable energy developer, IPP, technical advisory firm, or meteorological services provider is an advantage
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Renewable Energy Engineering, Environmental Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline
Working knowledge of wind and/or solar resource assessment methodologies, including power curve application, wake modelling concepts, and irradiance-to-power conversion (e.g. PVsyst, System Advisor Model, WAsP, or equivalent)
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, xarray) and/or SQL for processing large, gridded, time-series weather datasets; familiarity with NetCDF and geospatial data formats is an advantage

This role sits within the C&AFC F&P team responsible for the implementation and execution of the risk management framework for C&AFC risks across the bank, including methodology, processes, systems and training. This role is focused on ensuring that C&AFC data is sourced, controlled, documented and prepared to a standard that enables reliable risk management, analytics, MI and reporting. As a Data Operations Analyst, you will maintain the data processes, repositories, catalogues and dashboard inputs that support critical control processes, risk metrics, risk assessments and Group-level reporting. By ensuring data is accurate, consistent, complete and clearly governed, the role provides the trusted data foundation required for effective oversight, insight generation and decision-making across the C&AFC function.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with demonstrable expertise in writing and debugging complex formulas, managing PivotTables, and developing or maintaining VBA macros for process automation.
Strong practical experience with data handling, including manual data extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) processes, with a keen eye for detail and data accuracy.
Solid understanding of data governance principles, including metadata management, data lineage, data quality, and the importance of maintaining robust data catalogues.

A methodical and control-oriented mindset, with proven ability to follow procedural documents and maintain clear, auditable evidence of process execution.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly articulate data issues and collaborate effectively with data providers and consumers.

Fluent spoken and written English.

Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, data catalogues, data repositories, and workflow or reporting platforms would be advantageous.
Awareness of artificial intelligence applications and their potential use in data quality, analytics and reporting is beneficial.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

jobs.description:
Scientific Games

Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.

Position Summary

Résumé du poste

En tant que Chargé de projet client, vous êtes chargé de collaborer avec les clients et les équipes internes afin de mener à bien et de livrer avec succès des projets de mise en œuvre qui couvrent une ou plusieurs unités commerciales. Vous gérerez le calendrier global du projet, les problèmes et les risques, les dépenses par rapport au budget et communiquerez l'état d'avancement du projet aux parties prenantes, aux clients internes ou externes et à la direction générale. Nous recherchons un Chargé de projet client doté d'un leadership fort, d'excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion de projet « pratique », ainsi que d'une capacité à motiver les autres grâce à sa vision, son positionnement stratégique et ses qualités de leadership.

Fonctions et responsabilités

Vous fournissez un point de contact central pour les projets et vous aidez au développement des projets de leur conception initiale jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre finale. Vous facilitez la définition de la portée et des objectifs des projets, et vous coordonnez tous les aspects du projet, planifiez et dirigez les calendriers ainsi que les budgets. Vous devez être capable de travailler dans un environnement hybride, en utilisant à la fois les méthodologies Agile et en Cascade ( Agile and Waterfall methodologies ). Vous devez posséder de solides compétences dans la préparation de budget ainsi que la prévision et le suivi des performances financières par rapport au budget.

Qualification et compétences

Diplôme universitaire de premier cycle ou expérience équivalente
5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet et en direction de projets de mise en œuvre à grande échelle chez des clients
Certification PMP un atout
Une expérience en conseil informatique/sous-traitance ou dans l'un des quatre grands cabinets de conseil informatique est un plus !
Expérience dans la planification et la mise en œuvre de programmes et de projets à grande échelle impliquant l'approvisionnement, le développement de logiciels, l'infrastructure, la logistique, les fournisseurs tiers, le personnel sur site et hors site, les solutions numériques et mobiles utilisant les méthodologies Waterfall et Agile.
Expérience dans la mise en œuvre de solutions logicielles numériques
Capacité à voyager et à se rendre sur site pour les mises en œuvre chez les clients (possibilité jusqu'à 30 % du temps et principalement dans la province de Québec)
Expérience avérée dans la gestion réussie de programmes ou de projets de taille moyenne à grande
Solides compétences interpersonnelles et collaboratives, ainsi qu'un esprit critique requis.
Des compétences élevées en matière de présentation, de communication, de leadership, de collaboration et de relations humaines sont requises.
Expérience dans la gestion de plusieurs projets simultanés.
Expérience professionnelle pratique dans le développement, la création, la réponse, la rédaction, la contribution et la révision de demandes d'informations, d'appels d'offres, de propositions, d'élaboration de propositions, d'estimation des coûts de projets, de budgets de projets et de plans de projets.
Expérience professionnelle pratique dans la gestion de programmes ou de projets, depuis la demande d'informations jusqu'au lancement, la planification, l'exécution, la gestion et le contrôle, la clôture, le soutien après la mise en service et le transfert vers les opérations.
Nous recherchons des candidats motivés, déterminés, soucieux du détail et capables de travailler de manière autonome, de bien travailler sous pression, de collaborer et de travailler sans relâche pour trouver des solutions aux défis commerciaux, et de livrer des programmes et des projets dans les délais, dans le respect du budget et avec un niveau exceptionnel de qualité et de satisfaction client.
Formation et expérience en gestion de projet agile (une certification est un plus !)
Expérience technique avec le cycle de vie complet du développement logiciel (SDLC) dans les domaines des logiciels, des infrastructures, du numérique et du mobile, avec des processus d'assurance qualité et de gestion des versions (un atout !)
Français et Anglais parlé et écrit de niveau avancé (le rôle peut inclure des communications avec le Siège Social aux États-Unis)

Qualifications Et Compétences Additionnelles (un Atout)

Formation et expérience en gestion de projet agile ( Agile Project Management ) (une certification est un plus !)
Expérience technique avec le cycle de vie complet du développement logiciel (SDLC) dans les domaines des logiciels, du numérique et du mobile, avec des processus d'assurance qualité et de gestion des versions

Rôle et fonctions

Gérer un portefeuille d'initiatives complexes couvrant un ou plusieurs secteurs d'activité.
Développer et gérer tous les aspects de l'engagement dans le projet, depuis la planification jusqu'aux relations avec les fournisseurs externes, en passant par la communication, les ressources, le budget, les changements, les risques et les problèmes.
Prise en charge complète du cycle de vie du projet : la réussite du projet inclura la mise en œuvre complète, depuis le lancement jusqu'au déploiement, d'une initiative majeure ou de plusieurs initiatives mineures simultanément.
Gérer tous les aspects de plusieurs projets connexes afin de garantir que la mise en œuvre globale soit alignée sur les objectifs stratégiques et contribue directement à leur réalisation.
Travailler de manière créative et analytique dans un environnement axé sur la résolution de problèmes, en faisant preuve d'esprit d'équipe, d'innovation et d'excellence.
Comprendre les interdépendances entre la technologie, les opérations et les besoins commerciaux.
Faire preuve d'un sens fonctionnel pour soutenir la manière dont les solutions répondront aux objectifs des clients tout en restant en phase avec les meilleures pratiques du secteur.
Assurer une communication appropriée et efficace à tous les niveaux du projet.
Identifier et développer une relation de confiance avec les parties prenantes, les sponsors, les acteurs et les clients du projet et du programme.
Définir et gérer en permanence les attentes du projet et du programme tout en déléguant et en gérant les livrables avec les membres de l'équipe, les parties prenantes et les clients.
Poursuivre son développement professionnel afin de rester à jour sur les technologies, les méthodes et les meilleures pratiques émergentes.

Qualités et compétences

Orienté vers la performance et responsable : a des normes de performance élevées. Surpasse ses pairs.
Autonome : apporte des solutions plutôt que des problèmes. Remet en question le statu quo. A le courage d'adopter une position impopulaire.
Rapide/agile : élimine les obstacles pour aller plus vite. Expérimente et s'adapte. S'épanouit sous pression et dans un rythme rapide.
Prise de risques intelligente : prend des décisions/fait des recommandations audacieuses.
Esprit de croissance : fait preuve de curiosité.
Orienté vers l'extérieur : comprend les implications en amont et en aval de son travail. Suit et partage les tendances externes, les meilleures pratiques ou les idées.

Conditions d'emploi

Scientific Games, LLC, et ses filiales (collectivement, « SG ») exercent des activités hautement réglementées dans le domaine des jeux et des loteries. Par conséquent, certains employés de SG peuvent, entre autres, être tenus d'obtenir une licence de jeu ou d'autres licences, de se soumettre à des enquêtes sur leurs antécédents ou à des contrôles de sécurité, ou de satisfaire à certaines normes imposées par la loi, la réglementation ou des contrats. Afin de garantir le respect de ses engagements réglementaires et contractuels, SG exige de tous ses employés qu'ils satisfassent aux exigences nécessaires à l'exercice de leurs fonctions individuelles, comme condition préalable à leur embauche et au maintien de leur emploi. Comme condition préalable à l'emploi chez SG (dans la mesure où la loi le permet), vous serez invité à consentir à ce que SG procède à une vérification préalable/enquête sur vos antécédents.

Cette description de poste ne doit pas être interprétée comme exhaustive ; elle vise à identifier les principales responsabilités et exigences du poste. L'employé occupant ce poste peut être amené à accomplir d'autres tâches et responsabilités liées à son travail que celles mentionnées ci-dessus.

Qualifications

The Client Experience Project Manager (CEPM)
serves as the project manager for execution of services delivered to clients. The CEPM supports the execution of coaching engagements and holds primary responsibility for each client project including holding a clear understanding of the project and its complexities; identifying and securing needed resources; managing client communication and expectations; leading internal and external meetings; coordinating project pacing and deliverables management; administering client surveys; preparing reports; and ensuring the smooth completion of client services.

The CEPM must be comfortable with tight timelines and holding themselves and others accountable for deliverables. 

This role recognizes the pivotal role they play in the full client experience journey, in collaboration with returning and long-time clients, while at the same time welcoming and onboarding new clients with professionalism and ease.

The Client Experience Project Manager should be a self-motivated problem solver and critical thinker, offering thought partnership when they see situations, processes or systems that can be enhanced and improved. Impact | “Ignite Next Level”

Perform data entry and project tracking through use of Monday.com 
Order client gifts tied to delivery

Demonstrated success in client service roles
Excellent time and task management, with an eye for systems and efficiencies
Proficiency in MS Office, Google Drive, and other relevant software for project management; Monday.com experience preferred
Highly motivated with a growth mindset - be highly curious and have a love of learning.
Excellent oral and written communication skills

Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to present solutions
Ability to quickly learn and use new technology and the agility to adapt as needed
Equally comfortable working within a team and independently
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Attention to excellent customer service
Appreciative of a collaborative team environment

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical

As a project manager for Canonical’s Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location:
This role will be based remotely in the APAC region

The role entails

Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
Assisting in the development of project statements of work
Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
Managing project risk mitigation and plans
Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
Maintaining daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
Identify custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
Advocating for the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What We Are Looking For In You

Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

UK | Remote-first with client travel

Full-time | Permanent

Reporting to: Head of Client Transformation

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced HRIS Project Manager to lead complex HR, payroll and people-technology transformation programmes across our client base.
This role goes beyond traditional project delivery. You’ll act as a consultative delivery partner, accountable not only for timelines, scope and governance, but also for commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, successful adoption and ensuring clients realise the full value of their transformation investment.
Working within our Client Transformation team, you’ll partner with senior client stakeholders, HR and Payroll leaders, technology vendors, system integrators, internal consultants and Silver Cloud leadership to drive successful outcomes.
This is an opportunity to shape the future of our clients while helping Silver Cloud continuously evolve its transformation methodologies, delivery standards and client proposition.

What you’ll be doing

Programme delivery and governance
Lead end-to-end delivery of HR, payroll and HRIS transformation programmes, from initiation and discovery through to testing, go-live, hypercare and transition to business as usual
Create and maintain integrated project plans covering client, vendor, system-integrator and Silver Cloud activities
Own project governance, including RAID logs, actions, decisions, dependencies, change control, status reporting and milestone management
Manage scope, budget, resources, timelines and quality throughout delivery
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, escalation routes and decision-making processes
Facilitate project boards, steering committees, governance forums and executive updates
Identify risks and issues early, establish appropriate mitigation and drive actions through to resolution
Support programme recovery where delivery has moved off track or requires additional structure

Understand the client’s wider business and transformation objectives and ensure programme activity remains aligned to them
Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, decision forums and stakeholder-engagement activities
Translate complex project information into clear, practical updates for technical and non-technical audiences
Provide independent advice and constructively challenge decisions where this will improve the client outcome
Manage expectations transparently and support clients through difficult decisions, competing priorities and periods of significant change

HRIS and transformation delivery
Coordinate activity across HRIS vendors, implementation partners, client workstream leads and Silver Cloud specialists
Develop a clear understanding of the relationship between HR, payroll, data, integrations, testing, business processes and organisational change
Ensure business requirements, design decisions, dependencies and acceptance criteria are understood and documented
Oversee readiness across key workstreams such as data migration, integrations, testing, parallel payroll, training, communications and go-live
Support clients to move towards effective future-state processes rather than simply recreating existing ways of working in a new system
Ensure handover, operational readiness and transition to business as usual are planned and completed effectively

Commercial ownership
Maintain accurate forecasts and provide clear visibility of project health
Monitor project financials, resource consumption, milestones and delivery against the agreed scope
Identify commercial risks early and manage them in partnership with Silver Cloud leadership
Apply robust change control where requirements or delivery needs move beyond the agreed engagement
Recognise opportunities where additional Silver Cloud support could deliver genuine value for the client
Contribute to account growth through trusted relationships, high-quality delivery and a strong understanding of client needs
Support proposals, scoping and mobilisation for new or expanded engagements when required

Team and programme leadership
Coordinate consultants, technical specialists, client teams, vendors and third-party partners across multiple workstreams
Manage dependencies, competing priorities and critical delivery milestones
Create a collaborative, accountable and high-performing programme environment
Provide clear direction while enabling specialists to take ownership within their areas of expertise
Support coaching, mentoring and knowledge sharing across the Client Transformation team
Promote open communication, early escalation and collective problem-solving

Change and continuous improvement
Support organisational-change and adoption activities throughout the programme
Ensure solutions are embedded successfully into client operations rather than treating go-live as the end of the transformation
Establish meaningful measures of readiness, adoption and transformation success
Facilitate lessons-learned activity and translate findings into practical improvements
Contribute to Silver Cloud’s project-management methodologies, templates, tools and quality standards
Share knowledge and reusable approaches that improve consistency across future engagements

What success looks like

Success in this role means:
Programmes are delivered with clear governance, strong momentum and informed decision-making
Scope, budget, timelines, quality and commercial performance are managed effectively
Forecasts and project reporting are accurate, timely and transparent
Risks, issues and dependencies are identified early and actively managed
Client stakeholders understand the programme position and have confidence in the delivery approach
Delivery teams operate with clarity, accountability and a shared understanding of priorities
Clients achieve agreed business, technology and transformation outcomes
New systems and ways of working are embedded successfully into day-to-day operations

What we’re looking for

Proven experience leading complex projects or programmes across the full delivery lifecycle
Strong experience within HR, payroll, HRIS or people-technology transformation
Experience managing HRIS, payroll or enterprise-system implementations from the client side, consultancy side or within professional services
Good understanding of the dependencies between business process, data, integrations, testing, change, training and operational readiness
Experience working with technology vendors, system integrators, internal specialists and senior business stakeholders
Strong project governance, planning, change-control, risk-management and reporting capability
Commercial awareness, including experience managing budgets, forecasts, scope and project financials
Confidence facilitating steering committees and communicating programme health to executive stakeholders
Ability to challenge constructively, resolve ambiguity and maintain progress through complex delivery situations
Experience leading remote, cross-functional and multi-party teams
Ability to manage multiple projects, clients or workstreams while maintaining delivery quality
Strong written and verbal communication skills
A collaborative, low-ego leadership style and willingness to share knowledge
Strong attention to detail with a practical, outcome-focused approach
Confidence working independently within a remote-first consultancy environment
Flexibility to travel to client and team locations across the UK when required

Desirable experience

Experience delivering global or multi-country HR and payroll programmes
Exposure to HRIS selection, project readiness, digital review or programme-recovery engagements
Experience supporting presales, statement-of-work development, solution scoping or account growth
Familiarity with tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project or ClickUp

Silver Cloud is a boutique, fast-growing digital transformation consultancy specialising in HR, payroll and people technology.

Join Our Team...

This role is for a
Staff Technical Program Manager within GoDaddy’s engineering organization, focused on building scalable, fault-tolerant systems that power critical customer and platform experiences at massive scale.

A computer science degree or comparable background in the industry.
Direct experience with major SIEM and SOAR platforms, cloud provider security services, or Kubernetes-native security tooling.
Experience running Sev 1 or Sev 2 incident coordination.
Prior work on data protection, privacy, or DLP programs.

The company has earned recognition from various publications and has been named to prestigious lists. It has also made history by being the first company to go live with a key industry standard and testified before a government committee on the future of identity.

The company supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in-office. It operates as a digital-first organization with strong collaboration across different regions. The company maintains physical offices in several U.S. cities and in India. Depending on the role and location, there may be an expectation to spend time in the office regularly. Role

The organization is looking for an experienced Learning & Development professional
to build and scale learning initiatives.

This is a foundational role. The individual will define the learning strategy, mature existing programs, and build new ones that help employees, managers, and leaders grow throughout their careers.

The role will own learning across the employee lifecycle - from onboarding and fraud education through to manager development, leadership capability, performance enablement, and knowledge sharing. Develop and own the organization's learning and development strategy, identifying capability gaps and prioritizing learning initiatives that have measurable business impact.

Design and facilitate engaging workshops, training sessions, and learning experiences for employees, managers, and leaders across the company.
Improve how employees access and share knowledge by helping build scalable learning resources, documentation, and self-service tools.

Experience in a startup or high-growth technology company.
Experience supporting technical organizations.

/year + equity + benefits

Follow Through

Do Something Smart

Job Description

Who will you be working with?

This position with support the Train Performance and Automation P&L within Digital Intelligence. The Program Manager will be a customer facing and will be responsible for delivering projects on schedule and on budget. This will include managing the project through quality, engineering and operations. This person will be expected to understand earned value financials, responsible for communicating cost, schedule, and production deliveries to customer (internal and/or external). The position will be responsible for identifying and managing risk associated with each project. This person will also work closely with the manufacturing team to manage demand and drive parts for projects assigned, as applicable. This position would preferably be located in Melbourne, FL or Cedar Rapids, IA.

How will you make a difference?

The Program Manager is responsible for leading programs from initial contract proposal through execution and support. This role ensures programs are built on a strong foundation, delivered according to commitments, and positioned for long‑term customer success. The Program Manager drives technical coordination, risk‑informed planning, customer communication, and disciplined program controls while fostering predictable, high‑quality execution.

What do we want to know about you?

College BS/BA degree required, with preference given to engineering, software fields, or business management areas of study.
Must have knowledge of Systems/Software Project Management.
7–10 years of experience managing complex, cross‑functional projects or programs.
Proven ability to drive clarity in requirements, schedules, and acceptance criteria.
Experience with enterprise PM tools such as Clarity, Primavera, Rally, Oracle.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and decision‑making skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead without authority in a matrixed environment.
10-15% travel requirement

Key Skills & Competencies

Organizational Awareness – Ability to navigate complex stakeholder landscapes.
Coaching & Motivation – Lead teams through influence, development, and engagement.
Data Accuracy / Data Governance – Ensure data used in decisions and reporting is clean, consistent, and reliable.
Decision‑Making – Make fast, informed decisions supported by facts, risk insights, and cross‑functional alignment.
Digital Adoption – Competent with enterprise tools and digital program management platforms (Clarity, Rally, Primavera, Oracle).
Financial Acumen – Understand EAC, forecasting, cost control, and risk reserve management.
Process & Framework Adherence – Apply standard PMO processes rigorously.
Growth Mindset / Continuous Improvement – Seek efficiencies and drive better outcomes continuously.
Collaboration & Influence – Work across teams to drive commitments and resolve issues.
Data Visualization & Reporting – Convey complex information clearly to leadership and customers.

What will your typical day look like?
1.
Contract Proposal (ITO) Phase

Goal:
Establish a strong foundation for execution success.

Build the foundation for successful delivery by:

Driving creation of the Statement of Work and ensuring clarity in deliverables.
Partnering with Engineering & Product teams to confirm technical feasibility, resource constraints, and capabilities.
Defining clear requirements and unambiguous acceptance criteria to prevent downstream rework.
Establishing and maintaining a realistic, achievable joint master schedule.
Developing resource‑loaded, deliverable‑based estimates to complete using systems such as Clarity.
Serving as the owner of EAC (Estimate at Completion), ensuring risk‑loaded plans and forecasts.
Program Execution Phase

Goal:
Deliver reliably and predictably on all program commitments.

Ensure programs deliver on commitments through disciplined execution:

Take ownership and proactively drive all aspects of program delivery.
Hold technical management resources accountable to program objectives.
Embed quality in planning to prevent rework and ensure reliable outcomes.
Manage scope and requirements aggressively through predictable change control processes.
Lead proactive customer communication, including meetings, follow‑ups, and change order management.
Facilitate timely decision‑making and eliminate delays.
Establish and maintain performance baselines for scope, schedule, and cost.
Conduct bi‑weekly schedule status updates and forecasting.
Identify, track, and mitigate risk, maintaining an appropriate risk reserve/contingency budget.
Ensure strict alignment of program execution with project control tools (e.g., Primavera, Clarity, Rally, Oracle).
Support & Lifecycle Contribution
Reinforce the principles established in proposal and execution phases to support long‑term customer satisfaction.
Ensure Delivery and Support Services are positioned for continued customer value and future growth opportunities.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

About The Company

At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. You will own the delivery of Redpin's most important cross-functional business initiatives — the programs the company is betting on — and be accountable for the outcome, not just the plan.

You'll operate across Engineering, Product, Operations, and the CTO's office, turning ambiguous, high-stakes goals into a plan teams believe in and then landing it. Async-first and pragmatic. We default to writing, meet only when a decision needs a room, and value judgement over process. We're not looking for a TPM who runs programs by the book or blocks progress with ceremony — we're looking for the person who is the reason initiatives ship.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Safeguards (Infrastructure & Evals)
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Safeguards Engineering builds and operates the infrastructure that keeps Anthropic's AI systems safe in production — the classifiers, detection pipelines, evaluation platforms, and monitoring systems that sit between our models and the real world. That infrastructure needs to be not just correct, but reliable : when a safety-critical pipeline goes down or degrades, the consequences can be serious, and they can be invisible until someone looks closely.

As a Technical Program Manager for Safeguards Infrastructure and Evals, you'll own the operational health and forward momentum of this stack. Your primary responsibility is driving reliability — owning the incident-response and post-mortem process, ensuring SLOs are defined and met in partnership with various teams, and making sure that when things go wrong, the right people know, the right actions get taken, and those actions actually get closed out. Alongside that ongoing operational rhythm, you'll coordinate the larger platform investments: migrations, eval-platform improvements, and the cross-team dependencies that connect them.

This role sits at the intersection of operations and program management. It requires genuine technical depth — you need to understand how these systems work well enough to triage effectively, judge what's actually safety-critical versus what can wait, and have informed conversations with the engineers building and maintaining them. But the core of the job is keeping the machine running well and the work moving.

What You'll Do

Own the Safeguards Engineering ops review - Drive the recurring cadence that keeps the team informed and coordinated: surfacing recent incidents and failures, bringing visibility to reliability trends, and making sure the right people are in the room when decisions need to be made. This is the heartbeat of how Safeguards Eng stays ahead of operational risk.
Drive incident tracking and post-mortem execution - When incidents happen — and in this space, they happen regularly — you'll make sure they get followed through properly. That means tracking incidents across the organization (including those owned by partner teams like Inference), ensuring post-mortems get written, and most critically, making sure the action items that come out of them actually get done. Closing the loop on post-mortem actions is one of the highest-leverage things this role does.
Establish and maintain SLOs with partner teams - Work with Safeguards Engineering teams and key partners — particularly Inference and Cloud Inference — to define service-level objectives for safety-critical pipelines. Then build the tracking and reporting that makes it possible to tell whether those SLOs are being met, and surface it when they're not.
Maintain runbook quality and incident-ownership clarity - Safety-critical systems need clear playbooks for when things go wrong. Partner with engineering leads to keep runbooks accurate, actionable, and up to date — and ensure that ownership of incidents is unambiguous so that nothing falls through the cracks during an active incident.
Drive platform migrations and infrastructure projects - Own the program management for the larger infrastructure work on the roadmap: migrating the infra from one platform to the next, moving from one incident platform to the next and from one cloud system monitoring to another, and other migrations as they come. These are cross-team efforts with real dependencies — your job is to keep them sequenced, on track, and connected to the teams that need them.
Coordinate evals platform improvements - Partner with the evals engineering team to drive improvements to the evaluation platform — including self-serve capabilities and the broader eval factory infrastructure. Help scope the work, track dependencies on other Safeguards systems, and make sure the evals platform is keeping pace with the team's needs.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Have solid technical program management experience, particularly in operational or infrastructure-heavy environments — you're comfortable owning a mix of ongoing operational cadences and discrete project work simultaneously.
Understand how production ML systems work well enough to triage incidents intelligently and have substantive conversations with engineers about what's going wrong and why — you don't need to write the code, but you need to follow the technical thread.
Are energized by closing loops. Post-mortem action items that never get done, SLOs that no one checks, runbooks that go stale — these things bother you, and you know how to build the processes and follow-ups that fix them.
Can work effectively across team boundaries — comfortable coordinating with partner teams (like Inference) where you don't have direct authority, and skilled at keeping shared work moving through influence and clear communication.
Thrive in environments where the work shifts between "keep the lights on" and "build something new" — and can context-switch between incident follow-ups and longer-horizon platform projects without dropping either.
Have experience with or strong interest in AI safety — you understand why the reliability of a safety-critical pipeline is a different kind of problem than the reliability of a product feature, and that distinction motivates you.

Strong Candidates May Also

Have experience with SRE practices, incident management frameworks, or on-call operations at scale.
Have worked on or with evaluation infrastructure for ML systems — understanding how evals get designed, run, and interpreted.
Have experience driving infrastructure migrations in complex, multi-team environments — particularly where the migration touches operational systems that can't go offline.
Be familiar with monitoring and alerting tooling (PagerDuty, Datadog, or equivalents) and the operational culture around them.

Deadline to apply:
None, applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Launches
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

As a Technical Program Manager for Product, you'll drive the programs that bring Anthropic’s AI capabilities to the world. You’ll work closely with research teams to understand new model capabilities, then orchestrate across engineering, product, infrastructure, and go-to-market teams to ensure we launch reliably and at pace. This role is essential in orchestrating the cross-functional effort required to launch successfully as Anthropic continues to scale.

This role offers unique challenges in coordinating high-stakes technical programs while maintaining the quality and reliability our customers expect. This position requires deep technical fluency, the ability to earn trust with researchers and engineers, and a talent for driving alignment across teams with different priorities and working styles.

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end program management for model and product launches, coordinating between research, engineering, product, infrastructure, and partnership teams
Drive cross-functional alignment and decision-making across workstreams, ensuring teams are unblocked and launches stay on track
Partner closely with Research PMs and engineering leads to sequence work, manage dependencies, and navigate technical tradeoffs
Track and communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to leadership and stakeholders
Build strong relationships with technical stakeholders, earning trust through deep engagement with the details
Coordinate with research teams to understand upcoming model capabilities and prepare launch plans accordingly
Navigate tradeoffs between speed, quality, and scope, helping teams make informed decisions under pressure
Develop and improve launch processes, playbooks, and operational frameworks that scale with our growing complexity
Create and maintain documentation of launch processes, decision logs, and cross-functional dependencies

You may be a good fit if you

Have several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs
Possess deep technical knowledge that allows you to engage meaningfully with ML researchers and engineers
Have experience managing programs with significant external dependencies and multiple stakeholder groups
Excel at translating between technical teams and stakeholders, making complex tradeoffs understandable
Can thrive in ambiguous situations, bringing structure to complex technical challenges
Have strong organizational skills and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively
Are comfortable operating at a fast pace where priorities shift and new challenges emerge quickly
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority
Build trust quickly and maintain strong relationships even under pressure
Are passionate about Anthropic's mission and interested in the challenges of bringing frontier AI capabilities to users safely

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$365,000—$435,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Superhuman team members in this role must be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and they must be able to collaborate in person 2 days a week.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is running multiple GTM motions simultaneously: business units at different stages of maturity, channel partners across Growth (our B2C self-serve motion) and Managed (our B2B enterprise motion), and a creative and campaign engine that needs to stay in sync with all of it. This role is the operating layer that holds it together.

Senior Program Manager, GTM Operations: you will flex across business units to stand up GTM processes, enable teams to use them, and drive the planning and coordination that turns product launches into well-executed GTM moments. You will also lead large-scale campaign programs, coordinating across BU leaders, channel partners, and Creative Ops from brief creation through execution.

This is a role for someone who thrives in breadth: you can go deep on a BU's product roadmap one week and run a cross-functional campaign kickoff the next. You build the infrastructure that makes GTM repeatable, and you can operate within it well enough to step in when hands-on coordination is needed.

What Makes This Role Electric

You'll have exposure across GTM motions and business units, with the flexibility to go deep where the business needs you most.
You'll join a team with strong existing processes, playbooks, and tooling foundations, and bring a fresh eye to them. The opportunity is to integrate across teams, collaborate on improvements, and help the GTM orgs work better together.
You'll lead programs that span from product feature launches to campaign execution and reporting, giving you end-to-end visibility into how GTM actually works.
You'll partner with senior leaders across BUs, Product, Growth, Managed, and Creative Ops, making this one of the most cross-functional roles in the business.
You'll be part of bringing new products to market from the ground up — working at the intersection of product innovation and GTM at a company where both are actively evolving.

In This Role, You Will

GTM Process & Enablement

Stand up and operationalize GTM processes across business units: launch sequencing, readiness tracking, brief frameworks, and planning cadences
Enable BU teams and channel partners on new processes, ensuring adoption and consistent execution
Build BU-specific and cross-portfolio playbooks that others can learn from, adapt, and run independently
Identify where process gaps are slowing GTM down and drive solutions before they become blockers

Campaign Program Management

Lead large-scale campaign programs end-to-end, coordinating BU leaders, Growth and Managed channel teams, and Creative Ops from brief creation through execution
Ensure campaigns have complete strategic briefs (audience, positioning, timing, success metrics) before Creative Ops kickoff
Maintain cross-BU campaign calendars and keep all stakeholders aligned on sequencing and dependencies
Surface conflicts, gaps, and risks across the campaign portfolio and drive them to resolution

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as the coordination layer between BU leaders, PMMs, DPMs, TPMs, and channel partners across Growth and Managed
Connect product readiness timelines to campaign production schedules so nothing goes to Creative Ops underbaked
Keep GTM priorities, blockers, and dependencies visible to senior GTM leadership

Tooling & Operational Infrastructure

Develop deep fluency in Superhuman Docs, Superhuman's primary GTM operating tool, and partner with program management teams across EPDM to optimize how it's leveraged across GTM workflows that combine other key tools like Jira and Asana
Identify opportunities to improve how teams work across Superhuman Docs, Asana, Jira, and other tools, contributing to standards and improvements in collaboration with the teams who own them
Build and maintain GTM artifacts within our operational hub: active projects, launch trackers, brief templates, and workback calendars

Qualifications

Proven ability to flex across multiple products, business units, or GTM motions simultaneously
Strong cross-functional coordination skills across Product, Marketing, Sales, Design, and Creative Ops
Exceptional written and verbal communicator; able to distill complex, cross-functional programs into clear stakeholder updates and facilitate alignment across leadership teams
Experience leading end-to-end campaign programs, from brief creation through execution
Ability to stand up processes from scratch and enable teams to adopt and run them independently
Familiarity with both PLG and Sales-led GTM motions
Tooling-literate: comfortable evaluating and operating across Coda, Asana, Jira, and similar tools
Comfortable leveraging AI tools and automation to reduce manual lift, improve operational workflows, and scale GTM processes
Relationship-first operator who earns trust before driving change
Experience with paid acquisition or performance marketing workflows is a plus

Compensation And Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
Disability and life insurance options
401(k) and RRSP matching

20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time

We will reduce cost and effort and improve performance as we break down silos and establish consistent ways of working.

The Digital Project Manager will develop project plans, drive project tasks with various team members and stakeholders, track project progress, and escalate project issues.
