jobs.title: Project Manager - Construction
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world

Who are you?

Turner & Townsend
is seeking an experienced Project Manager
to support the successful delivery of workplace, real estate, and capital projects within a leading financial services environment.

Reporting to the Project Delivery leadership team, you will play a key role in managing complex projects from initiation through close-out, ensuring delivery excellence across scope, schedule, budget, and stakeholder expectations. This is a hands-on role requiring strong project leadership, exceptional organization, and the ability to navigate multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

As a trusted project leader, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project execution, maintain governance standards, manage project risks, and measure value realization. Your ability to align project outcomes with business objectives while delivering an exceptional end-user experience will be critical to success.

You will support projects within ATB Financial's People Places & Spaces (PP&S)
team, the group responsible for real estate strategy, workplace experience, design, construction, facilities management, and the ongoing transformation of both corporate and client-facing environments across Alberta.

Leveraging Turner & Townsend's industry-leading project controls, governance practices, and delivery expertise, you will help ensure projects are completed efficiently, effectively, and in alignment with organizational priorities.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery:
Lead complex projects through the full project lifecycle, from planning and initiation through execution, launch, and close-out, ensuring successful delivery against established objectives.
Scope, Schedule & Budget Management:
Develop, manage, and monitor project scope, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements, ensuring projects remain aligned with approved parameters.
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
Provide clear, timely, and consistent communication to project stakeholders, including project status, risks, key decisions, milestones, and change impacts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner effectively with business units, consultants, vendors, and internal teams to ensure coordinated execution and successful project outcomes.
Project Governance & Documentation:
Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, schedules, budgets, risk logs, status reports, decision registers, and close-out records.
Risk & Project Health Management:
Monitor project performance, proactively identifying risks, issues, and dependencies while developing mitigation strategies to maintain project momentum .

Value Realization & Reporting:
Track and report on project outcomes, benefits, and value realization, ensuring alignment with strategic and operational objectives.
Change Impact Assessment:
Evaluate project impacts on people, processes, and operations, supporting smooth implementation and successful transition management.
Project Close-Out:
Lead project handover and close-out activities, ensuring all deliverables are completed, documented, and transitioned effectively to operational stakeholders.

Qualifications

Experience:
3-5+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated success delivering complex projects from initiation through close-out. Previous experience managing end-to-end projects within the construction, real estate, workplace, or capital projects environment is considered a strong asset.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Construction Management, Real Estate, or a related field. PMP certification is considered a strong asset.

Project Management Tools:
Experience with Smartsheet or comparable project management platforms.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency with Google Workspace (or similar productivity tools) and the ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies.
Leadership:
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage competing stakeholder interests, and drive projects to successful outcomes.
Communication:
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with expertise in project reporting, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement.

Additional Information

What's in it for you...

100% covered health and dental benefits for you and your dependents (including paramedical services)

Health spending account, to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program

RRSP option with company matching

Annual learning and development budget

Access to a range of online learning tools, and support for career development and growth

Coverage of one professional membership or license fee per year, if directly related to your role

We believe in work-life balance, so you can recharge and take care of what matters most with vacation, flex and sick days

A flexible, hybrid work approach that allows colleagues to find balance between their professional and personal lives

Commitment to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture that promotes a sense of belonging

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

We are an Equal opportunity employer who will ensure accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities upon request. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee high-profile infrastructure projects, $100,000 - $130,000

Your new company

Our client is a well-established Canadian contractor specializing in complex foundation, shoring, geotechnical and underground construction projects. With operations across Eastern Ontario and Quebec, the organization delivers technically challenging infrastructure and ICI projects for public and private sector clients.

Known for its collaborative culture, strong project pipeline and reputation for tackling complex engineering challenges, the company continues to expand and is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the delivery of major projects ranging from $1M to $20M+.

Your new role

As Project Manager, you will take ownership of the planning, execution and successful delivery of specialized construction projects across the infrastructure, institutional and industrial sectors.

Working closely with senior leadership, field operations, clients, consultants and subcontractors, you will oversee multiple projects simultaneously while providing mentorship and guidance to junior project staff and coordinators.

Projects may include deep foundation systems, excavation support, geotechnical works, bridge-related construction, underground works, infrastructure upgrades and other technically complex civil construction assignments.

Key responsibilities will include:
Managing projects from pre-construction through closeout
Developing and maintaining project schedules, budgets and forecasts
Reviewing drawings, specifications and contract documents
Coordinating internal resources, subcontractors and suppliers
Leading project meetings with clients, engineers and project stakeholders
Identifying and mitigating project risks
Monitoring financial performance and cost control

Preparing progress reports and executive updates
Ensuring compliance with health, safety, quality and environmental requirements
Mentoring junior project personnel and supporting project team development

The ideal candidate will bring strong construction project management experience and a desire to work on technically challenging infrastructure projects. Candidates may come from backgrounds such as:
Heavy civil construction

Foundations and piling

Large-scale ICI projects

5+ years of Project Management experience within construction

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Strong commercial and financial acumen

jobs.description:
What You’ll Be Doing

The Project Manager is a key position at Jensen Infrastructure. You’ll design and coordinate multiple product lines for precast concrete products. You’re the point person who determines proper process flow to ultimately manufacture quality products and fulfill on-time deliveries.

Reporting to our Sales Manager, you’ll communicate with our production department regarding schedule requirements, with our customers, outside sales, and engineers regarding project contract, with our delivery and yard departments for safe and on-time delivery, and report progress and challenges to the leadership team.

A Highlight Of Your Day-to-day Will Include

Managing and coordinating all aspects of large and/or custom projects.
Managing the work order process to provide accurate work orders and drawings for production.
Producing an accurate bill of materials (BOM) for precast concrete structures being planned for production. Inputting BOMs into the manufacturing software to reflect an accurate accounting of the cost associated with each product being manufactured on a job-by-job basis.
Managing project take-offs and estimating for projects in the planning and bidding stages.
Tracking and reporting project progress from submittal stage to product installation via our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
Ensuring deliverables fall within the applicable scope, schedule, and budget.
Preparing a weekly sales report for the Sales Manager’s review and distribution to the team.
Ensuring that mutually agreed upon contract clearly specifies terms and conditions and all products requested clearly specify requirements per drawings and plans so that the estimates are 100% accurate for each project in support of efficiency, accuracy, and deadline adherence.
Communicating the date the product can be manufactured and ready for delivery, changes to orders, add-ons, and any other issues that may arise during the manufacturing process to the customers.
Ensuring delivery date is scheduled per customer needs and delivered as requested.
Obtaining project site specifications and safety standards to communicate with dispatch for offloading products, and understanding hazards for crane operators.
Participating in entertainment functions with customers (e.g., lunches, dinners).
Participating in tradeshows, seminars, and classes to improve product knowledge and/or personal skills.

Who We Are Looking For

You’re enthusiastic and motivated in a fast-paced environment. You possess demonstrated project management experience, preferably in a precast concrete or building materials environment (minimum of 3 years). You’re a lifelong learner preferably with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or construction management. Your passion for customers comes first and you aren’t bothered by having to manage the details in the CRM. You don’t take shortcuts. You’re safety conscious not just for yourself, but for your team.

We’re open to individuals who aren’t just looking for their next job, they’re looking to build a career. You want an opportunity to showcase your skillset in dispatch/logistics, strategic planning and business development with a solid company who will invest in you. In our culture – everyone matters.

All About Jensen Infrastructure

Much like you, our founder, Don Jensen was looking for a way to support his family, so he started his Company in 1968. Since founded, we’ve been supporting communities across Nevada, California, Arizona, Washington, Missouri, and Hawaii.

Jensen Infrastructure likely has an impact on your daily life. We build culverts to take water away from your neighborhoods, underground utility boxes to hold cables, and manholes to allow workers access to the sewers deep below the roads we drive on. And that’s just a small sample of what we do at Jensen on a daily basis.

When you work at one of Jensen’s many locations, you will enjoy the close relationships and camaraderie of a small company while being part of a larger, well-established, growing company.

We are committed to ensuring employment practices that promote equal opportunities. Please let us know if you require any reasonable accommodations during your interview process.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

What MatX Is Building

MatX is on a mission to be the compute platform for AGI. We are developing vertically integrated full-stack solutions from silicon to systems including hardware and software to train and run the largest ML workloads for AGI. MatX is seeking silicon micro-architects and design engineers to join our team as we create best-in-class silicon for high-performance and sustainable GenAI. Successful candidates for these roles will be responsible for delivering performant and functionally accurate silicon for MatX products across compute, memory management. High-speed connectivity and other key technologies.

About The Role

MatX is building next-generation AI infrastructure systems for high-performance datacenter workloads. We are looking for a Senior NPI TPM, Rack-Scale AI Systems
to manage integrated execution for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final production ramp.

In this capacity, you will serve as the primary interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners. You will coordinate workstreams across material readiness, PLM/BOM/ECO control, factory test deployment, quality metrics, and high-volume ramp readiness for high-performance AI infrastructure.

What You'll Do Here

Direct the integrated NPI lifecycle for rack and board platforms, spanning engineering builds through the final volume production ramp.
Act as the primary technical interface for manufacturing execution with external CM/JDM partners to ensure factory readiness.
Manage master build schedules, configuration matrices, and unit allocation while leading formal build-readiness governance.
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across PLM, BOM control, ECOs, material readiness, and shipment logistics.
Oversee integrated execution across PCBA, high-power modules, liquid-cooled trays, and complex rack-level systems.
Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to finalize DFX requirements, serviceability standards, and factory-flow optimization.
Partner with test teams to deploy diagnostics, power characterization, and data-capture infrastructure prior to build kick-off.
Define metrics and dashboards to track first-pass yield, quality gates, and corrective actions throughout the development cycle.
Engage with Supply Chain to mitigate risks associated with long-lead semiconductor components and material shortages.
Lead ECO tracking and revision effectiveness, serving as the central point for build-level change communication.
Prepare executive-level reporting that summarizes technical risks, material gaps, and high-volume ramp readiness.
Ensure critical learnings from validation phases are captured in playbooks to drive predictable production-readiness plans.

Who You Are

8+ years of technical program management, NPI program management, manufacturing operations, hardware operations, or engineering program management experience.
Experience driving complex hardware builds through EVT, DVT, PVT, production readiness, and ramp.
Experience working with CM, JDM, ODM, or rack-scale manufacturing partners on build planning, factory readiness, issue closure, and manufacturing execution.
Experience with BOMs, AVLs, ECOs, configuration management, DFM/DFA/DFT, PCBA manufacturing, final assembly, factory test, and quality systems.
Experience tracking manufacturing KPIs such as first-pass yield, defect pareto, rework rate, test pass rate, build cycle time, and quality escapes.
Ability to drive schedules, risk management, issue tracking, milestone governance, and executive-level communication.
Strong cross-functional leadership across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, test, and external partner teams.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize build risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and schedule impact.
Proficiency with program-management and engineering collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, MS Project, Google Workspace, or equivalent.

Bonus Points If You Have

Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU/accelerator systems, datacenter racks, networking systems, storage systems, or high-power server platforms.
Experience coordinating programs involving rack-scale integration, liquid-cooled systems, high-speed interconnects, factory diagnostics, or system-level validation.
Prior hands-on experience in hardware, manufacturing, test, quality, supply chain, or NPI operations is a plus.

Early Career - $120,000 - $250,000 + equity
Mid Career - $175,000 - $362,500 + equity

At Outform Group, our guiding philosophy is Dare To Innovate.

Outform Group specializes in creating tangible consumer engagements that elevate, connect and humanize brand experiences. We unite leading experts in research, strategy, design, innovation and manufacturing, who work together to create unforgettable brand experiences.

Lean, interdisciplinary teams work in close collaboration with clients, helping them to solve their user’s biggest problems. Our user-centric, data-driven approach focuses on creating a seamless experience across different environments.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager
to own and drive complex, high‑visibility technology initiatives from concept through global deployment.

This role requires a seasoned technical leader who thrives in ambiguity, navigates complexity with ease, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to deeply understand technologies that power modern retail experiences. Curiosity, technical breadth, and strong execution discipline are essential.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCOPE & ACCOUNTABILITY

This role owns the full lifecycle of complex, high-visibility technology programs—from initial scoping and architecture through global deployment and long-term support. The Senior Technical Project Manager serves as the central technical authority and primary client-facing leader for large-scale retail technology initiatives, with initial focus on multi-phase LED video wall programs for a major retail brand. This position carries direct accountability for program outcomes across scope, timeline, budget, and quality, while simultaneously building and maintaining high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones. The role operates with significant autonomy and is expected to make high-impact decisions that shape both client experience and internal capability.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Oversight

Provide senior-level oversight across multiple concurrent technology programs, ensuring technical feasibility, design excellence, and flawless execution within scope, timeline, and budget.
Evaluate project opportunities, define high-level architecture, determine resource needs, and guide teams through complex decision-making.
Lead the development and integration of hardware, software, and physical display systems, ensuring seamless performance in demanding retail environments.
Build and maintain high-trust relationships with engineers, designers, fabricators, and manufacturing partners across global time zones.
Define technical requirements, develop comprehensive technology BOMs, and guide sourcing, procurement, and estimation strategies.

Program & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, translating their goals into actionable technical plans and delivering executive-level communication.
Oversee large-scale project roadmaps, risk mitigation strategies, and milestone tracking across multiple parallel workstreams.
Maintain and evolve technical documentation, including wiring schematics, integration maps, digital die lines, and BOMs.
Define and implement documentation standards, QA processes, and best practices for installation, support, and troubleshooting.
Lead internal and external status meetings, delivering clear updates to senior stakeholders.

Hands-On Technical Execution

Personally evaluate, test, and validate technology solutions as part of pre-sale exploration, prototyping, and client demonstrations.
Build quick-turn prototypes and technology demos that support new business development and innovation initiatives.
Act as a tier-two escalation point for complex troubleshooting, ensuring issues are resolved swiftly and root causes are understood.
Partner with technology vendors to scope, assess, and co-develop solutions tailored for retail activation.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration

Operate as the central hub between engineering, design, production, sourcing, and client teams—translating technical details into clear, actionable insights.
Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that encourages experimentation, knowledge sharing, and creative problem-solving.
Anticipate communication gaps and proactively bridge them across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor junior team members and contribute to scaling technical project management capabilities across the organization.

KEY INTERFACES (NON-REPORTING)

This role collaborates consistently with the following teams and functions outside its direct reporting structure: Engineering and Software Development teams (hardware/software integration), Design and Creative teams (retail experience and display design), Production and Fabrication teams (manufacturing and physical build), Sourcing and Procurement teams (vendor and component management), Client stakeholders and executive sponsors, Technology Vendors and LED/digital signage suppliers, Global Manufacturing Partners (including production facilities in China), and Installation and Field Support teams.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Success in this role will be measured against metrics including but not limited to:
On-time and on-budget delivery rate across assigned technology programs
Client satisfaction scores and retention on managed accounts
Prototype and demo quality as measured by client approval and conversion
Speed and effectiveness of issue resolution (escalation response time)
Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation (BOMs, schematics, integration maps)
Cross-functional team feedback on communication clarity and collaboration
Adherence to QA standards and reduction in post-installation defects

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred; equivalent work experience accepted.
Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical project management role within experiential, retail, hardware, software, or systems integration environments.

Technical Knowledge

Strong foundation in both hardware and software systems with ability to engage in deep technical discussions
Prior experience with LED systems, digital signage, and retail technology highly preferred
Familiarity with wiring schematics, integration maps, and technology BOMs
Hands-on technical aptitude (e.g., PC building, coding, home networking, video editing, or interactive technology tinkering)

Program Management Skills

Proven track record managing large, multi-stakeholder programs with competing priorities
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation, QA processes, and installation standards
Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies

Communication & Leadership

Exceptional communication and leadership presence with demonstrated client-facing skills
Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences
Experience presenting to executive-level stakeholders

Other Requirements

Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time (domestic and international, including China)
Availability for weekly calls with teams in China across time zones

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES & PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

Strategic & Innovative Thinker: Approaches problems with a forward-thinking mindset, comfortable owning high-impact decisions and operating with autonomy in ambiguous situations.
Exceptional Communicator: Able to simplify technical complexity for any audience—from engineers to C-suite executives—with clarity, confidence, and precision.
Trust Builder: Earns credibility through deep preparation, technical intelligence, and consistent execution. Develops high-trust relationships with clients, vendors, and internal teams alike.
Relentless Problem Solver: Thrives under pressure with a track record of delivering results. Approaches obstacles with a solutions-oriented mindset and never leaves an issue unresolved.
Collaborative Influencer: Skilled at guiding cross-functional decisions and rallying diverse teams behind a shared goal without formal authority.
Passionate About Retail Technology: Genuinely energized by leveraging technology to create best-in-class customer experiences in physical retail environments.
Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented: Consistently meets deadlines, maintains rigorous documentation standards, and keeps complex programs on track simultaneously.
Self-Driven & Proactive: Takes initiative without being prompted, anticipates needs before they arise, and is energized by building what doesn’t yet exist.
Positive Can-Do Attitude: Willing to jump in wherever and whenever needed, bringing energy and optimism to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Essential Functions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, sit, and stand, using hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools, or controls. LMI is seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager (TPM)
to work onsite at Fort Bragg and lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of a mission-critical technical program supporting U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM). The TPM will integrate the work of cross-functional technical teams, translate mission priorities into executable plans, and ensure delivery against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and performance commitments.

The ideal candidate is a disciplined, mission-focused leader who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, communicate with senior government and corporate stakeholders, and remove barriers for engineers and delivery teams. Success requires sound judgment, strong program controls, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt quickly as operational and technical priorities evolve.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This position is located onsite at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, and requires an active Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance.

Responsibilities

Lead day-to-day planning, execution, and delivery of a complex technical program supporting USSOCOM mission requirements.
Translate government priorities and technical objectives into integrated project plans, milestones, work packages, and measurable outcomes.
Enable cross-functional teams—including software, platform, data, cybersecurity, engineering, and operations personnel—to deliver high-quality capabilities on schedule.
Establish and maintain program controls for scope, schedule, cost, staffing, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and contract deliverables.
Monitor program performance, identify emerging execution risks, and drive timely mitigation, escalation, and corrective action.
Coordinate priorities, resource assignments, and delivery timelines with technical leads, product owners, program leadership, and government stakeholders.

Maintain a strong working understanding of the technical solution, including NVIDIA hardware, GPU infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, networking, data center infrastructure, and related software technologies.
Translate complex technical concepts, risks, and dependencies into clear communication for business and executive stakeholders.
Develop and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, resources, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
Identify project risks, technical blockers, resource constraints, and dependencies early and drive them toward resolution.
Lead client status meetings, technical syncs, project reviews, and executive-level updates.
Manage project scope and change requests while maintaining alignment around timelines, budgets, and client expectations.
Own day-to-day client communication and maintain strong relationships throughout the engagement.
Coordinate with NVIDIA and NVIDIA partner resources when necessary for technical alignment, product updates, troubleshooting, or escalations.
Ensure accurate project documentation and communication throughout pre-sales, implementation, delivery, and closeout.
Manage project financials in a billable/professional services environment, including scope, resource utilization, time tracking, and billing expectations.
Lead project closeout, including documentation handoff, lessons learned, client acceptance, and transition to support or operations.

Required Qualifications
7+ years of project/program management experience, including significant experience managing highly technical infrastructure or technology projects.
Demonstrated experience working within the NVIDIA ecosystem, including one or more of the following:
NVIDIA GPUs
NVIDIA DGX systems
NVIDIA AI Enterprise
CUDA
GPU compute infrastructure
AI/ML infrastructure
NVIDIA networking technologies
NVIDIA data center solutions
Experience managing projects across the entire lifecycle — pre-sales/scoping, planning, implementation, delivery, go-live, and closeout.
Strong technical fluency with the ability to understand infrastructure architecture, system integrations, technical dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
Proven ability to serve as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience managing complex projects involving multiple engineering teams, vendors, partners, and client stakeholders.
Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills, including experience communicating with C-level executives and senior technical leaders.
Strong project planning, risk management, resource management, and escalation management capabilities.
Experience working within a consulting, professional services, or other billable client environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to travel to client sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience managing NVIDIA AI infrastructure deployments, DGX environments, GPU clusters, or accelerated computing projects.
Experience with data center infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), AI/ML infrastructure, networking, or systems integration.
Experience working for an NVIDIA partner, systems integrator, VAR, consulting firm, or professional services organization.
Familiarity with NVIDIA's partner ecosystem, certifications, products, and support/escalation processes.
PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, or similar project/program management certification.
Experience with project management and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or Asana.

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a technical project leader rather than a purely administrative PM. You don't need to be the engineer configuring the environment, but you should understand the technology well enough to participate credibly in technical discussions, challenge assumptions, recognize risks, and communicate effectively between engineers and business leaders.
We're looking for someone who can walk into a conversation with an NVIDIA architect or infrastructure engineer, understand what is being discussed, and then translate the key decisions, risks, and business impact to a client executive.

If you have successfully led NVIDIA, GPU, AI infrastructure, HPC, or complex data center deployments while owning the client relationship from pre-sales through final delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Project Manager IV, Transformation
jobs.description:
If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career.

Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families.

The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

Grade: Professional 312

Pay Range: $109,900.00 - $170,400.00

Job Description

The Project Manager IV, Transformation is responsible for constructing and leading detailed project plans designed to implement important business process transformation initiatives and strategies.  The Project Manager IV uses traditional project management tools combined with advanced transformation methodologies to successfully deliver large scale change initiatives which could potentially impact all the colleges, students, and employees at WGU.  Business Process Transformation at WGU is not complete until the hearts and minds of the users and stakeholders are also transformed; therefore, the Project Manager IV is a leader in both the human factors of transformation as well as the technology/process elements.  The Project Manager IV works at all levels of management and at all phases of transformation.  Skills in business architecture mapping to synthesize business needs and technology needs into a target future state are just as important as the ability to deliver a complex project on schedule, at cost, and within service level agreements.  A Project Manager IV coordinates constantly with the project leadership in our education technology team as well as the process owners in our colleges and academic practices.  The position will be directly involved in the largest and most important transformation projects at WGU. 

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Responsible for planning, organizing, monitoring, and managing all phases of business transformation projects. 
Responsible for establishing and maintaining professional working relations and communication with customers, project sponsors, service providers, and outside contacts. 
Responsible for maintaining effective communication and coordination within project team. 
Leadership of business architecture mapping and future state planning workshops with business process and EdTech (Information Technology) owners to design the roadmap for transformation.  
Plans, coordinates, and delivers one or more business transformation projects/programs across WGU. 
Secures commitments from different stakeholders to deliver the project to plan. 
Defines priorities and ensures alignment across all other transformation projects where interdependencies apply. 
Builds a project/program team from different capabilities and functional areas. 
Delivers  financial and quality commitments according to the strategic plan. 
Ensures smooth deployment of process and EdTech (Information Technology) solutions in the colleges and practices across the university. 
Reports project/program status & risk regularly to the stakeholders, users, and leadership team. 
Key deliverables of each business transformation project include:  standardized & optimized business processes, training materials and documentation, role descriptions, impact assessments for implementation, transformation communication plan and materials, EdTech solutions, data migration strategies, quality assurance plans, risk management plans, and performance metric/dashboard tracking.  
Collaborates with other professionals both inside and outside of the university to promote a positive, student-obsessed atmosphere. 
Consistently exhibits WGU’s Leadership Principles. 
Responds with urgency to organization needs and exhibits excellent judgment to deliver results.  
Performs other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skill and Abilities:

Excellent leadership and project management skills. 
Works well in a team environment. 
 Ability to influence change and motivate others. 
Strong oral and written communications abilities. 
Solid technical and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to plan and meet schedules. 
Ability to use all related computer equipment and applications 
Understanding of Business Process Architecture Mapping. 

Competencies:

Organizational Impact:

Responsible for implementing initiatives and projects established by university or department leadership; establishes operational plans for department, function, or office with short-term impact on results. 
May deliver input into new processes, standards, or plans that impact overall university or department results.

Problem Solving & Decision Making:

Leverages a systems-thinking approach for improving existing processes and systems within the department using significant conceptualizing, reasoning, and interpretation.
Problems and issues faced are numerous, difficult, and require detailed information gathering and analysis. Typically affect multiple areas or specialties. Problems and issues span a wide range of challenging and unique situations.

Communication & Influence:

Collaborates cross-functionally with parties within and outside of the department and may occasionally communicate with external parties. 
May influence others to accept the job area’s views, practices, concepts, and approaches and conduct briefings with leaders within the University or department. 

Leadership & Talent Management

Responsible for providing guidance, coaching, and training to other employees in the department, Function, or Office. 
Provides direction to project team members, including feedback on performance.
Demonstrates the WGU leadership principles in all aspects of service to students, employees, and partners of WGU.

Job Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

A Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Quality, Computer Science/Software/Information Management, or Business Management. Education must be from an accredited institution. Education is verified. 
Minimum 8 years’ professional experience in a role that required extensive Project/Change Management skills in a large and distributed organization (5000+ employees). 
Excellent understanding of Change Management theory/techniques, and implementation into a project plan. 
Excellent understanding and skills in the change management process.  
Minimum of 8 years of progressive project management & business transformation experience. 
Project Management qualification (PMP) or equivalent. 
Professional experience in strategic planning, risk management. 
Proficiency in project management software tools. 

Preferred Qualifications:

May have broad knowledge of project management.
Black Belt or Master Black Best certification 
Lean Silver or Gold certification 
Experience working with SalesForce software 

Physical Requirements:

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

jobs.title: Senior Security Program Manager
jobs.description:
Description

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance, with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information visit www.agsva.gov.au.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Physical Security is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Program Manager Team Lead to join our team.

The role is responsible for overseeing physical security design and the installation of security features and systems including Access Control, Intrusion Detection, Camera Surveillance, Passive and Active Barriers, and other security features and capabilities consistent with AWS security standards and public sector requirements. This role will perform security program management in support of new data centers, support facilities, data center expansions, and special security programs and projects.

You will lead and manage a team of employees and will work directly with the Cluster Security Managers (CSMs), the Data Center Engineering Operations Team, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate business and operations requirements into long-term physical security design and implementation. You will work independently to support the design and deployment of physical security packages and security program enhancements for AWS data centers and supporting facilities. Additionally, you will work across multiple organizations and serve as the subject matter expert to author security design, Concept of Operations (CONOPS), security installation and sustainment contracts, and other security documents. You will both lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously in the physical security program. You and your team will influence and manage vendor contracts to ensure industry leading systems are deployed and sustained.

The ideal candidate for the role has expertise is setting team goals, managing performance, and motivating employees to achieve program success. Additionally, this candidate has a deep understanding of Security Construction and Equipment Committee (SCEC) physical security requirements and leverages that expertise to make the right decisions for physical security projects and site sustainment. The candidate will handle a complex security and compliance program elements mitigating visible risks or roadblocks to drive timely decisions. The candidate will be comfortable defining program and industry requirements and negotiating resources to achieve priorities and find a path forward on difficult situations. Additionally, the candidate will work across multiple teams within an Amazon Security organization to influence both internal and external customers, system owners, and business leaders. The candidate will effectively communicate with stakeholder audiences across multiple teams and be able to run meetings to drive business and technical discussions and decisions. This candidate will represent AWS in engagements with the internal and external stakeholders to coordinate physical security approvals.

The role will involve some travel for project management and and hand-off of completed projects to local security operations teams.

Key job responsibilities

Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects.
Provide physical security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
Manage vendor on-boarding, Request For Proposal / Request For Quote bidding, contracting, contract execution, QA/QC, and support processes.
Effectively and accurately manage multi-million dollar security project budgets. Own and track the finance and budgeting process for security programs and projects.
Representative for physical security team acceptance, sign-off, and operational readiness validation for high security facilities in conjunction with other AWS teams.
Reporting performance metrics such as physical security system installation vendor service delivery performance, actual spend vs. budget variance, cost reduction goal attainment, post installation defect rates, physical security program analysis, etc.
Collaborate across teams to drive global, regional, and local security initiatives.
Support Cluster Security Managers by providing physical security analysis and recommend program enhancements to maximize security of assigned locations.
Position requires occasional travel to AWS facilities in various cities in Australia to support physical security design and system installation for security program or project execution activities.

Hold or be able to attain an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency clearance (see https://www.agsva.gov.au/applicants/eligibility-and-suitability)

About The Team

The team is comprised of security professionals with a cross section of national security, law enforcement, and private sector experience, providing a range of perspectives required for creative problem solving. We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Benefits

Learning & development — AWS training and certification support, access to internal learning platforms.

Health, income protection and life cover — Amazon subsidises private health insurance premiums, and group salary continuance and life insurance are included at no cost to you.

Military differential pay launching in Australia — Australian employees taking defence reserve leave may receive up to 52 weeks of military differential pay to help cover the difference in pay while serving.

Employee Assistance Program — Free, confidential support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for you and your family — mental health, financial coaching, legal questions, and everyday life events.

Family-building benefit — Access to Maven for fertility treatment, adoption support, surrogacy, and parenting coaching.

Amazon Extras & employee discount — cashback and discounts across hundreds of retail, fitness, travel, and lifestyle partners.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of experience working with physical security design and/or implementation of electronic security systems such as Access Control System, Intrusion Detection System, and CCTV Surveillance systems. Familiarity with security in depth strategies.
5+ years of experience in program or project management, leading both technical and non-technical teams focusing on physical security standards and designs.
3+ years of people management and team leadership experience

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical individuals regarding physical security standards and system designs.
Proficient understanding of construction plans, elevations, and other design and construction artifacts for architectural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and telecommunications plans.
Familiar project management and design and construction software.

Acknowledgement Of Country

In the spirit of reconciliation Amazon acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of country throughout Australia and their connections to land, sea and community. We pay our respect to their elders past and present and extend that respect to all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples today.

IDE Statement

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Product & Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

The mission of Aurora’s OneTech Security Product Management team is to embed security into every aspect of Aurora’s products—spanning software, hardware, and services. As a Staff Technical Product &Program Manager, Security
, you will be responsible for driving security strategy and initiatives across the organization, ensuring that security is a fundamental and functional part of the Aurora product development process.

You will act as a bridge between Security and Product teams across the organization, moving seamlessly between high-level strategy and detailed execution to ensure that complex, cross-functional security is successfully integrated into products developed across the company. Your ability to lead, influence, and manage large-scale security initiatives will be essential in safeguarding Aurora’s products and ensuring they meet the highest security standards.

The job level is negotiable based on experience. Flexible work locations are available (MTV, SFO, PIT, SEA, DET) for US-based employees (Full remote is not available for this role).

In this role, you will

Collaborate with product teams: Work closely with product management, Software and Hardware Development, engineering, and security teams to define security features, assess product risks, prioritize security initiatives, create business and technical use cases, and implement strategic controls that protect both product integrity and user trust.
Engage with suppliers and development partners: Work closely with hardware and software suppliers and Tier1 development partners to define and align on cybersecurity features, drive their timely delivery, and ensure that contributions meet Aurora’s security standards and support overall product integrity and user trust.
Develop high-level security roadmap(s): Work closely with product and engineering leads to develop high level roadmaps and plans (Business and Technical) which will highlight and document cross-functional dependencies as well as the critical path(s) of various programs and projects.
Lead security integration: Develop and execute security assurance, governance, and risk management programs, ensuring they are deeply embedded into all phases of product development from hardware to support applications and that they are aligned with company goals objectives.
Monitor and report: Define and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to product and security risks, ensuring transparency and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Technical Product, Program or Product Management role, in the automotive or AV domain preferred and also cybersecurity experience.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent experience.
Proven experience developing product strategies, building product use cases, leading large-scale programs with an emphasis on project management, requirements management, and integrating hardware and software features into complex products.
Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional product teams.
Hands-on experience participating and directing product development.

Desirable Qualifications

Experience building and scaling product programs from the ground up, particularly in product-focused environments or industries with stringent security requirements.
Strong knowledge of auto industry security standards and regulations (e.g. ISO21434)
Proven ability to lead broad organizational changes.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, particularly in a product context.
Advanced certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent

For roles based in San Francisco, CA, Mountain View, CA, and Seattle, WA: The salary range for this position is $181,000 - $262,000 per year.

For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA: The salary range for this position is $163,000 - $236,000 per year.

Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits.

Working at Aurora

At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom.

Our commitment to safety

At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best-in-class self-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what.

Our commitment to inclusion

Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech.

For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a highly capable Senior Project Manager
to join our IS&S Delivery function, playing a critical role in delivering complex, business-critical technology programmes across DS Smith.

This is a high-impact, global role where you will lead the successful delivery of infrastructure, security and service transformation initiatives
, working across multiple regions and business units. You will operate at the heart of our technology organisation, driving projects that enable strategic change while ensuring robust governance, risk management and delivery excellence.

jobs.description:
Shape the future of security across the Nordics in a fast-growing, international business.

Verisure is seeking a highly experienced, strategic and hands-on Nordic Corporate Security Manager to lead and develop our physical security agenda across the Nordic region. This is a critical role with high visibility, supporting senior leadership and enabling continued growth in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

This is a rare opportunity to step into a high-growth, high-performing and profitable business with a clear mission: to protect what matters most.
Verisure operates in a category with remarkably low market penetration, offering fast potential for expansion. Our growth is rapid, resilient, and highly profitable — powered by a recurring revenue model and deep, long-term customer relationships. What sets Verisure apart is the strength of our platform: a robust, scalable operating model and a high-performing culture rooted in purpose. We’re growing fast, we’re doing it right — and we’re still just getting started.

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services with 24/7 response in Europe and Latin America.
Every day, our dedicated teams use leading technology to Deter, Detect, Verify and Intervene to protect our residential and small business customers against intrusion, burglary, fires, physical attack, home occupation, theft from a business, life-threatening emergencies and other hazards that may risk the safety, wellbeing or condition of our customers and their properties.

We protect a portfolio of over 6.3 million customers across 18 countries.
In 14 of our 18 geographies, we lead the category in terms of customers served and we continue to gain market share. We have a strong track record of profitable and resilient growth, primarily delivered organically by our codified and industrialised business model with high share of recurring revenues (about 90%) and industry leading retention.

Our mission is to give our customers peace of mind by protecting what matters most to them. We believe that everyone has the right to feel safe and secure.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered another year of strong, profitable growth, generating €3.7 billion in Total Revenue, €1.7 billion in Adjusted EBITDA (46% margin) and €953 million in Adjusted EBIT (25% margin). For more information:  www.verisure.com

Verisure in the Nordics

Born in Sweden over 35 years ago, Verisure has grown from a local pioneer into the leading provider of monitored security solutions across the Nordic region and globally.
Today, Sweden stands as our third largest market and Norway as our fifth, with Denmark and Finland playing critical strategic roles in our portfolio. All four countries have delivered exceptional growth over the past five years and hold #1 positions in their respective markets.

With more than 2,000 passionate colleagues and partners across the Nordics, we proudly protect homes and small businesses every day.
As we continue to scale and accelerate, strengthening our brand, reputation, and trust with customers, communities, and key stakeholders is essential. Our ambition is clear: to make the Nordics the most recognized and most preferred security provider in the region.

Responsibilities Of The Corporate Security Manager

As Nordic Security Manager, you hold full accountability for the Corporate Security function across the Nordic region, with a clear mandate to lead, shape, and continuously strengthen the overall security framework
. You are expected to define and drive the regional security strategy, ensuring it is not only aligned with global standards but also effectively translated into concrete actions, measurable outcomes, and consistent execution across all Nordic markets.

In this role, you are not only responsible for setting direction—you are expected to ensure delivery, follow-through, and tangible impact
. You will proactively identify risks, challenge existing ways of working, and implement robust frameworks that enhance resilience, protect critical assets, and support the business in achieving its strategic objectives.

You will operate in a highly cross-functional environment, working closely with senior stakeholders across Legal, HR, Technology, Information Security, and Compliance. As a trusted partner, you are expected to influence decision-making at a senior level, provide clear and actionable insights, and ensure that security is embedded into business processes rather than treated as a standalone function
. In parallel, you will collaborate with international peers and Group functions to drive consistency, share best practices, and contribute to the continuous evolution of the global security agenda.

Success in this role requires the ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on involvement
, taking ownership in critical situations while maintaining a long-term, proactive perspective on risk and security development.

Core responsibilities

Develop and implement the corporate and physical security strategy across the Nordic region, ensuring a consistent level of security maturity across all markets to protect Verisure’s people, facilities, assets, operations, information, reputation, service continuity, and customer trust against risks of any nature
Identify risks, gaps, threats, and vulnerabilities, and drive preventive, reactive, and predictive mitigation actions
Lead internal investigations focused on the detection and prevention of misconduct fraud, loss of sensitive information, illegal competition, and other security-related irregularities
Address internal and external incidents with potential legal, operational, financial, or reputational impact, ensuring appropriate investigation, escalation, documentation, and follow-through
Collaborate with HR, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Technology, and Information Security to gather relevant evidence, support sensitive investigations, and ensure actions are aligned with company policies and applicable requirements
Coordinate, where appropriate, with law enforcement, public authorities, external advisors, and relevant security bodies in connection with incidents or investigations
Develop preventive and predictive methodologies to strengthen fraud deterrence, crime prevention, and loss prevention across the region
Monitor compliance with security policies, procedures, standards, and governance requirements, including alignment with global standards and regulatory expectations
Promote employee awareness, responsible behaviours, and a strong security and compliance culture across the Nordics
Lead corporate security initiatives, including insider risk, personnel security, physical security, crime prevention, fraud deterrence, and investigations
Prevent, detect, manage, and learn from security incidents with potential operational, legal, financial, or reputational impact
Own and continuously improve incident management processes, tools, reporting routines, and governance across the region
Provide intelligence, analysis, and actionable insights related to incidents, investigations, risks, and emerging threats to support strategic decision-making
Define, track, and report security KPIs and continuous improvement metrics, including investigation, fraud, incident, and resilience indicators
Own and develop the Nordic Business Continuity Planning framework, ensuring readiness to protect critical services and recover effectively from disruption
Lead crisis management processes, coordination, exercises, and continuous improvement, ensuring the organisation can respond with structure, speed, and discipline
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership across the Nordics, translating complex security risks into clear, pragmatic, and business-oriented recommendations
Collaborate with Group and regional security leaders to share best practices, drive consistency, and contribute to the evolution of Verisure’s broader security agenda
Contribute to enterprise risk management, organisational resilience, and the safe development of the business across the Nordic region

Candidate profile

You are a highly seasoned and trusted security leader with the ability to operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels in a complex, international environment. With a strong track record of leading security functions across multiple countries, you bring deep expertise across corporate security, physical security, personnel security, fraud deterrence, investigations, business continuity, crisis management, and organisational resilience.

You understand that security is not only about protecting the business from risk, but also about enabling the business to grow in a safe, trusted, and disciplined way. You have a well-developed business mindset and understand how to balance risk, operational needs, customer trust, reputation, and commercial priorities, while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism. You are a natural influencer who builds credibility quickly with senior stakeholders and can translate complex security risks into clear, actionable business decisions. Known for your sound judgment and discretion, you are comfortable handling sensitive matters, working with confidential information, and navigating high-pressure situations with calm, structure, and follow-through. You combine analytical depth with a strong execution mindset and have a proven ability to develop preventive and predictive approaches, implement frameworks, lead investigations, manage incidents, and continuously strengthen security maturity across markets.
